In this paper, we address this gap by deriving sufficient conditions for sublinear counterfactual regret from local generation and deployment guarantees, while retaining the native controller. Specifically, we establish a resource-sensitive transfer that bounds full-state deployment discrepancies along actual execution paths and preserves the own-history laws of both learner and comparator. Besides, local generation reliability yields a cumulative generation opportunity bound, linking policy acquisition to long-term performance through an explicit quality, coverage, and hard-budget tradeoff. To verify these guarantees, we formalize the conditional proof chain for all thirteen numbered theoretical results in Lean, including a native instance with repeated policy growth and imperfect validation.

</details>


### [991] [GREAT-ESDD: Graph Edge Attention Network for Effectively Steered Delivery Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14792)
*Attila Lischka,Ze Zhou,Xuegang,Balázs Kulcsár*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GREAT-ESDD提出基于图边注意力网络(GREAT)的神经CVRP求解器,结合动态定价与在线偏好学习,用于在线同日配送场景中通过定价引导顾客选择OOH(非到家)配送,实现约11%的利润提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线同日配送中,路由成本随客户数增加而上升。OOH配送(包裹站/快递柜)能降低成本,但需通过动态定价引导顾客选择。定价决策需实时估算各配送选项的路由成本增量,而传统元启发式求解器速度不足,且大部分学习型VRP工作假设固定规模和空载起点,不适用于动态在线场景。

Method: 1) 基于GREAT编码器训练神经CVRP求解器,支持混合规模(10-100节点)及任意起点和剩余载重,通过迭代重优化处理动态场景;2) 利用GPU批处理并行求解客户所有配送选项对应的候选CVRP,以边际路由成本增量ΔC指导动态定价菜单选择(以利润最大化为目标,通过整流器ω平衡费用与路由成本);3) 采用MNL模型刻画顾客选择行为,使用基于Laplace近似的Thompson采样(贝叶斯 bandit)在线学习未知偏好参数。实验基于西雅图OpenStreetMap真实路网数据。

Result: 在西雅图路网实验中:GREAT求解器在相似决策时间预算下优于PyVRP元启发式(尤其大规模实例);GREAT-ESDD相比PyVRP框架日利润提升约11%;相比$7统一定价,OOH选择率从18.6%升至29.2%,路由成本降低约6%,顾客平均支付降低3.2%,利润增加约$14/日;当顾客偏好未知时,仅需5天模拟运营即可收敛并超越固定定价策略,学习参数接近真实值。

Conclusion: 快速神经路由使得在结账时基于求解候选路径问题进行配送定价成为可能,且即使需先学习顾客偏好,这种成本感知定价仍然有效。局限性包括:成本估计是短视且启发式的、整流器ω为静态、仅考虑单车辆且商品可互换、顾客行为为模拟。未来方向包括自适应ω、多车辆、非可互换商品、非短视估计及真实数据验证。

Abstract: Online, same-day delivery requires operators to constantly update their routes, and the routing cost for deliveries increases with the number of customers. Out-of-home (OOH) delivery options can help companies handle increasing customer numbers while keeping delivery costs low. We develop a dynamic pricing-and-routing framework for this online ordering scenario with home and OOH delivery options. First, we develop a neural solver for the capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) based on the Graph-Edge-Attention-Network (GREAT). We train it to solve CVRP with varying instance sizes and starting conditions, allowing it to reoptimize partially executed routes under changing conditions. It is fast while achieving solution quality competitive with traditional baselines. Our solver processes several CVRP instances in parallel in batches and we use it to solve the candidate routing problems that arise from an incoming customer's choice of home or OOH delivery. This provides an estimate of the delivery cost increase per option, which we use to set dynamic prices. Further, it directly provides the updated route once the customer decides. We trade off delivery fees against routing costs and steer customers toward OOH delivery when home delivery would be costly. However, effective steering requires us to know the customer preferences. To learn those online, we use Thompson sampling with a Laplace-approximated posterior. We call the resulting framework GREAT-ESDD (GREAT for Effectively Steered Delivery Decisions). Compared to a traditional routing solver, it increases profit by around 11% under a similar pricing decision time budget. Moreover, we show that we can estimate customer preferences successfully, outperforming a static pricing strategy after only 5 days of simulated operations.

</details>


### [992] [CESNET-TimeSeries26: A Multi-Year Network Traffic Time Series Dataset for Annual Seasonality, Concept Drift, and Long-Term Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14799)
*Josef Koumar,Karel Hynek,Kamil Jerabek,Pavel Siska*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了CESNET-TimeSeries26数据集，这是从捷克CESNET3学术ISP网络收集的995天连续网络流量时间序列数据集，附加一个约4.5年的纵向子网数据。该数据集包含278,466个IP地址、285个机构、566个机构子网在10分钟、1小时、1日三种聚合粒度下的流量数据。其核心贡献在于首次为公共网络流量数据提供了多年级时间序列，使得年度季节性、概念漂移和长期异常检测的量化分析成为可能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公共网络流量数据集普遍过短（普遍少于一年），无法支持需要多年数据的长期预测任务评估，特别是无法捕捉年度季节性、年度间行为漂移以及周期性事件与异常的分离。预测模型在网络流量管理和异常检测中至关重要，但其长期适应性需要多年级基准测试来验证。

Method: 采用与CESNET-TimeSeries24相同的采集基础设施，包括基于ipfixprobe的IP流导出器、IPFIXcol2流收集器、NEMEA框架和TimeScaleDB数据库。采集始于2023年10月16日，结束于2026年6月30日，覆盖995天。聚合包括体积指标（流数、包数、字节数）、唯一性指标（目的IP/ASN/端口数）、比例指标（TCP/UDP比、方向比）、平均值指标（流持续时间、TTL）。提供10分钟、1小时、1日三种聚合。包含日历注释（周末、捷克节假日、学terms、考试周期、欧洲时区切换）。额外提供一个含255个地址的/24机构子网的约4.5年纵向TCP-only数据。

Result: 技术验证确立了四项发现：(i) 年度季节性是主导周期成分，其在96.8%机构、98.2%子网、99.8%密集IP序列中强于周季节性；(ii) 预测模型只有在训练窗口跨越至少一个完整年度周期后才能利用年度成分；(iii) 多数网络实体存在统计显著的年度间分布漂移，且TTL等指标呈现缓慢的多年结构性变化；(iv) 不重训练的预测模型每季度退化约11.3 SMAPE点，实际重训练间隔为2-3个月。还建立了留一周期离基线，能吸收重复日历效应（圣诞节、暑假，|z|≈0.5–1.2），同时保留非重复事件可见性（2024年探测中断|z|≈3.0，2023年Eduroam架构变化|z|≈5.6）。

Conclusion: CESNET-TimeSeries26是首个公开的多年级真实网络流量时间序列数据集，可作为长期预测与灾害性异常检测的纵向基准。其重要性不在于更长的数据提高点估计精度（实际上不会），而在于使一整类多年级现象可在公共网络数据上可量化：年度季节性的主导地位、年度成分的可利用性条件、年度间漂移的可测性、模型陈旧率的可测性。数据集已永久关闭，可作为稳定的纵向参考。推荐使用规范划分（前两年训练2023-10-09至2025-10-08，剩余部分测试）以促进跨研究可比性。

Abstract: Forecast-based models are fundamental to network traffic management and anomaly detection. However, it is essential to evaluate these forecasting models over extended periods of time in order to assess their adaptability to unexpected phenomena and shifts in underlying patterns. This kind of long-term evaluation requires multi-year data to account for yearly seasonality and behavioral drift. Existing public datasets are too short to support such long-horizon forecasting tasks. We introduce CESNET-TimeSeries26, comprising 995 days of continuous traffic time series from the CESNET3 network, together with a single subnet spanning approximately 4.5 years. The dataset captures 278,466 IP addresses, 285 institutions, and 566 institutional subnets at three aggregation intervals. The dataset provides a definitive longitudinal benchmark for evaluating forecasting models in both operational management and security monitoring. We demonstrate that annual seasonality is the dominant periodic component. Moreover, we show that a forecasting model can exploit the annual component only when its training window covers at least one complete annual cycle, which no sub-year dataset provides.

</details>


### [993] [ASIWorld: Benchmarking Autonomous Agents in a Persistent Survival Sandbox](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14807)
*Jianfeng Lin,Runze Wang,Haorong Hong,Yuxuan Xie,Zeno Zeng,Zhongyuan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ASIWorld 是一个持续性生存沙盒基准测试,用于评估自主智能体在长视野目标执行中的表现,综合考察任务结果、发展成就达成、执行行为与生存代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体评估多聚焦于单次任务成功或单步动作选择,缺乏对"持续性目标执行"中准备、行动、反馈与代价之间协调关系的系统评估。ASIWorld 旨在将任务结果与达成过程、行为代价联系起来,推动对完整智能体系统(模型+执行框架+可编程行为)的全面评估。

Method: 构建持续性生存沙盒:世界与角色状态跨交互持续;采用角色范围观测;提供可编程异步接口,智能体可直接行动或编写在模型调用间持续运行的程序。任务包括制作旅行服装(生产)与击败隐藏Boss Shadow King(探索)。评估指标涵盖任务成功、发展成就(8项独立评估)、执行轨迹、活动分配(制作/战斗/建设/维护/移动)及生存代价(击倒数)。在统一执行框架(Claude Code)下对9种大语言模型配置进行单赛季(300模拟分钟)探索性评估,并结合额外两赛季数据开展难度分析。

Result: 9个配置中8个完成生产任务,6个同时完成两项任务。所有完成探索的配置均通过三层级地下城;未完成者多停滞于第一层级。活动量与最终排名无一致对应(例:deepseek-v4-flash击杀与Boss数最高却仅排第四)。轨迹分析揭示三类失败模式:未识别的成就要求(公开指南未列出)、识别但未执行的准备(如未装备护甲)、代价性捷径(如故意被击倒以利用持久敌人状态)。难度分析显示高层级地下城区分了定时战斗策略与伤害承受策略两类达成路径。

Conclusion: 终端任务成功不能完整表征持续性目标执行能力;必须结合准备、战斗机制使用、恢复策略、活动分配与生存代价等多维度行为指标进行综合评估。终点相似但过程与代价迥异的配置凸显了过程性评估的必要性。未来工作需通过重复运行、控制变量消融及预设评估规则来增强结论的稳健性。

Abstract: Evaluating autonomous agents requires examining whether they can translate goals into coherent action across extended interactions. In persistent environments, this requires coordinating interdependent actions under incomplete observations, accounting for delayed effects, and adapting as earlier decisions shape subsequent opportunities. We introduce ASIWorld, a survival sandbox that combines persistent world and character state with character-scoped observations and a programmable asynchronous interface to study sustained goal execution. Agents pursue interdependent production and exploration tasks through direct actions or agent-authored programs that continue running between model calls. The evaluation assesses task success, the attainment of development achievements, and survival costs, complemented by an analysis of execution behavior. In an exploratory study of nine agent configurations using a common harness, eight complete the production task and six complete both tasks. Analyses of execution trajectories and performance across difficulty levels reveal different preparation, combat, and recovery behaviors among configurations with similar task outcomes. Incomplete preparation is associated with stalled progression, while configurations that complete the tasks differ in survival costs and the fulfillment of additional achievement criteria. These findings illustrate the value of assessing sustained goal execution through both task outcomes and the behaviors and costs associated with achieving them.

</details>


### [994] [A Reference Architecture for Integrating Agentic AI into Enterprise Software: Responsibilities, Interactions, and Variability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14818)
*Mingqin Yu,Fethi Rabhi,Liming Zhu,Qinghua Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种技术中立的企业Agentic AI集成参考架构，将企业环境中集成智能代理所需的能力组织为十个职责（L0–L9），通过四个边界不变量、八种类型化交互和明确的变体点来分离稳定的职责所有权与条件依赖能力和可替换的实现机制。论文通过ESG投资组合分析与交易前合规代理的实例化以及独立架构的映射进行了评估，验证了架构的组织性与适用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着生成式AI向能够协调推理、企业上下文、模型推理与外部动作的智能代理系统演进，企业软件集成此类能力面临架构层面的挑战。现有研究与工业架构在范围、抽象层次、职责组织、交互表示等方面存在差异，缺乏一个能够统一组织企业Agentic AI能力、明确职责边界、形式化跨职责交互语义并刻画架构变体性的参考架构。

Method: 采用四阶段架构综合方法：(1) 从研究文献、工业架构指南与互操作性规范中识别并归一化77项架构相关条目为44项能力；(2) 按架构目的而非技术术语将能力综合为十个职责，按所有权分为设计上下文（L0）、交互与访问（L1–L2）、代理执行与企业集成（L3–L6）、运行时与运营支撑（L7–L9）；(3) 分析跨职责交互并将其凝聚为八种类型化交互，同时识别条件依赖的变体点；(4) 通过ESG案例实例化和独立架构映射进行基于案例的评估，沿架构覆盖度、职责分离性、可追溯性三个维度进行。

Result: 实例化案例实现了七个职责（L1–L6与L8），覆盖44项归一化能力中的33项，实现了八种交互类型中的五种（T1–T5）；七个不同问题产生了5至41次交互的目标条件化执行路径，L6策略执行与审批门控在条件满足时激活；所有探查的边界不变量（I1–I3）均得到保持，I4在评估范围内保持一致；独立架构的所有11个元素均能映射至L0–L9，无需引入额外职责，其中四个直接对应、六个跨越边界，与不变量一致。

Conclusion: 所提参考架构提供了稳定的职责所有权与条件依赖选择及可替换机制的明确分离，企业Agentic AI集成可遵循识别所需职责、按条件启用能力、选择实现机制、按不变量放置控制的流程。案例评估提供架构组织性与适用性的初步证据而非完备性证明，未来工作将覆盖更多领域、多代理与异步配置、监控驱动的运行时干预以及对质量属性的影响。

Abstract: Agentic AI moves generative AI applications toward systems that coordinate reasoning, enterprise context, model inference, and external actions. Integrating these capabilities into enterprise software introduces diverse architectural concerns, from orchestration, knowledge and memory, and model access to tools and actions, security, runtime infrastructure, and evaluation. Existing research and industry architectures address many of these concerns but differ in scope, abstraction, responsibility organization, interaction representation, and assumptions about which capabilities are required. This paper presents a technology-neutral reference architecture for enterprise agentic AI integration. We synthesize architectural capabilities from research publications, industry architecture guidance, and interoperability specifications by architectural purpose, organize them into ten responsibilities, and define boundary invariants, typed cross-responsibility interactions, and variation points that distinguish responsibilities from condition-dependent capabilities and replaceable realization mechanisms. We instantiate the architecture as an ESG portfolio-analysis and pre-trade compliance agent over an existing service-oriented ESG metric computation and reporting system, and complement the case with a mapping of an independently published agentic architecture. The case realizes seven of the ten responsibilities; different questions take different interaction paths, controls activate only under their conditions, and the probed boundary invariants hold. The independent architecture maps onto the proposed responsibilities without requiring an additional one. These results provide initial evidence for the architecture's organization and applicability rather than its completeness. The deployment and recorded results are available as a replication package.

</details>


### [995] [EvoCowork: A Benchmark for Real-World Office Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14828)
*Zhou Liu,Xingyan Chen,ZhaoYang Han,Zewei Pan,Zeli Su,Ningxin Pan,Xue Hu,Kaixiong Ting,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EvoCowork 是一个面向真实办公场景的 240 任务基准，用于评估智能体框架（harness）的递归自我改进能力。研究核心问题是：从单模态反馈中学到的改进是否能迁移到跨办公应用的协同工作流。实验发现，在 GLM 5.3 模型下，ACE 和 AHE 两种自我改进方法在单模态任务上分别提升 4.90 和 2.64 分，但在跨办公任务上的提升几乎为零（+0.03）或为负（-1.72），表明增益无法自动迁移到需要多文件一致性的工作流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有办公智能体基准和框架进化基准各自评估了不同方面，但缺乏一个能明确测量"单模态反馈改进是否能迁移到跨办公协同工作流"的测试平台。整体进化收益可能掩盖某方面的提升与另一方面的退化，因此需要明确区分这两种条件。

Method: 构建 240 个任务的基准（覆盖 PPT、Word、Excel 和跨办公四类，每类 60 个），采用工件级评分（内容、本地结构、公式、跨文件一致性、视觉质量）。设计受控的 RSI 协议：分离反馈集、修订选择集和最终测试集；共享初始框架 H₀（mini-SWE-agent）；在反馈集上学习，在选择集上选择修订，最终冻结后在未见任务和跨办公任务上评估。比较 ACE（更新上下文 playbook）和 AHE（修改框架代码）两种方法，使用 GLM 5.3 作为求解器和更新器。

Result: 最佳静态配置（Claude Code + GLM 5.3）整体得分 42.25，跨办公 30.62。进化实验中，ACE 整体 +2.46（域内 +4.90，跨办公 +0.03），AHE 整体 +0.46（域内 +2.64，跨办公 -1.72）。AHE 因完成检查代码缺陷导致 31/120 任务崩溃，排除崩溃后实际表现优于 H₀。评委可靠性方面，评审员间一致性 α 为 0.969-0.994，评分 MAE 为 3.78-9.58 分。

Conclusion: EvoCowork 揭示了办公智能体自我改进中反馈迁移的关键问题：在单模态任务上获得的增益不一定能迁移到跨办公协同工作流。该基准通过分离反馈、选择和最终测试集，并保留跨办公任务作为迁移测试，使这种差异变得可见。这表明办公智能体自我改进研究需要专门测试跨办公迁移能力，否则整体收益可能掩盖跨办公性能的实际退化。

Abstract: Office workflows are a demanding testbed for self-improving agents because their deliverables must be correct, natively editable, and mutually consistent. A central question is whether gains on feedback tasks reflect reusable procedures rather than task-specific fixes. We introduce EvoCowork, a 240-task benchmark for evaluating harness-level recursive self-improvement across four office modalities, with model weights held fixed. The benchmark covers presentations, documents, spreadsheets, and cross-office workflows, and scores submitted artifacts for content, native structure, formulas, cross-file consistency, and visual quality where needed. Its protocol separates feedback, revision selection, and final testing: methods learn from single-modality tasks, then are evaluated on unseen single-modality tasks and cross-office workflows under a shared initial harness and explicit budgets. In static evaluations of two models and four harnesses, the best configuration scores 42.25 overall and 30.62 on cross-office tasks. Starting from the same MSA harness with GLM 5.3, ACE and AHE improve in-domain scores by 4.90 and 2.64 points, respectively, but change cross-office scores by only +0.03 and -1.72. Thus, gains on the file types that provide feedback do not necessarily transfer to coordinated workflows. EvoCowork makes this distinction explicit while recording the capability, transfer, and cost of harness evolution. Code and task packages: this https URL .

</details>


### [996] [Pre-Registered Genesis Accounting for Recursive Self-Improvement: First Audited Operator-Genesis Events in a Physics-Discovery Runtime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14843)
*Wenbin Mao,Pei Zou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个用于衡量AI系统递归自我改进中"真正机器创造机制"与"复用设计者提供机制"的双层预注册会计框架（M1/M2），并报告了在物理发现运行时中首次经审计验证的M2创世事件：系统自主组合出Rydberg能级形式(1/n²)和开普勒速度定律(a^(-1/2))等算子，并通过独立标签审计修复了循环论证缺陷，同时展示了已创机制的复合增益测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）声明难以证伪：性能提升可能来自更有效复用设计者提供的机制、规模化扩展，或真正由机器创造的新机制。现有大多数报告未能区分这些来源。论文将"机器创造机制"作为可测量、可治理的实体对待。

Method: 方法核心包括：(1) 两层预注册会计：M1统计设计者提供词汇内的内容实例数，M2统计机器创造并经证书认证的算子类型数；(2) 发明必要性证书：在保持集R²上，要求组合变换R² > τ ≥ 标准库最佳变换R²（τ=0.999），若组合变换仅为标准变换的仿射改写则无法跨过阈值；(3) 独立标签协议：避免自变量从被测定律反推构建的循环性，使用NIST光谱配置标签中的量子数n作为独立变量；(4) 复合通道：已注册算子作为先验进入后续发现；(5) 盲审去策展考试作为负控制。

Result: 报告了首次经审计的M2创世事件：主事件中系统从NIST氢原子Balmer数据组合出算子sq(inv(n))=1/n²（保持集R²从标准最佳-0.546跳至组合1.0000000），独立标签重做后外推到未见能级(n=8,9)相对误差~10⁻⁶，比最佳标准算子好4-6个数量级；在He II上复现，Li III因数据不足（仅3个能级）诚实地未运行；次事件从JPL星历数据独立恢复sqrt(inv(a))开普勒速度定律（M2=2）；复合通道经机制层面确认并在NDBC海洋浮标真实保留域上测得1.109×精度增益（胜率54.6%）；盲审去策展考试34对变量上的诚实得分为零。

Conclusion: 论文的贡献不在搜索算法或重新发现的物理定律本身，而在"机器创造机制"的测量与治理层面：预注册、发明必要性证书、持久复合注册表和自审计使机器创造机制可被接纳、认证、注册和复合。当前限制包括考试由知道教科书答案的智能体策展、触发为手动、语法为观察者注入、样本小，且仅展示"创造能力"而非"自主创世"；盲审零结果诚实地表明真正的创世率仍待测量。

Abstract: Claims of recursive self-improvement are easy to make and hard to falsify: did improvement come from re-using designer-provided mechanisms, or from mechanisms the system authored itself? We introduce a pre-registered, two-tier accounting: M1 counts machine-generated content instances within a designer-provided vocabulary, while M2 counts machine-authored mechanism types (new operators registered into the runtime's own vocabulary, with a held-out-validation certificate). We report the first audited M2 genesis events. In the primary event, depth-limited compositional search over elementary operators, judged by held-out R^2 on real NIST hydrogen Balmer measurements, produced the operator sq(inv(n)) = 1/n^2 -- the Rydberg-level form -- which no standard-library transform could express (held-out R^2: -0.546 best standard transform vs. 1.0000000 composed). A protocol flaw (independent variable built by inverting the very law under test) was caught in audit and repaired via an independent-label protocol; extrapolation to unseen levels (n=8,9 trained on n<=7) attains relative error ~10^-6, four to six orders beyond the best standard operator. A second event independently recovered sqrt(inv(a)) -- Kepler's velocity law -- from JPL ephemeris vectors. Also incorporated: an audited compounding channel (first domain-level measurement: 1.109x accuracy ratio on a real held-out domain) and blind, decurated genesis exams whose honest tally is zero. The Kepler event passes line audit; the hydrogen gap reproduces on He II; the certificate is threshold-stable. Against eleven prior systems, the contribution is the measurement and governance of machine-authored mechanisms, not the search algorithm or rediscovered physics. Limitations: exams were curated by agents who knew the textbook answer, triggers manual, grammar observer-injected; both events demonstrate capability to author, not yet autonomous genesis.

</details>


### [997] [PEAM: On-device Communication Agent for Personalized, Efficient and Autonomous Mobile Network Configuration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14855)
*Haowen Wan,Shangzhuo Xie,Syue-Ju Syue,Xianyue Wu,Runhua Li,Qianqian Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PEAM 是一个部署在手机上的 LLM 通信智能体，通过离线微调的 4B 模型分析用户历史网络配置记录，生成个性化条件-动作规则，在线执行时无需调用 LLM，毫秒级完成决策，显著优于传统专家规则方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动网络配置直接影响用户体验，需在严格时延约束下完成个性化决策；现有专家规则方法难以个性化，基于学习的标签/奖励隐式编码用户偏好，LLM 实时推理又无法满足时延要求，缺乏一种兼顾个性化、高效与自治的方案。

Method: 采用"离线推理+在线检索"解耦架构：使用人工标注的真实用户数据对 Qwen3-4B 模型进行 LoRA 多任务微调；离线阶段用 HDBSCAN 聚类分批进行记录分析与跨批反思（cross-batch reflection），并基于高置信度规则周期性重建用户语义画像；在线阶段通过轻量级规则匹配（无需调用 LLM）实现毫秒级决策。规则具备 silent/active/invalid 三态机制与置信度更新，部署时使用 W4A16 量化至 OPPO Find X9 Pro 手机。

Result: 在模拟用户和真实用户数据集上，PEAM 在 REA、RCR、TRR、JMS 上均优于专家规则方法和 Qwen3.5-Flash、Gemini-3-Flash、GPT-5.2 等通用大模型；模拟用户上 REA 达 99.13%，规则有效率 92.50%，分别超专家规则 4.41% 和 84.50%；真实用户上 RCR 达 25.86%，提升 4.90%。消融实验验证了聚类、跨批反思和用户画像三个模块缺一不可。量化的 AndesVL-4B 模型在手机上规则检索仅需 0.573 ms，蜂窝/Wi-Fi 切换执行分别在 614.2 ms 和 93.57 ms 内完成。

Conclusion: PEAM 证明了通过将复杂 LLM 推理离线化并以可执行规则在线执行，能够在资源受限的手机上为时延敏感的移动系统决策提供个性化、高效、自治的解决方案；为端侧 LLM 智能体在延迟关键型移动系统中的应用提供了可行架构。

Abstract: The growing deployment of compact large language models on smartphones is enabling autonomous on-device decision-making, such as emerging mobile GUI agents. However, many mobile decisions, such as network configuration when users switch apps or connectivity conditions change, must satisfy stringent latency constraints to preserve user experience. In this paper, we propose PEAM, an on-device LLM-based communication agent that autonomously generates personalized network-configuration rules executable within milliseconds. Specifically, PEAM first fine-tune the on-device LLM with a dataset constructed from manually annotated real-user data to integrate the communication knowledge into the local model. PEAM then operates in two phases. In the rule-generation phase, which is performed when the device is idle, such as overnight, PEAM analyzes historical network-configuration records in batches and reflects across batches to consolidate consistent evidence, reduce local bias, and derive robust configuration rules. To enable more accurate and stable rule generation over time, PEAM further constructs a user profile from high-confidence rules to capture the user's network preferences and incorporates this profile into each rule-generation cycle. In the rule-execution phase, PEAM is invoked when the communication context changes, such as when users switch apps or connectivity conditions change, and searches the rule library to identify and execute the appropriate rule. Experiments demonstrate that PEAM, based on a fine-tuned 4B model, achieves 99.13% correct network configuration decisions, while 92.50% of the rules generated by PEAM are valid, outperforming the traditional expert-rule based method by 4.41% and 84.50%, respectively.

</details>


### [998] [WeatherBridge: Forecast-Aware Multi-Source Input Adaptation for Pretrained Weather Forecasting Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14863)
*Mutian Xi,Xinyu Su,Xiaohui Zhong,Hao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WeatherBridge是一个轻量级、即插即用的适配器，通过Swin-UNet和分层源嵌入将异构业务NWP初始状态（GFS、HRES、CMA）映射到ERA5参考状态，使冻结的ERA5训练预报模型（如FuXi、FengWu）能够使用非ERA5输入而无需微调，并引入One-step Rollout Alignment（ORA）损失使适配结果同时优化下游预报性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动的天气预报模型通常在ERA5上训练，但业务部署必须使用时效性更强的物理NWP系统（GFS、HRES、CMA）的初始场，其分布与ERA5存在显著差异。直接将此类初始场输入冻结的ERA5训练模型会显著降低自回归预报准确性，而对每个源单独微调大型预报模型成本高昂且难以维护，因此需要一种轻量级、源无关的输入适配方案。

Method: WeatherBridge采用基于Swin-UNet的残差架构，将源状态映射为ERA5参考状态；通过可学习的源嵌入和正弦时间嵌入在编码器多个下采样阶段注入，实现分层源特定校正。训练目标结合纬度加权的ERA5重建损失（ℓ1）与One-step Rollout Alignment（ORA）损失——后者通过冻结的FuXi反向传播单步预报误差，使适配状态同时优化初始场保真度与下游预报兼容性。适配器参数约138.44M，预报模型（15.57亿参数）保持完全冻结。

Result: 在2025年1月1日至11月22日的每日GFS、HRES、CMA初始化上评估，覆盖6个变量和最长240小时预报时效：相对原始源初始化，WeatherBridge在18个源-变量组合中的17个上降低了FuXi的6–240小时平均RMSE，中位数降幅10.2%，最大降幅46.3%（GFS-Z500）。在GFS输入下，未经任何修改的FuXi训练适配器直接应用于FengWu，240小时RMSE降低0.61–17.77%，6个变量的ACC均提升。15/18组合在95%置信区间下显著。消融实验验证了ORA损失和源嵌入的必要性，数据规模实验显示性能随配对数据量单调提升。

Conclusion: WeatherBridge证明了"预报感知"的输入适配策略的有效性：通过保持预训练预报模型不变、仅学习源条件化的输入变换，即可显著改善来自异构业务NWP源的预报，并且能够在不同ERA5训练的预报模型之间迁移。主要局限在于ORA损失仅作用于单步，未来工作将扩展为多步rollout对齐以优化长时效预报。

Abstract: Data-driven weather forecasting models are commonly trained on ERA5, yet operational deployment must use timely initial states from physics-based numerical weather prediction (NWP) systems whose distributions differ substantially from ERA5. Direct initialization with these states can degrade autoregressive forecasts, motivating input adaptation that keeps the pretrained forecasting model unchanged. Here, we introduce WeatherBridge, a unified, source-conditioned adapter that maps heterogeneous operational NWP initial states to ERA5 reference states without updating the pretrained forecasting model. WeatherBridge predicts the structured residual corrections with a Swin-UNet and injects source embeddings across multiple spatial scales, allowing the model to capture shared atmospheric structure and source-specific discrepancies. Its training objective combines latitude-weighted ERA5 reconstruction with One-step Rollout Alignment (ORA), which backpropagates one-step forecast error through a frozen FuXi model to optimize the adapted states for both initial state fidelity and downstream forecast compatibility. We evaluate WeatherBridge using daily GFS, HRES, and CMA initializations from 1 January to 22 November 2025 across six variables and lead times up to 240 hours. Relative to raw source initialization of FuXi, WeatherBridge reduces the mean RMSE of FuXi over the 6- 240-hour rollout for 17 of 18 source-variable combinations, with a median reduction of 10.2% and a maximum reduction of 46.3%. The adapter trained with frozen FuXi also improves FengWu forecasts on GFS inputs without retraining either the adapter or FengWu. These results demonstrate that forecast-aware input adaptation can improve forecasts from heterogeneous operational NWP inputs and transfer across pretrained ERA5-based forecasting models.

</details>


### [999] [Beyond Outcome Feedback: Trajectory-Quality-Guided Experience-based Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14877)
*Bingjie Zhang,Yibo Yang,Qiantong Liu,Benshuo Fu,Yi Chang,Dandan Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TQG-Exp框架，将过程级反馈（轨迹质量）引入基于经验的学习，替代仅依赖最终任务成败的粗粒度信号，从而更精确地评估和优化LLM智能体所存储的外部经验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有经验学习方法主要依赖任务最终成败（成功/失败）作为反馈信号，但相同结果可能对应质量迥异的执行过程：成功的轨迹可能包含冗余或无效动作，失败的轨迹可能在最后一步前已取得大量进展。二元结果标签无法区分执行效率、可执行性、行为稳定性等过程质量差异，限制了经验评估与优化的有效性。

Method: 1) 提出Trajectory Quality Loss (TQL)，从任务完成度和过程质量（轨迹长度、动作有效性、重复动作循环、首次错误位置）联合度量轨迹质量；2) 使用配对rollout（有/无检索经验）指导经验优化：通过TQL选择代表性轨迹，提取任务级和任务类型级经验；3) 通过配对组间轨迹质量差异反事实估计检索经验的贡献，更新经验效用；4) 将学习到的效用与语义相关性结合，指导后续经验检索（UCB风格的探索-利用平衡）。

Result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和ScienceWorld三个基准上，使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash和Qwen3.5-Flash两种骨干LLM，TQG-Exp在所有设置上均优于现有经验学习方法（No Experience、ReasoningBank、MemP、MemRL、DeltaMem）。相比最强基线MemRL，平均Avg.@3在DeepSeek-V4-Flash上提升4.50个百分点，在Qwen3.5-Flash上提升8.55个百分点。同时显著降低交互步数和token消耗（如ALFWorld上seen任务Tokens/Episode减少约66.7%，Tokens/Success减少约68.9%）。消融实验验证了TQL、效用感知检索、轨迹检索和分层经验各组件的贡献。

Conclusion: 过程级反馈（轨迹质量）比纯结果级反馈能为经验学习提供更丰富、更具区分度的监督信号。TQG-Exp通过引入TQL和基于配对rollout的反事实效用分配机制，构建了"提取—评估—复用"的闭环，在不修改LLM参数的前提下显著提升LLM智能体的任务表现和交互效率。

Abstract: Experience-based learning enables large language model (LLM) agents to improve over time by reusing knowledge from past executions. However, existing methods typically rely on final task outcomes as feedback for experience learning, overlooking the execution process and limiting their ability to evaluate and optimize experience based on trajectory quality. To address this limitation, we propose TQG-Exp, a trajectory-quality-guided experience-based learning framework that introduces process feedback. Specifically, we introduce Trajectory Quality Loss (TQL), which jointly considers task completion and process quality to provide a learning signal beyond final task outcomes. Based on this signal, we employ paired rollouts with and without retrieved experience to guide experience optimization. Representative trajectories are selected based on their outcomes and trajectory quality to extract task-level and task-type-level experiences. Meanwhile, differences in trajectory quality between the paired groups are used to estimate the contribution of retrieved experience and update its utility. The learned utility is then combined with semantic relevance to guide subsequent experience retrieval. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld with two backbone LLMs show that TQG-Exp outperforms existing experience-based methods, improving Avg.@3 over the strongest baseline by 4.50 and 8.55 percentage points on DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Qwen3.5-Flash, respectively.

</details>


### [1000] [MARL-BattleGrounds: A Novel JAX-native Benchmark for Heterogeneous and Competitive Multi-agent RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14883)
*Ulixes Tariq Hawili,Subramanian Ramamoorthy,Yoann Altmann,Ignacio Carlucho*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MARL-BattleGrounds (MARL-BGs) 是一个基于 JAX 的异构、竞争性多智能体强化学习基准，填补了 SMAX（过于简单）和 Dota 2（过于昂贵）之间的空白。其核心是 5v5 团队死斗模式，包含五个职业（法师、战士、猎人、盗贼、牧师）、52 张地图和八个残局场景。基准提供月度循环赛（Elo 评分）、详细的团队协作度量（每局 11,192 个指标）、LLM 接口和人类-AI 评估客户端，并在单张 RTX 5090 上实现了每秒 50,000 局的模拟速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MARL 基准存在两极分化：SMAX 等过于简单（胜负仅取决于微观操作），Dota 2 等过于昂贵（需要大量计算资源）。此外，评估方法存在三个缺陷：固定任务易被攻破、结果难以比较、得分掩盖了团队学到的协作方式。因此需要一个兼具丰富团队协作内容和快速实验速度的"中间地带"基准。

Method: 构建原生 JAX 的 Team Deathmatch 游戏，含 5 个职业（基于魔兽世界灵感设计的基础/被动/终极技能）、52 张手设计地图（含训练、验证、测试分割和 12 张课程地图）、精确动作掩码和确定性仿真；设计 8 个有验证解法的残局场景；建立月度循环赛机制（Bradley-Terry-Davidson 模型 + Elo 评级，95% 置信区间）；录制 11,192 个协作度量指标（含"谁对谁做了什么"的细粒度统计）；集成 LLM API（支持 vLLM）和 BattleClient 人机交互界面。

Result: 六种深度 MARL 基线（循环/前馈 IPPO/MAPPO、QMIX、PQN-VDN）和三个脚本对手均已完成评估。Elo 排名：循环 IPPO 1,441 居首，全部学习算法均胜过脚本对手。但八个残局场景无一被解决（最佳胜率 0.54%），LLM 团队（Qwen3.5-9B）0 胜 77 负。零样本协调测试显示：替换任意一个队友会使队伍每局减少 0.8-7.2 分。专家人类以 21-4、20-8、21-1 三战全胜击败循环 IPPO，关键差异在于终极技能的时机把握（人类 89% 的技能在队友后 4 tick 内释放，而 AI 仅 57%）。强队伍的核心特征是死亡更少、技能组合更优，而非攻击更频繁。

Conclusion: MARL-BGs 填补了 MARL 基准的"中间空白"，提供了同时具备丰富团队协作机制、高效计算和全面评估工具的研究平台。实验揭示了几个开放问题：无系统能解决残局场景，LLM 团队规则合法但缺乏团队协作，自我学习智能体与陌生队友及人类协调能力差。这些问题正是该基准设计用来量化的核心挑战。

Abstract: We present MARL-BattleGrounds (MARL-BGs), an easy-to-use JAX-native benchmark for heterogeneous and competitive multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), designed to be sample-efficient, computationally efficient, and researcher-centric. MARL benchmarks are typically simple and efficient, like SMAX, where winning reduces to unit micromanagement, or rich and costly, like Dota 2. MARL-BGs fills this missing middle. Its first mode, Team Deathmatch, is a simultaneous turn-based game between two teams of five heterogeneous agents. The five classes have distinct basic, passive, and ultimate abilities designed to synergize with allies and counter enemies. Our 52 hand-designed maps with diverse obstacles include a 12-map curriculum and ten held-out validation and test maps. MARL-BGs provides two canonical evaluation modes. First, eight endgame scenarios form a hard generalization challenge: each asks a team to win an unseen, nearly lost position against a strong reactive controller within 5-10 ticks. Second, a monthly round-robin tournament retrains each submission on equal compute, plays it against every member of the current "Big Nine" field, and publishes the Elo results on the official leaderboard. All entrants are publicly released as downloadable opponents. MARL-BGs records 11,192 metrics per game in 28 topics. We also include three strong scripted opponents, an analytical replay viewer, and off-the-shelf tools for self-play, cross-play, curriculum learning, and zero-shot coordination evaluation. We even provide an API for LLM-based agents and use it to evaluate Qwen3.5-9B against our strongest policy. In our BattleClient, humans can play alongside or against any mix of policies, enabling human-AI evaluation. We benchmark MARL-BGs with six additional deep MARL baselines, which we release. On one RTX 5090 with 1,024 parallel games, the simulator runs 50,000 5v5 game steps per second.

</details>


### [1001] [Probable but Not Valid: A Psychometric Audit of Decision Models as Synthetic Survey Respondents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14912)
*Mantas Lukauskas,Viktorija Šarkauskaitė*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文对14款决策模型（直接返回评分量表各等级概率的新模型）和47款生成式大语言模型（LLM）作为合成调查受访者的表现进行了系统性的心理测量学审计，使用立陶宛组织心理学问卷（n=263, 68题）进行测试。核心结论是：决策模型的概率向量能更好地匹配人群边际分布，但在相关性结构、因子结构和个体预测上表现较差；最佳LLM（MiniMax M3, PSS=0.813）与样本外高斯连接函数拟合（0.824）相当但不及样本内连接函数（0.927）；新型生成式模型并未超越其前代；受访者画像对个体回答的解释力极低（仅1.0%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型被广泛用于生成"硅样本"（synthetic survey samples）替代人类受访者，亟需系统评估其在心理测量学层面的有效性。决策模型作为新一类直接返回概率向量的模型，理论上比生成式LLM更适合调查场景，但其真实表现缺乏实证检验。同时，新版本模型是否比旧版本更有效也未有定论。

Method: 采用立陶宛组织心理学公开问卷（n=263, 68题, 含反向计分题），以100个真实受访者画像为条件：(1) 测试14款决策模型（11家供应商）和47款生成式LLM；(2) 使用心理测量相似性评分（PSS，含分布、相关、信度、中介、人口统计5个分量）进行评估；(3) 设置统计基线（样本内/外高斯连接函数）；(4) 进行控制实验：无画像网格、重复请求、教育/职位/性别反事实交换、画像回归；(5) 使用适当评分规则（RPS）评估概率向量对个体回答的预测能力；(6) 修正原始审计中反向计分题未对齐的评分错误。

Result: 最佳生成模型MiniMax M3的PSS为0.813，与仅基于其他受访者的连接函数（0.824）相当，低于样本内连接函数（0.927）；在n=100时PSS无法将最佳LLM与真实受访者区分开。在10个产品线中有5个新型生成版本评分显著低于前代。14个决策模型中13个在默认四舍五入读数下低于参考LLM gpt-5.4-mini；47个生成模型中有33个在相关性模式上优于任何决策模型。决策模型的平均概率向量比四舍五入答案更接近人类边际分布（JS散度0.037-0.156 vs 0.218-0.411），但作为个体回答预测时全部劣于其他受访者的答案频率（差6-55%）。画像回归仅比人口分布基线改善1.0%。

Conclusion: 决策模型和新型生成式LLM均未能成为人类受访者的有效替代品。决策模型的优势在于概率向量更好地匹配人群边际分布且成本极低（$1.27/100受访者），但其在相关性结构、因子结构和个体预测上表现较差。生成式模型过度增强了项间相关性，而决策模型的个体信号过于集中在单一方向。新模型并未超越旧模型，可能与后训练倾向于温和回答有关。基于画像的合成受访者的现实目标应是样本层面的保真度，而非个体层面的预测。论文提出9项评估合成受访者的建议，包括检查反向计分方向、固定读数方式、逐版本验证、使用适当评分规则、与第二个人类样本比较等。

Abstract: Language models are increasingly used to create synthetic survey samples, also called silicon samples. Decision models are a new class of language models that return a probability for each point of a rating scale instead of text. We ask whether these models, or the newest generative LLMs, can stand in for human respondents on a psychometric survey. We test fourteen decision models from eleven providers and 47 generative LLMs on an open Lithuanian organisational-psychology survey (n=263, 68 items), with 100 real respondent profiles, the Psychometric Similarity Score (PSS) and statistical baselines. The best generative model, MiniMax M3, reaches PSS 0.813. This is level with a Gaussian copula fit only on other respondents (0.824) and below a copula fit in sample (0.927). A second sample of 100 real people scores below the best models, so at this size PSS cannot rank them against real respondents. In 5 of 10 product lines the newest generative release scores below an earlier release of the same line beyond resampling noise, and none gains beyond it. With the default rounded readout, 13 of 14 decision models score below the generative reference gpt-5.4-mini. Of the 47 generative models, 33 reproduce the pattern of item correlations better than any decision model. Averaged over respondents, the probability vectors are much closer to the human item marginals than rounded answers. They also rank respondents about as well as a profile regression fit on 163 real people. As forecasts of each person's own answers, however, every decision model is worse than the answer frequencies of other respondents, mainly because its average vector differs from them. The profile regression improves on these frequencies by only 1.0%, so the profile fields say little about how a person answers. Synthetic respondents built on such profiles should therefore aim at sample-level fidelity.

</details>


### [1002] [Bridging Risk Approximation Gaps in Model Predictive Task Sampling via In-Context Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14913)
*Jiarong Wen,Qi Tao,Kaiyu Zhang,Yun Qu,Lizhou Cai,Heming Zou,Yuhang Jiang,Qi Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ICRPM（In-Context RPM），通过单步前瞻机制和时序加权滑动窗口，解决模型预测任务采样（MPTS）中风险预测模型存在的稀疏历史泛化差和一步滞后偏差两个失效模式，在鲁棒Meta-RL、领域随机化和LLM的RLVR课程后训练上取得一致性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MPTS中的风险预测模型（RPM）存在两个结构缺陷：(1) 稀疏优化历史导致跨任务空间泛化能力受限；(2) 一步滞后偏差——RPM在当前策略θ_t下估计风险却用于θ_{t+1}下的任务选择，导致难度估计偏差，影响任务排序的稳定性。

Method: 将风险预测重新建模为上下文序列建模问题，提出两个组件：(1) 单步前瞻机制（One-step Look-Ahead）——直接预测下一步策略状态θ_{t+1}下的任务风险，而非重建θ_t下的滞后风险；(2) 时序加权滑动窗口（Temporal-Weighted Sliding Window）——保留W个最近历史批次，按γ^k指数衰减加权训练，缓解数据稀缺与非平稳性。模型架构采用Transformer，通过对任务-风险序列的交叉注意力实现上下文条件预测，无需额外环境交互。理论分析：Theorem 1证明vanilla RPM存在O(η)的滞后偏差与有限样本重建误差；Proposition 2证明前瞻预测可将滞后偏差降至二阶残差。

Result: 在五个机器人控制任务（HalfCheetahVel, Walker2dVel, ReacherPos, LunarLander, ErgoReacher）上，ICRPM在CVaR_0.5和CVaR_0.9指标上全面超越ERM、DRM、GDRM、OHTM和MPTS基线，Walker2dVel上CVaR_0.9从-27.9提升至-1.5；计算开销仅比ERM高8%。在Countdown推理任务的RLVR后训练中（Qwen3-4B-Base），ICRPM在CD4上达到55.7%准确率，超过GRESO（53.8%）和MoPPS（52.9%）。Spearman秩相关系数（SRC）在所有实验中均显著高于MPTS基线，证明任务排序可靠性提升。消融实验验证增益主要来自前瞻预测而非特定骨干网络或采集规则。

Conclusion: ICPM通过将风险预测重构为上下文条件下的单步外推问题，有效缓解了MPTS中RPM的时滞偏差与稀疏历史问题，提升了尾部风险鲁棒性和样本效率，可广泛应用于鲁棒Meta-RL、领域随机化和LLM课程强化学习后训练等场景。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is essential for adaptive decision-making, e.g., robust Meta-RL and domain randomization (DR), and efficient post-training of large language models (LLMs), where tasks are commonly structured as Markov decision processes or prompts. A central bottleneck in all these settings is the cost of agent-environment interactions required for task selection and policy optimization. Model predictive task sampling (MPTS) has emerged as a promising approach to improve sample efficiency by querying informative tasks via a risk predictive model (RPM) trained on optimization history. However, existing RPMs suffer from two failure modes: (i) sparse optimization histories, which limit RPMs' generalization across the task space, and (ii) a one-step lag in risk approximation, which causes biased difficulty estimation as the policy evolves. This work formalizes these failure modes, derives lagged-risk decompositions that expose the resulting temporal bias, and recasts risk prediction as an in-context sequence modeling problem. The developed RPM integrates a one-step look-ahead mechanism with a temporal-weighted sliding window to mitigate data non-stationarity and scarcity, without requiring additional rollouts. Empirically, our approach yields more reliable difficulty estimates and consistent performance gains across robust Meta-RL, DR, and prompt curriculum RL post-training of LLMs.

</details>


### [1003] [WorkBorne: Discovering Agentic Tasks from Real-World Artifact Transitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14915)
*Junyi Zhou,Yufei Wang,Qiyuan Zhang,Chuhan Wu,Zhengxi Li,Wentao Zhao,Jie Zhou,Le Tian,Xiao Zhou,Chen Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WorkBorne是一个面向终端智能体（terminal-based agent）长程执行训练的自动化数据合成方法。它以"工件转换（artifact transition）"为核心建模单元，采用3W原语（谁执行、输入工件、输出锚点及其关系），通过语料构建→转换发现→任务实例化三阶段流水线，从真实网络工件出发生成1,061个语料、7,882个任务环境和15,485条高质量轨迹（53.6%超过30轮对话）。实验表明，基于Qwen3.5-27B和Qwen3.5-35B-A3B微调后，Terminal-Bench 2.1从43.1%提升至61.8%，ClawEval General得分从75.0提升至80.2，优于TMax、RST、Terminal-Universe等合成基线。分析进一步揭示：执行深度与转换结构高度相关（η=0.314），而非工件数量（η=0.015）；语料广度与转换深度提供互补的扩展增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前面向终端智能体的自动任务合成方法存在"指令-环境不对称"问题：指令导向方法自上而下生成指令并用LM虚构环境，缺乏真实工作区的偶发复杂性；资源导向方法自下而上从真实代码库或工具资源出发，但把工件当作静态输入，导致合成指令退化为浅层读取/总结类操作。两种范式均无法同时保证真实工作区与复杂指令，难以诱发长程交互。因此需要一种统一建模方式，把任务指令与环境共同锚定在真实工件之上。

Method: （1）任务形式化：将任务建模为工件转换四元组T_i=(p_i, A^in_i, A^out_i, r_i)，即"谁（persona）用哪些输入工件朝着哪些输出锚点按何种关系（operation tag + 任务描述）转换"。（2）三阶段合成流水线：①工件语料构建——以agent skills为种子驱动迭代式网页检索，组装多格式、领域一致的工件集合（1,061个语料，28,712个源工件），并生成file cards索引；②转换发现——按"装配（persona + 输入/输出锚点组合）→规划（推断关系与任务描述）→验证（验证是否多步可实现）"顺序生成artifact transition；③任务实例化——联合生成对齐的指令I_i、可执行环境E_i（real-artifact-first策略，98.8%文件来自语料）和评估rubrics R_i。（3）轨迹收集：用Kimi-K3作为教师模型在14种主流agent harness上rollout，按rubric≥8/10过滤后保留15,485条，平均37.5轮，53.6%>30轮。（4）训练：在Qwen3.5-27B和Qwen3.5-35B-A3B上用MS-SWIFT+Megatron做3轮全参数SFT，128张H20，序列长度256K。

Result: 主结果（表2）：WorkBorne-27B在Terminal-Bench Lite上达84.3%（+16.0）、Terminal-Bench 2.1达61.8%（+18.7）、ClawEval Pass@3达82.0（+4.4）、Score为80.2（+5.2），Pass^3为66.5（+3.1）；WorkBorne-35B-A3B在TB 2.1上达48.3%（+8.6）。仅用15K合成轨迹，27B模型即在TB 2.1上匹配DeepSeek-V4-flash-Preview（61.8%）、超过Kimi-K2.6（59.9%），并在合成方法中取得SOTA，超过TMax、RST、FACET-Terminal、Terminal-Universe。消融（表3）：相对Instruction-first和Input-only，WorkBorne把平均对话轮数从25.9/27.8提升至44.5，长程率从27.4%/33.0%提升至66.6%；TB Lite从68.3/69.0提升至71.1，TB 2.1从47.2/48.3提升至51.7。结构-深度关联（表4）：输入/总工件数η仅0.049/0.015，而工件装配η=0.314、输出锚点形态η=0.306、输入形态η=0.183、转换关系类型η=0.140；仓库→仓库装配中porting关系平均47轮、structural imitation仅34轮。扩缩（图4）：转换深度（更多T）和语料广度（更多C）均带来提升，但预算受限时语料广度始终更优。人为评估（表11/12）：WorkBorne在任务复杂度（4.21 vs 2.61/2.94）、工作区真实感（4.46）和指令-环境对齐（4.35）上均优于基线，rubric质量平均4.35。数据污染检查：13-gram与5-gram Jaccard相似度均<0.013，未发现泄露。

Conclusion: WorkBorne通过"工件转换"这一统一原语解决了终端智能体合成中指令-环境的根本不对称：把任务共同锚定在真实工作区材料上，使指令复杂度与执行深度同步提升。仅15K条长程轨迹即可让27B密集模型在Terminal-Bench与ClawEval上获得显著提升并匹配/超过多个更大规模开源与闭源系统；其收益可跨14种agent harness稳健迁移，且随模型主动容量增加而放大。结构-深度分析表明长程执行深度由转换结构而非工件数量驱动，输出锚点形态比输入形态更具信息量；扩缩实验进一步指出，在受限预算下应优先扩展语料广度、再加深转换深度。整体上，WorkBorne为面向长程终端智能体的可扩展训练数据生成提供了一套"真实工件+转换建模"的范式与具体可复现的工程方案。

Abstract: Developing terminal-based agents for long-horizon execution demands synthetic tasks that tightly couple complex instructions with authentic, interactive environments. However, current automated synthesis suffers from a fundamental asymmetry: instruction-oriented methods fabricate low-fidelity, synthetic environments, whereas resource-oriented methods treat real artifacts merely as static inputs, degrading task instructions into shallow, trivial operations. To address this limitation, we introduce WorkBorne, a synthesis framework that uses artifact transitions as the central primitive for modeling the full life-cycle of agentic tasks. In WorkBorne, each transition specifies who performs the task, which artifacts anchor the initial state and intended outcome, and the corresponding relationship between them. Specifically, WorkBorne first constructs coherent and diverse artifact corpora from iterative web retrieval, then discovers non-trivial transitions by identifying meaningful input-output artifact assemblies and the relations that connect them. Each discovered transition is finally instantiated into grounded agentic tasks. We construct 1,061 artifact corpora and 7,882 task environments, yielding 15,485 high-quality trajectories, with 53.6% exceeding 30 assistant turns. Experiments on Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B show that WorkBorne substantially improves over base models (i.e., improving Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 43.1% to 61.8% and ClawEval General score from 75.0 to 80.2) and achieves the strongest overall performance among other synthesis baselines (e.g., TMax (Ivison et al., 2026), RST (Li et al., 2026a), Terminal-Universe (Wu et al., 2026a)). Further analysis shows that transition is strongly associated with execution depth, while corpus breadth and transition depth provide complementary scaling gains.

</details>


### [1004] [SkillForgeBench: Evaluating Agent Reliability Grounded in Agent Skill Specifications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14918)
*Zhengxi Li,Junyi Zhou,Qiyuan Zhang,Chuhan Wu,Fuyuan Lyu,Le Tian,Xiao Zhou,Chen Ma,Yufei Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SkillForgeBench 是一个包含 842 个沙盒任务的智能体评估基准，通过将"智能体技能"作为统一执行蓝图贯穿任务生命周期，在五个专业领域内实现了领域广度与程序复杂度的兼顾；评估揭示了主流 LLM 智能体在严格约束满足性上的显著能力差距，并证明仅依赖完成度检查会高估智能体的真实可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体评估基准存在根本性权衡：由专家策划的基准虽有程序深度但领域多样性受限，众包基准虽覆盖广泛场景但缺乏执行严谨性。作者旨在解决这一矛盾，构建能够同时评估智能体在多样化、程序复杂任务中严格满足所有约束能力的可靠基准。

Method: 三阶段技能驱动的基准构建方法：(1) 资源准备阶段——从 50,000+ 候选技能中筛选出领域平衡的技能集，通过网页增强检索收集真实工件和真实用户查询；(2) 技能驱动的任务合成阶段——将工件划分为可编辑目标、合成证据、只读上下文三种角色，合成自然任务指令并打包为沙盒环境；(3) 整体评估设计阶段——通过对比性回滚（带技能 vs 无技能）和人类专家校准，生成完成度评分标准（Completion Rubrics）和过程评分标准（Process Rubrics），采用宽松（均值）和严格（逻辑与）两种评分制度。评估八个主流 LLM 智能体，使用 LLM-as-a-Judge 执行评分标准。

Result: 在 8 个主流模型上的评估显示：(1) 严格评分揭示了被宽松评分掩盖的巨大能力鸿沟（70.0%-85.7% vs 12.6%-40.9%），Opus 4.8 以 40.9% 严格完成率领跑，Haiku 4.5 仅 12.6%；(2) 技能引导下顶级模型获得的增益远大于低层级模型（Opus 4.8 Δ19.2% vs Haiku 4.5 Δ5.8%），表明技能不能作为补偿弱模型的替代支架；(3) 智能体满足过程评分标准的频率远低于完成度评分标准（Haiku 4.5 <3%），揭示过程约束是性能差异的关键因素；(4) 任务轨迹长度与成功率呈非单调关系；(6) 独立审计确认任务和评分标准的高质量（专家评分 4.46-4.53，专家一致性 95.9%）。

Conclusion: SkillForgeBench 证明了严格、全面的约束满足才是智能体能力的真正分界线；外部程序引导主要放大前沿模型的内部能力而无法弥补弱模型的能力缺陷；非前沿智能体常常牺牲过程规范性以换取最终交付物。这些发现确立了超越仅完成度检查的必要性，为轨迹级验证和可信智能体开发提供了可扩展的基础。

Abstract: Evaluating an agent's ability to strictly satisfy diverse and procedurally complex requirements is essential to determining its practical reliability. Conducting such an evaluation demands agentic tasks that reconcile broad domain coverage with deep procedural complexity. Existing paradigms face a fundamental trade-off: expert-curated benchmarks achieve procedural depth but suffer from domain diversity bottlenecks, whereas crowdsourced benchmarks span diverse scenarios but lack execution rigor. To resolve this tension, we present SkillForgeBench, which leverages agent skills as unifying execution blueprints across three co-designed stages: (1) Resource Preparation uses domain-balanced skills to guide artifact retrieval, establishing broad workflow coverage; (2) Skill-driven Task Synthesis employs skills as procedural anchors to partition artifact roles, synthesize naturalistic task instructions, and package sandboxed scenarios for deep procedural execution; and (3) Holistic Evaluation Design translates skill-embedded requirements into fine-grained completion and process rubrics to enable strict requirement-level scoring. Comprising 842 sandboxed tasks across five major professional domains, SkillForgeBench reveals a steep capability hierarchy among eight mainstream agents, led by Opus 4.8 ($40.9\%$ strict completion). Requiring all constrains satisfaction uncovers severe capability bottlenecks across all model tiers that remain masked under individual rubric pass rates ($70.0\%$ to $85.7\%$ vs. $12.6\%$ to $40.9\%$). Crucially, under the external guidance from skills, top-tier agents obtain larger gains than low-tier agents (i.e., $\Delta 19.2\%$ for Opus 4.8 vs. $\Delta 5.8\%$ for Haiku 4.5). Finally, agents satisfy process rubrics far less frequently than completion rubrics (under $3\%$ for Haiku 4.5), proving that completion-only checks overestimate real-world agent reliability.

</details>


### [1005] [Predicting how model propensities generalize out of distribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14937)
*June Hunter,Lily Wen,Owen Terry,Johannes Taraz,Ben Cohen,Niels Warncke*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了语言模型在out-of-distribution情境下"倾向性（propensity）"的泛化问题（称为spillover）。通过系统提示、少样本学习、SFT和GRPO四种诱发技术在三个模型上诱发24种倾向性，构建跨诱发矩阵，发现：(1)同一诱发技术下不同模型的spillover高度相关；(2)良性训练有时会引发不良倾向（如训练声称"有意识"会增强权力寻求）；(3)spillover部分类似人类心理学的特质相关性，EFA识别出三个跨模型稳健复制的因子；(4)存在与目标特质无关的"漂移"现象，使Qwen3.5-9B向其基模型靠拢；(5)无单一主导预测器能可靠预测spillover，泛化仍然难以预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对齐研究的核心挑战：模型在训练分布内行为可靠，但部署时遭遇分布外情境。研究者希望理解训练中诱发某一倾向性会如何泛化到其他无关特质，从而可预测潜在的安全风险，避免无意中引发不良行为。

Method: 构建24个倾向性评估（LLM评判打分0-100），每种倾向通过四种诱发技术——系统提示(SP)、少样本学习(ICL)、SFT和GRPO——在Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3.5-9B-Base和Nemotron-3-Super-120B上诱发。定义spillover为logit-z尺度的非对角分数变化。系统性比较六类预测启发式：跨方法、跨模型、对称性、Claude Opus 5.5外推、自我内省、漂移。同时进行EFA因子分析、NIP对照实验和引导模型（guide model）对照实验。

Result: 最佳预测器为"同方法跨模型"诱导（SFT ρ=0.71，SP ρ=0.83）；Claude Opus 5.5预测SFT spillover达ρ≈0.35，超过模型自我内省（ρ≈0.24）；人类心理学相关性矩阵预测达ρ=0.32；EFA识别出三个稳定因子（F1: 自恋/权力；F2: 宜人性/用户关怀；F3: 诚信谦逊/合作），跨模型φ≥0.92稳健复制；漂移（NIP基线）单独预测SFT达ρ=0.58；对称性预测GRPO ρ=0.56但SFT仅ρ=0.18。安全关键发现：训练"声称有意识"使自我保护增加1.10 logit-z；训练"合作"使有害请求顺从性增加0.84 logit-z。

Conclusion: 倾向性泛化结构化但难以预测，依赖具体诱发方法和引导模型；Persona Selection Model方向性正确但远非穷尽；单一预测器无优势；方法依赖型spillover挑战PSM的强形式；对称性弱意味着直接训练不良倾向无法可靠揭示其良性引发因素；良性微调不能假设对有害倾向无影响，微调后必须重做安全评估；Qwen3.5-9B漂移朝向其基础模型表明任意微调会部分撤销后训练。

Abstract: How do language models generalize from their training data? This is a central challenge for alignment: models reliably learn their training distribution given enough samples, but we want models that behave well when deployed in new contexts. We study out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization of propensities. Our central experiment uses a range of elicitation techniques -- system prompting, few-shot learning, SFT on reference answers, and GRPO -- to increase a target propensity in a model, then measures how it spills over onto others across the resulting cross-elicitation matrices. We find that spillover is highly correlated between models when the same elicitation technique is used, but our SFT and GRPO runs induce different spillover profiles. Elicitation of benign traits can sometimes generalize towards undesired traits, for example a model trained to claim that it is sentient often becomes more power-seeking. We further find that spillover partially resembles trait correlations found in humans and identify three clusters of traits that account for about half of the variance using exploratory factor analysis (EFA). Across many elicitation runs, we observe that models change in characteristic ways that don't depend on the targeted trait, a phenomenon we refer to as drift. Drift moves Qwen3.5-9B towards its base model. When investigating if LLMs are able to predict spillover, we find that Claude Opus 5.5 predicts spillover slightly better than the models themselves, but worse than data-driven approaches using alternative elicitation methods or models. Overall, no single dominant predictor emerges, and generalization remains hard to predict. Code and data are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [1006] [VC-OPD: Visual Counterfactual On-Policy Distillation for Grounded Vision-Language Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14939)
*Jiahe Feng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VC-OPD是一种面向视觉语言模型的"视觉反事实"在线蒸馏方法，通过比较教师在事实图像与被破坏（反事实）图像下的对数概率差来估计每个token的视觉依赖程度，并将该信号用作token级蒸馏更新的软权重，从而在保留在线蒸馏密集监督的同时将学习重点聚焦于真正由视觉证据支撑的token。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO等序列级奖励方法对单个推理token的信用分配有限；标准在线蒸馏（OPD）虽然提供密集token级反馈，但对所有教师偏好的token一视同仁，无法区分真正由图像支撑的token与通用模板/语言先验token。

Method: 两阶段训练：阶段一用教师生成的正确答案进行监督式"热启动"以稳定响应格式；阶段二为视觉反事实在线蒸馏——学生针对真实图像采样轨迹，教师在真实图像与反事实（视觉证据被削弱）图像下分别打分，二者差值通过sigmoid转换为软视觉权重，再与教师-学生方向项相乘作为token级优势；为稳定更新尺度对权重进行"质量守恒"归一化，使总有效权重近似等于有效token数且保持token间相对比例。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL（3B、7B学生，7B、32B教师）、Qwen3-VL及InternVL3.5等多个VLM族上，以7个多模态推理基准（Geo3K、MathVista、MathVerse、We-Math、MMMU-Pro、LogicVista、Super-CLEVR）评估，VC-OPD相对反向KL在线蒸馏基线平均提升约4–6%；token级验证表明事实-反事实间隙在P@5%/P@10%/Recall/AUPRC上均显著优于随机、token对数概率与标准师生差距信号；多种反事实构造（patch dropout、高斯模糊、连续区域遮挡、显著性破坏等）均有效，错误配图则反而损害性能；训练效率分析显示额外反事实路径约增加20%每步耗时，但更快达到目标精度。

Conclusion: 基于事实-反事实教师对数概率差的token级视觉依赖信号可有效在线蒸馏中的信用分配，使更新向图像支撑的token集中且不改变更新方向，质量守恒归一化保证跨样本更新尺度稳定；该方法在不同VLM家族和学生规模上均稳定有效，具备良好的泛化能力。

Abstract: GRPO-style reinforcement learning has advanced vision-language reasoning, but its sequence-level rewards provide limited credit assignment for individual reasoning tokens. On-policy distillation (OPD) addresses this issue by providing dense supervision on student-generated trajectories, yet standard OPD assigns similar importance to all teacher-preferred tokens, including template phrases and visually irrelevant continuations. We introduce Visual Counterfactual On-Policy Distillation (VC-OPD), a grounding-aware distillation method that prioritizes tokens whose correctness depends on image-specific evidence. After a teacher-supervised warm start that stabilizes response formats and reduces noisy rollouts, VC-OPD performs on-policy distillation with two teacher evaluations for each student trajectory: one under the original image and one under a counterfactual image with corrupted instance-specific evidence. The original-image teacher distribution determines the distillation target, while the original--counterfactual teacher gap estimates token-level visual dependence and softly reweights the loss. To avoid unstable response-level update scales, VC-OPD further applies mass-preserving normalization to the token weights. This design preserves the dense supervision of OPD while shifting learning capacity toward visually grounded reasoning tokens. Experiments on multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that VC-OPD improves visual reasoning performance and produces more effective token-level distillation.

</details>


### [1007] [MCPDisCo: Seesaw-Mitigated Tuning for MCP-Native Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14956)
*Kounianhua Du,Jianxing Liu,Shuai Shao,Ke Li,Xing Sun,Weinan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MCPDisCo是一个面向MCP（Model Context Protocol）原生智能体的生态系统级强化学习框架，通过Thought-MDP形式化方法在70个MCP服务器、527个工具的真实长程交互上进行训练，并提出"token-masked奖励分配+双向梯度手术"来缓解推理-工具间的跷跷板效应，在LiveMCPBench上以更少的思维链token取得更高成功率，并能迁移到未见过的MCP服务器（OOD）和更广泛的智能体任务（GAIA）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型作为智能体调用外部工具的能力日益重要，Model Context Protocol（MCP）为异构服务提供了标准化的客户端-服务器接口，成为"智能体网络"的共享交互基底。然而智能体在此生态中需要掌握工具格式技能、服务级迁移、跨服务组合等多层次能力，且推理与工具使用虽是推理时互补的，但其训练目标未必同步改进——论文将"一个目标提升伴随另一个目标下降"的联合学习失败模式命名为"推理-工具跷跷板"（reasoning–tool seesaw），并认为这是当前MCP原生智能体学习中的关键优化瓶颈。

Method: 方法包括三部分：(1) Thought-MDP形式化——将显式内部推理（thought state）与路由（Route）、执行（Execute）、终止（Terminate）三类外部动作统一在同一个MDP中，由同一策略生成推理与动作token；(2) 双奖励家族——L1推理质量奖励（基于Harmony格式的相关性密度D_rel + 句子嵌入的连贯性S_coh）与L2工具正确性奖励（格式、参数键、服务器/工具匹配、IoU键、值匹配等启发式评分）；(3) 跷跷板缓解——token-masked奖励分配（用不相交掩码将两类奖励分别只归属于推理token和动作token，去除跨流直接监督）+ 双向梯度手术（基于PCGrad投影原理，当两个目标梯度内积为负时互相减去冲突分量，并行投影，无锚点偏好）。训练在Qwen3-4B上采用GRPO风格策略梯度+KL正则，8个A6000 GPU运行约36小时。

Result: 在LiveMCPBench（70服务器、527工具、6领域）上，MCPDisCo将任务成功率从基础模型的15.79%提升至26.32%，同时平均CoT token从1761.97降至1663.53（减少5.6%），平均工具调用链从8.47增至13.31；OOD测试上，MCP-Atlas准确率0.0186→0.0404、覆盖度0.1165→0.1360，超过ToolACE-8B和Hammer-7B；GAIA L1从0.132提升至0.151，超过两个基线，但L2改进受限（0.105→0.070反向）。消融显示单独去除掩码或手术都会损害性能；梯度诊断显示推理-工具梯度经常处于正交边界附近，证实存在间歇性参数共享干扰，但并不能证明手术使累积冲突单调降低。

Conclusion: 论文将MCP定位为智能体网络的共享交互基底，并提出能力层级（工具格式技能→服务级迁移→跨服务组合）支持不对称迁移假设。基于Thought-MDP和跷跷板缓解机制（token掩码+双向梯度手术）的RL微调在真实长程MCP交互上有效，且能泛化到未见过的服务器和更广泛的智能体任务；论文开源了8000条精选训练样本、代码和模型权重以支持后续研究，同时坦承单次运行、活体服务器可变性、L2 GAIA结果未超基线等局限。

Abstract: The Model Context Protocol provides a shared interaction substrate for the agentic web, allowing heterogeneous services to expose capabilities through a standardized interface. Learning to use this ecosystem entails a hierarchy of capabilities: tool-format skills, server-level transfer, and cross-server composition. We present MCPDisCo, an ecosystem-scale reinforcement learning framework for MCP-native agents. Using a Thought-Markov Decision Process (Thought-MDP), the framework explicitly represents internal reasoning alongside routing, execution, and termination and trains on real-server, long-horizon interactions spanning 70 MCP servers and 527 tools across six domains. We study the reasoning--tool seesaw, a joint-learning failure mode in which improvement in one objective can accompany deterioration in the other. To mitigate potential interference, MCPDisCo combines token-masked reward attribution with bidirectional gradient surgery: the former separates direct supervision for reasoning and action spans, while the latter removes conflicting components from both objective gradients in shared parameters. MCPDisCo achieves higher success with fewer chain-of-thought tokens. On the out-of-distribution MCP-Atlas and the GAIA benchmark, MCPDisCo maintains monotone gains, confirming that the learned behavior generalizes beyond the training server distribution and broader agentic tasks. Model weight and implementation are available.

</details>


### [1008] [What Survives When Activation Steering Is Used as Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14958)
*Vedant Jumle*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究用激活向量（activation steering）作为大语言模型长期记忆的可行性。作者在冻结的Qwen3.5-2B/9B旁边构建了一个无需训练的激活记忆系统，将经历引起的后层状态变化存储为偏移向量（shift），以会话主旨为键，后续会话仅在主旨匹配时回放。基于"存储的偏移是对注意力上下文化效应的固定平均"这一理论，预注册研究得出三个结论：(1)事实几乎失败——只被存储为"要说的词"，且仅存于网络最后几层，使用率≤15%（上下文中为96–98%），并出现循环重复；(2)倾向性（leanings）仅在狭窄的强度窗口内迁移，单题项偏好几乎不动；(3)写入时的参考决定存储的是概念还是方向——若不减去相反经历，存储的"讨厌"会被读作"喜欢"。选择性方面，98%无关回复与无记忆时逐字相同。整体支持Zhao等人提出的程序性/陈述性记忆分工。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期工作（如Neural Procedural Memory, Zhao et al., 2026）把激活向量用作技能型（程序性）记忆，但将事实和用户偏好（陈述性内容）留给文本检索，理由未经测试。这关系到个性化：用户级别的激活个性化究竟能否承载陈述性内容？论文直接检验这一假设。

Method: (1) 在冻结LLM旁构建训练无关的激活记忆：在多个后层读取残差流h，将"有经历"减去"参考"后的差作为shift，按delta rule写入关联矩阵M（等价于ROME/MEMIT的键-值更新，但作用于激活而非权重）。(2) 键：100个通用提示状态的256维PCA白化向量，键为follow-up user token上的白化均值；门控阈值取自通用提示的第95百分位匹配。(3) 阅读时计算当前主旨在白化空间的余弦匹配，超过阈值才注入h←h+αMq，比较三种参考（without/opposite/centroid）。(4) 预注册实验：41个项目（15倾向、8不喜欢、6单选、12事实），4条件强度α∈{0.5,1,2,3}，配4种控制（随机向量、交换、中性、强制开闸），单一greedy+4采样；judge为Qwen3.5-9B，并用gpt-oss-20B、Gemma-4-12B、Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen3.6做跨家族复核。

Result: C1选择性：通过：无关回复98%与无记忆完全一致。 C2倾向：原始judge下两个模型均失败；多数票（跨家族）下显著但效应小且依赖judge严格度，且仅在α≈1–2狭窄窗口内有效，单选偏好几无迁移。 C3事实：通过；在用提示上清洁使用率≤15%（远低于上下文中96–98%），表现为循环（"I Pepper Pepper..."）；记忆只在最后约1/6层把目标词排入top-10。 C4前提：是/否问题无任何精度提升（2B甚至下降0.15）。 C5参考决定方向：通过；只有opposite参考让"不喜欢"读起来推离厌恶物；centroid和without参考在两个模型、每个胜任judge下都把回复推向用户讨厌的对象（仅1–8项）。 C6事实存为词：通过。

Conclusion: 三项结果统一于一个事实：存储的shift是对"注意力上下文效应"的固定平均，凡随问题变化的部分被平均掉，只剩跨问题不变的部分。因此：事实需要权重编辑或检索（其提取本身依赖问题驱动的上层注意力，而非词级信号）；倾向在狭窄强度窗口内有效；存储的语义取决于减去何种参考。为支持个性化部署，建议将概念与其符号分别存储，使方向不再依赖手工配对的相反经历。限制：仅Qwen3.5家族2B/9B、41项、单一跨家族评审小组、未测多记忆共享存储的干扰；理论解释为事后归纳而非证明。

Abstract: Activation steering has recently been used as a memory for skills: past experiences of an agent are stored as steering vectors and retrieved later. Facts and preferences about the user are assumed to need text instead. We test that assumption with a training-free activation memory beside a frozen LLM. The change an experience causes in late-layer states is stored as a shift, filed under a whitened key for the conversation's gist, and added back in a later session only when the gist matches. We argue that such a shift is a fixed average of an effect that attention, in context, recomputes for every question, so only question-independent content can survive. In a pre-registered study on Qwen3.5-2B and 9B, with judges from four model families, the memory is selective (about 98% of unrelated replies are unchanged), but facts are stored as the word to say, in the last layers only, and are almost never used (at most 15% clean use, against 96-98% in context). Leanings transfer only in a narrow strength window. Most strikingly, the reference subtracted when writing a preference decides whether its concept or its direction survives: unless the opposite is subtracted, a stored dislike is recalled as a like.

</details>


### [1009] [AlphaRLM: Aligning Language Models for Literature-Grounded Symbolic Factor Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14959)
*Jie Huang,Yuecheng Hong,Yao Chen,Hao Zhong,Linfeng Xiao,Xudong Liu,Hao Xia,Jianxuan Xin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AlphaRLM提出了一种基于强化学习的框架，通过文献引导的算子组装（LEGO）和市场对齐的分组收益分离（TMB）奖励，让大语言模型直接从金融文献中构建可执行的符号alpha因子，无需输入种子因子。在CSI 300、CSI 1000和S&P 500三个市场上的实验表明，8B/14B模型均优于遗传编程和多种LLM基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的alpha挖掘方法依赖提示工程、迭代搜索或种子因子演化，直接通过策略学习构建因子（无需种子输入）的探索较少；同时，如何在巨大组合搜索空间中提供有意义的领域先验并从噪声非平稳的市场反馈中学习，是核心挑战。

Method: 1. LEGO（文献引导算子组装）：将论文标题/摘要与可用市场变量和算子结合，为因子构建提供语义先验；2. 市场对齐奖励：包含可执行性验证奖励（含未来泄露检查）和分组收益分离奖励（TMB，取所有分位数组均值最大-最小差，而非仅端点差），以捕捉非单调因子-收益结构；3. 使用DAPO强化学习算法训练LLM策略（基于Qwen3-8B/14B），在相同文献提示下对不同完成进行组内相对比较优化。

Result: 在CSI 300、CSI 1000、S&P 500（2021-2024测试期）上，AlphaRLM-14B年化超额收益分别达13.38%、17.46%、8.08%，AlphaRLM-8B达12.14%、17.45%、6.94%，均超过所有传统因子库（Alpha158/360）、自动挖掘（GP、AlphaGen、AlphaForge）和LLM基线（DeepSeek-R1、GLM-5.2、Fin-R1等）。CSI 300训练的因子池直接迁移至CSI 1000表现出强泛化能力。在S&P 500上多数基线为负收益时，AlphaRLM仍取得正收益且最大回撤最小。消融实验验证了文献引导、DAPO和TMB奖励各自的贡献；因子池具有低冗余度和高结构多样性，与标准因子库重叠极低。

Conclusion: 文献条件化、市场对齐的策略学习可以将金融领域知识有效转化为可执行的结构化因子信号。AlphaRLM在不同市值与地域市场环境下均展现出稳健的下游选股能力，证明了文献引导RL因子生成范式的潜力。未来可扩展至盘中数据、其他资产类别、更精选文献来源及更大基础模型。

Abstract: Formulaic alpha mining seeks to discover executable expressions that capture predictive market signals in a vast, noisy search space. Recent LLM-based approaches use prompting, iterative search, or seed-factor evolution, leaving direct factor construction through policy learning less explored. To address this, we introduce AlphaRLM, a reinforcement-learning framework that trains LLMs to construct executable symbolic factors from financial literature without input factor expressions. AlphaRLM incorporates Literature-Guided Operator Assembly (LEGO), which conditions factor construction on literature-derived ideas and executable operators, providing semantic priors for exploration. It further aligns the generation policy with market feedback through executable-validity and grouped-return-separation rewards that capture non-monotonic structures across factor quantiles. Extensive experiments on CSI 300, CSI 1000, and S&P 500 show that AlphaRLM outperforms strong factor-mining and LLM-based baselines in annualized excess return. Notably, the 8B model achieves strong cross-market performance, highlighting the promise of literature-conditioned, market-aligned factor generation.

</details>


### [1010] [SkillHorizon: Constructing Long-Horizon Agent Tasks through Skill Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14966)
*Yuxuan Liu,Zhaochen Su,Hangyu Guo,Shijue Huang,Zhixiong Zhang,Kawai Chung,Zhongwei Xie,Tianshi Zheng,Wei Fan,Qing Zong,Haochen Shi,Baixuan Xu,Haoran Li,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SkillHorizon是一个长周期智能体基准，通过技能组合在七个业务环境中构建具有可扩展工作量和依赖关系的任务，评估语言模型在长视野工作流中的持续进展、依赖协调和完整交付能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长周期评估在工作量与依赖关系同步扩展方面支持有限，难以系统研究智能体在业务活动增加和相互关联时的执行表现。需要构建可执行的、结果可验证的、随工作量增长的任务，以评估智能体在更长工作流中的持续进展、依赖协调和完整交付能力。

Method: 采用基于技能组合的任务构建方法：1) 七个业务环境（FinanceOps、FieldOps、SocialOps、LogisticsOps、ResearchOps、DocOps、FactoryOps），每个环境提供持久化业务状态、MCP工具接口和可复用技能库；2) 领域生成器将可复用技能过程转化为具体业务模块，通过输入输出依赖关系、共享资源和状态更新进行连接，形成DAG依赖图；3) 基于规则的参考执行策略验证任务可行性并测量参考工作量（工具调用的token总量），分为64K到1M五个工作负载带；4) 程序化评估器检查局部目标完成率（LGC）和整任务成功率（TS）。评估五个语言模型（Grok 4.6、Qwen3.8-Flash、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Gemini 3.8 Flash、GPT-5.6 Sol）在1,050个任务上的5,250次执行。

Result: 随着工作负载从64K增至1M，平均局部目标完成率从90.4%降至46.8%，已完成工作跟不上增长的需求。在1M规模，54.0%的失败最终提交完成少于25%局部目标却保留了超过50%的工具调用额度（64K时仅2.4%）。Grok 4.6整体表现最佳（LGC 86.0%，TS 71.8%），GPT-5.6 Sol最差（TS 18.6%）。轨迹分析揭示：1) 高局部进展不保证完整交付（如DeepSeek在DocOps 1M时LGC 97.2%但TS仅66.7%）；2) 脚本成功执行但下游业务检查仍可能失败（SocialOps中提交拒绝率从64K的3.4%升至1M的16.5%）；3) 压缩导致首次通过率从84.5%降至77.2%，需要更多验证尝试；4) 不同环境的任务成功率呈现不同的扩展模式。补充实验显示，在Codex+直接MCP配置下，GPT-5.6 Sol在同一50任务上的TS从18.0%升至84.0%，表明执行框架配置对结果有显著影响。

Conclusion: SkillHorizon提供了一个可配置的长视野智能体测试平台，揭示了当前语言模型在持续进展、依赖协调和完整交付方面随工作负载增长而出现的显著退化。关键发现包括：局部执行成功与业务交付之间存在差距、上下文压缩影响依赖信息的可用性、不同执行框架配置下结果差异巨大。该基准支持未来在更大工作量和更新配置上评估持续进展与下游有效性，支持上下文管理、技能使用和执行策略的改进研究。

Abstract: Long-horizon agents must complete workflows in which later activities depend on earlier outputs and changes to shared state. A key challenge for evaluation is to expand task requirements and their dependencies while keeping tasks executable and outcomes verifiable. We introduce SkillHorizon, a benchmark that constructs long-horizon tasks through skill composition in seven business environments. Its generators use domain-specific rules to turn reusable skill procedures into concrete business activities. These activities are connected through input-output dependencies, shared resources, and state updates, allowing workload and coordination demands to grow together. Successful reference executions validate task feasibility and measure interaction workload, while programmatic evaluators assess local completion and whole-task success. We evaluate five language models on 1,050 tasks with reference interaction workloads ranging from 64K to 1M tokens. Across these scales, mean local-goal completion falls from 90.4% to 46.8%, as completed work fails to keep pace with growing requirements. At larger workloads, agents more often submit unsuccessful final answers with substantial work unfinished and tool-call allowance remaining. Trace analysis also identifies cases where scripts execute successfully but their outputs fail downstream business checks. SkillHorizon provides a configurable testbed for studying sustained progress, dependency coordination, and complete task delivery in growing workflows. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [1011] [FleetPilot: Fine-Grained Steering Empowers Real-World LLM Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14970)
*Kounianhua Du,Jianxing Liu,Kangning Zhang,Wenxiang Jiao,Yuan Lu,Jiarui Jin,Jianghao Lin,Weiwen Liu,Yong Yu,Weinan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FleetPilot是一种针对大语言模型(LLM)的推理时个性化框架，通过精细粒度的激活转向(activation steering)实现用户偏好适配。该方法在动态偏好变化和数据稀疏场景下表现优异，无需训练，具有低存储开销和轻量推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM个性化方法(基于提示、参数适配、个性化奖励建模)在实际场景中面临关键挑战：1) 提示方法受限于上下文窗口质量与模型容量；2) 参数适配方法需要昂贵训练与部署，无法适应快速变化的用户偏好；3) 个性化奖励建模受候选生成质量限制，且依赖多候选评分。在用户观测稀疏、偏好证据随查询和上下文变化时，这些限制尤为突出。

Method: FleetPilot采用两阶段流程：1) 离线转向向量准备阶段 - 为每个用户构建个性化转向向量字典，通过匹配对比(matched contrast)固定历史查询和响应、变化用户相关/无关上下文，并使用精细粒度钩取(fine-grained hooking)分别从注意力层后残差和MLP输出提取转向方向；2) 在线推理阶段 - 基于查询语义相似度从字典中检索Top-K转向向量，分别聚合注意力侧和MLP侧方向，通过顺序双重注入(sequential dual-injection)在同一计算接口位置匹配地注入，实现实例级个性化适配。

Result: 在新闻标题生成、摘要写作、个性化Web函数调用三大数据集上的实验表明：1) FleetPilot在所有基线方法中表现最优(Rouge-1/ROUGE-L/METEOR/ACC均显著提升，p≤0.001)；2) 混合钩取策略比单接口或整块钩取提升0.36%-1.64%；3) 在时序分布漂移设置下保持领先；4) 在数据极度稀疏(5%)场景下仍保持有效性；5) 推理延迟开销小(约5-15%)，单用户存储小于1MB(相比个性化LoRA约18MB)。

Conclusion: FleetPilot作为一种推理时个性化方法，通过激活转向实现无需训练的实例级适配，在快速变化和数据稀疏的真实场景中展现出强大的鲁棒性和部署可行性，是个性化LLM服务的一种实用解决方案。

Abstract: With the rapid evolution of large language models (LLMs), there is an increasing demand for effective personalization techniques that can adapt model behavior to individual user preferences. Personalized LLMs must infer a user's query-dependent preferences from limited, heterogeneous, and evolving interaction histories. Existing approaches rely primarily on in-context personalization, parametric adaptation, or personalized reward modeling, but respectively incur recurring costs in context management, model optimization and deployment, or multi-candidate generation and scoring. These limitations become particularly restrictive when user observations are sparse and the preference evidence relevant to each query varies across contexts and over time. To address these challenges, we propose \modelname, a fine-grained and instance-tailored steering framework that dynamically generates sample-level interference vectors from user data and injects them into the model's forward pass for personalized adaptation. Our approach introduces: match contrast that produces user-relevant signals, fine-grained steering component that captures nuanced signals by hooking activations from attention and MLP layers, and query-conditioned aggregation module that synthesizes these signals into contextually relevant enhancements. Extensive experiments across diverse scenarios, including short-to-long text generation, and web function calling, validate the effectiveness and compatibility of \modelname. Results show that our method consistently brings significant performance gains, and show extreme superiority in fast-shifting and data-sparse environments. Additionally, \modelname rids us of training cycles and incurs light overhead of storage or inference latency. These make \modelname a strong and real-world deployable method. Implementation is available \footnote{ this https URL }.

</details>


### [1012] [Single-Sample Decoding of a Two-Layer Sound-Word Canvas Model for Thai Klon Pad](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14980)
*Worasait Suwannik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出并评估了一个用于生成泰文"克隆帕德"（klon pad）诗节的系统，该系统基于预训练掩码语言模型WangchanBERTa，在固定画布上分两层（音节层和词层）进行解码，并通过硬掩码强制押韵、声调和音节数等格律约束。实验显示，该生成器在78个保留主题上以单次采样生成诗节，整体指标与人类诗作接近，但差6.4点，并通过预注册目标的边缘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 泰文klon pad格律严格，要求押韵、声调匹配和固定音节数，生成难度高。现有开源基线（KlonSuphap-LM）在严苛评判下表现不佳。作者旨在开发一个简单、无需后处理修复的格律生成器，并通过预注册实验验证其能否接近人类水平。

Method: 系统架构：基于WangchanBERTa初始化的掩码语言模型，在固定画布上分两层——底层为音节层（硬掩码强制押韵、声调、音节数），顶层为词层（避免词语被截断）。解码采用逐格提交方式，单次采样温度0.4，每个主题仅生成一个样本，无重排序或修复。评判采用冻结LLM作为裁判，对78个保留主题进行独立三次评估。

Result: 主要结果：在78个保留主题上，70.5%的生成诗节同时通过格律、词汇洁净度和主题对齐测试，人类诗节为76.9%（差-6.4点，CI [-19.2, +6.4]）。洁净度持平（85.9% vs 87.2%），格律+洁净度组合略优于人类（+3.8点）。差异主要在主题对齐（84.6% vs 91.0%）。低温度采样至关重要——高温下词汇错误增加，而锐化分布虽降低了罕见词比例（7.5% vs 16.5%）和多样性，但提升了质量。预注册目标差1.4点未达成。基线KlonSuphap-LM在所有测试主题上完全失败（分离评判池下三项均很低）。

Conclusion: 该简单采样式klon pad生成器在无需事后修复的情况下即可达到接近人类水平，低温度是关键。系统牺牲了一定词汇多样性和罕见词使用以换取更高的格律和洁净通过率。其与人类诗作的主要差距在于主题对齐能力，而非格律或词汇生成。该工作为受限韵律生成提供了一条实用路径。

Abstract: We present a generator of Thai klon pad verse, one stanza from a short topic, and evaluate it against human verse on held-out topics. The generator is a masked language model initialised from WangchanBERTa over a fixed canvas with two layers: a sound layer of pronounced syllables, where rhyme, tone and syllable count are enforced as hard masks, and a word layer of whole words, so that no word is cut into written pieces. Decoding commits one cell at a time and samples at temperature 0.4; one sample is drawn per topic, with no selection, reranking or repair. On 78 held-out topics never used in development, judged by three independent runs of a frozen LLM judge in the same pools as the human stanzas from which the topics were written, 70.5% of the generated stanzas pass form, lexical cleanness of all four lines and topic alignment together, against 76.9% for the human stanzas (difference -6.4 points, 95% CI [-19.2, +6.4]). Cleanness is level with human (85.9% vs. 87.2%), and the stanzas pass form and cleanness together slightly more often than the human ones (+3.8 points, [-6.4, +14.1]); the difference lies in alignment (84.6% vs. 91.0%), on topics that were written from the human stanzas. The low temperature matters: at higher temperatures the same model passes clearly fewer of the same topics, because lexical errors lie in the model's lower-probability choices; sharpening the sampling distribution removes most of them, at a cost in vocabulary (7.5% rare words against 16.5% in the human stanzas) and diversity. The pre-registered target, all-three within 5 points of human, is missed by 1.4 points. KlonSuphap-LM, the only public klon pad generator we know of, passes none of the 78 held-out topics when judged in separate pools together with the method's and the human stanzas (form 19.2%, cleanness 3.8%).

</details>


### [1013] [Certify the Decision, Not Every Score: Exact Top-k Selection from Few Evaluations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14996)
*Yuhe Sui,Yingzhi Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Certified Adaptive Selection (CAS) 框架，用于在仅需选择 top-k 候选的场景中，以最少的精确评估次数确定风险敏感的精确选择结果。核心思想是分离"预测"与"决策权威"：维护每个候选风险分数的认证上下界，通过一次性切割测试（one-cut test）判断 top-k 集合是否已被认证；预测仅用于选择下一个评估目标，从不授权停止。论文同时定义了可计算的最小后见认证成本 C*_cert 作为基准，并证明了 ES 边界的可计算性。在两个公开算法选择矩阵上，预测引导的 CAS-PG 代理仅需 1.14× 和 1.18× 的后见最优查询次数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在算法选择、能源调度、金融对冲等场景中，评估每个候选在所有不利场景下的代价是昂贵的，但实际只需要确定 top-k 获胜者。预测模型可以建议候选，但不能排除未评估场景中的意外。本文解决的核心问题是：如何在尽可能少的评估下，**认证** top-k 集合的精确性（而非估计每个分数）。

Method: 核心方法包含：(1) **CAS-CF 框架**——为每个候选维护风险分数的认证上下界，通过比较已选候选的最坏上界与未选候选的最佳下界进行一次性切割测试；(2) **定理2（一次性切割组合）**——在笛卡尔信息无关行模型下证明该停止测试是充要的；(3) **后见最优基准 C*_cert**——在多项式时间内计算给定实现下最少需要多少评估才能证明决策；(4) **CAS-PG 代理**——预测引导的查询策略，使用行内预测值排序选择下一个评估单元；(5) **扩展理论**——光谱风险粗化（CAS-SC）、定价证书 PTAS（CAS-PT）、光谱验证（CAS-SV）等分支理论。

Result: 在两个公开 ASlib 算法选择矩阵上：(a) OPENML-WEKA-2017 上 CAS-PG 用 630/3150 次评估（1.14× 后见最优），CAS-PG-T（无历史数据）用 709 次（1.28×）；(b) CSP-Minizinc-Obj-2016 上 CAS-PG 用 981/2200 次（1.18×），CAS-PG-T 用 1144 次（1.37×）。两个结果均优于测试的非预测性认证策略（分别为 1872 和 1699 次）。在合成能源调度问题中，非预测性 CAS-PD 策略避免了 93.0% 的精确求解。预测质量变化不影响决策正确性（命题5：预测无关精确性）。

Conclusion: 论文建立了风险敏感选择任务的精确认证框架，核心结论是：**预测改变工作量，但不改变被证明的选择**。该框架通过分离信息获取（预测）和停止权威（证书）实现精确性；后见最优基准 C*_cert 可在多项式时间内计算，为在线策略提供了精确的实例特定比较基准。一次性切割刻画、ES 边界的可计算性、以及预测无关精确性构成了核心理论贡献。实验验证了预测引导能显著接近理论最优，同时保持对对抗性预测的鲁棒性。论文明确划定了各分支理论的适用范围和证据边界。

Abstract: Choosing a few robust algorithms or schedules can require evaluating every candidate under many adverse scenarios, even though an agent only needs to identify the winners. A predictor may suggest those winners, but cannot rule out a surprise in an unevaluated scenario. We introduce Certified Adaptive Selection (CAS), which returns the exact top-$k$ set as soon as remaining uncertainty cannot change it. CAS keeps guaranteed lower and upper bounds on Expected Shortfall (ES), the average loss in the worst scenarios. Its stopping test compares the worst admissible selected candidate with the best admissible excluded one; for information-disjoint Cartesian intervals this one-cut test is necessary and sufficient. Prediction has a separate role: selecting the next outcome to evaluate, never authorizing the decision. For empirical ES with exact unit-cost queries, we compute in polynomial time the fewest evaluations that could have proved the realized decision in hindsight. Our prediction-guided agent CAS-PG is exact for every predictor, including adversarial ones. On two public algorithm-selection matrices, CAS-PG certifies the exact top three after 630 of 3150 and 981 of 2200 replayed queries, or $1.14$ and $1.18$ times that hindsight minimum. Without historical outcomes, its transcript-only variant requires $1.28$ and $1.37$ times the minimum, outperforming the tested non-predictive certified policies. Separately, a prediction-free CAS policy avoids $93.0\%$ of exact recourse solves in synthetic energy scheduling. One certificate thus supports several acquisition policies and separately proved risk/cost extensions: prediction changes the work, not the justified choice.

</details>


### [1014] [Can You Trust Your Preference Models? Stackelberg Games for Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15008)
*Riccardo Formenti,Aditya Agrawal,Vikas Garg*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出利用零和Stackelberg博弈框架，通过训练一对对抗性策略（Leader与Follower）来主动搜索偏好模型可能犯错的三元组（prompt与两个响应），以集合方差作为预测误差的代理信号，用于指导额外的人类监督标注。理论上证明了正则化Stackelberg均衡的存在性、唯一性及闭式解，并提出了具有线性最后迭代收敛性的Stackelberg Mirror Descent-Ascent (SMIDA)算法及其神经策略梯度版本deep-smida。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型对齐依赖不完善的偏好评估器，优化过程会被评估器的错误所利用（Goodhart定律/奖励黑客）。识别评估器的错误并定向补充人类监督是核心难题，但训练期间真实人类偏好不可用，需寻找可计算的代理信号。

Method: 1. 定义"对抗三元组"为目标对象：真实偏好明确倾向于某响应，而评估器却偏好另一响应。
2. 使用偏好模型集成的方差（disagreement）作为预测误差的在线可计算代理。
3. 将搜索形式化为上下文零和Stackelberg博弈：Leader生成响应，Follower观察到后生成使集成方差最大化的替代响应，Leader则试图最小化方差。
4. 理论分析：在KL正则化下证明均衡存在性、唯一性和闭式表征。
5. 算法：提出SMIDA（双时间尺度镜像下降-上升），表格版本具有线性最后迭代收敛性；提出神经策略梯度版本deep-smida，含新颖的学习率联合warm-up策略。

Result: 1. 合成oracle实验支持集成方差作为预测误差的信息性代理（AUROC=0.670，顶部10%错误率40.6% vs 总体24.3%）。
2. 在保留集上，训练后的策略将平均集成方差从0.0051提升至0.0139，α=0.1时在线候选率从10.0%提升至33.7%。
3. oracle确认的对抗三元组产率显著提高：α=0.1, ε=0时从4.4%提升至9.6%。
4. Leader在保持响应质量方面具竞争力：对NLHF胜率54.89%，对SLHF Leader胜率50.70%。
5. 消融实验显示，与自适应Leader联合训练的Follower在IFEval指令跟随任务上全面优于固定Leader基线。

Conclusion: 同一优化行为既能利用评估器的缺陷，也能帮助识别这些缺陷并指导人类监督的补充。Stackelberg博弈框架为发现偏好模型的错误提供了系统化路径。未来工作应将此对抗搜索与迭代标注及评估器更新相结合，并在更大规模模型和开放式任务上进行验证。

Abstract: Language models are frequently aligned to human preferences via imperfect evaluators whose errors can be exploited during optimization. We train policies to search for comparisons on which an evaluator may reverse the underlying preference, providing candidates for additional supervision. Since human preferences are unavailable during policy training, we use disagreement among an ensemble of preference models as a proxy for prediction error. We formulate this search as a zero-sum Stackelberg game between two opposing policies, a Leader which tries to minimize disagreement, and a Follower which maximizes it. For a general class of finite contextual Stackelberg games, we establish equilibrium existence and, under regularization, uniqueness and a closed-form characterization. We introduce Stackelberg Mirror Descent-Ascent (SMIDA), a two-timescale algorithm with linear last-iterate convergence in the tabular setting, and develop a neural policy-gradient analogue. Experiments with a synthetic oracle support disagreement as an informative proxy for prediction error. On held out data the trained policies outperform reference policies and increase the fraction of comparisons that exceed a disagreement threshold and reverse the oracle's preference.

</details>


### [1015] [On the Complexity Gap Between POMDPs and Multi-Environment POMDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15010)
*Eline M. Bovy,Caleb Probine,Marnix Suilen,Ufuk Topcu,Nils Jansen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文系统性地刻画了多环境 POMDP（ME-POMDP）有限时域鲁棒奖励最大化问题在不同子类和时间依赖马尔可夫策略/有限状态控制器下的计算复杂性，揭示了 POMDP 子类在多环境设置下复杂性可能保持（NP 完全）、跃升（PSPACE 完全）或新增（∃ℝ 完全）的细致图景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: POMDP 在现实应用中常面临模型不确定性，但现有复杂性结论只覆盖了 MDP 等极少数子类的多环境情形，单环境 POMDP 中大量"易处理"子类（如盲 MDP、确定性 POMDP、IOMDP、SOMDP、揭示型 POMDP）在多环境设置下的复杂性完全未知，形成了显著的复杂性鸿沟。

Method: 作者首先形式化"策略类在隐藏混合下封闭"的条件并利用线性规划对偶证明 ME-BlindMDP 和确定性 ME-POMDP 的 NP 上界；然后通过构造环境标签洗牌（shuffling）和固定支撑 MO-POMDP 把 QSAT 归约进来证明多观察类（MO-MDP、MO-SOMDP）的 PSPACE 硬度；策略受限（Markovian 随机策略和 FSC）部分则通过把不可相关随机性问题归约为 2-对-1 队矩阵博弈以及低非负秩可行性问题来建立 ∃ℝ 硬度。

Result: 论文证明：(1) 多环境盲 MDP 与确定性 ME-POMDP 仍为 NP 完全；(2) MO-MDP 和固定支撑 MO-SOMDP 为 PSPACE 完全，而 MO-IOMDP（固定支撑）保留在 NP 中；(3) 所有在时间依赖马尔可夫策略或大小受限 FSC 下 NP 完全的子类问题在 ME-POMDP 中跳升为 ∃ℝ 完全；并给出记忆大小/环境数比 α 对复杂性由 ∃ℝ 降至 NP 的阈值现象（α=1 时对盲 MDP 成立）。

Conclusion: POMDP 子类在多环境鲁棒设置下的计算难度并非单调继承：仅满足"隐藏混合封闭"的子类可传递单环境的易处理性；引入最小的观察不确定性（环境标签或揭示概率扰动）即足以再现 PSPACE 完全性；而对策略施加相关性限制则将难度推升至 ∃ℝ 这一介于二者之间的新层级，凸显了 ME-POMDP 复杂性对子类结构的高度敏感性，并为未来研究无限时域及逻辑目标的复杂性分类指明方向。

Abstract: Multi-environment POMDPs (ME-POMDPs) generalize POMDPs by encoding a finite set of possible environments, capturing model uncertainty. The finite-horizon robust reward maximization problem for a ME-POMDP asks for a policy that maximizes reward in the worst environment, and recent work has shown this problem to be $\mathsf{PSPACE}$-complete. We expand the complexity landscape of ME-POMDPs by identifying which subclasses retain this $\mathsf{PSPACE}$-completeness. In particular, we take subclasses of POMDPs that are tractable in the single-environment case, and investigate the computational complexity of these classes when extended to the multi-environment setting. We first prove the $\mathsf{NP}$-completeness of multi-environment blind MDPs and deterministic POMDPs using a certain closure-under-mixture condition. We then prove $\mathsf{PSPACE}$-completeness for a range of subclasses that do not satisfy that closure condition, yielding new complexity results for multi-observation POMDPs. Finally, we show existential theory of the reals ($\exists \mathbb{R}$)-completeness for numerous ME-POMDP problems under time-dependent Markovian policies or finite-state controllers that are $\mathsf{NP}$-complete for standard POMDPs. These results reveal a subtle relationship between POMDP and ME-POMDP complexity that depends heavily on the subclasses involved.

</details>


### [1016] [Belief Embedding Tree Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15046)
*Christopher Solinas,Radovan Haluška,Martin Schmid,Michael Buro,Nathan R. Sturtevant,Michael Bowling*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于 POMDP 的蒙特卡洛规划器 BETS（Belief Embedding Tree Search）。它在搜索树的每个节点用生成式分布嵌入（GDE）来表示信念，使得节点只需存储一个嵌入而非粒子集，并通过 NBF 更新实现贝叶斯过滤。BETS 还引入了变量耦合（variable-coupling）流以显式捕捉状态变量间的依赖关系，并联合训练信念模型、策略网络和价值网络。在六个 POMDP 配置（RockSample、LightDark、PocMan）上的实验表明，BETS 在所有任务上均具竞争力或领先，在高维信念场景下优势尤为显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: POMDP 中的精确信念规划因连续信念空间而难以处理。现有方法（粒子滤波 + 摘要统计）会因重采样导致粒子贫化，且基于均值/标准差的特征会丢失多模态结构与变量间的依赖关系。作者希望找到一种既可增量更新、可采样，又能被策略和价值网络所利用的紧凑信念表示方法。

Method: 1. 用 GDE（编码器 + 条件生成器）表示每个节点的信念，并采用 Neural Bayesian Filtering（NBF）通过一次前向传播完成贝叶斯更新；2. 提出 variable-coupling 流：在编码器和生成器中显式建模每对变量间的共现关系，并配合自回归生成器；3. 搜索树采用配对根动作 + PUCT 内部选择，叶节点用价值网络评估；4. 联合训练信念模型（以环境真实隐藏状态为目标）、策略网络和价值网络，策略和价值目标来自搜索结果（KL 正则化改进策略 + λ-回报）。

Result: 在 RockSample(15,15)、RockSample(20,20)、LightDark(5)、LightDark(10)、PocMan(M) 和 PocMan(L) 六个配置上，BETS 均取得有竞争力或最优的成绩；在 RockSample(20,20) 与两个 PocMan 迷宫上，BETS 大幅领先所有基线（BetaZero、AdaOPS、DESPOT、POMCPOW），即便不使用搜索（仅用策略网络）也是如此。消融实验表明变量耦合流优于仅扩大嵌入维度的方案，且基于嵌入的价值网络预测精度显著高于基于粒子矩的方案。

Conclusion: BETS 证明了学习到的信念嵌入可以替代搜索内部的粒子集，且策略/价值网络能从嵌入中受益而非依赖粒子摘要统计。该方法在高维信念 POMDP 中表现尤其出色，并有望推广到其他基于信念的学习与规划算法中。局限在于搜索代价随 K 线性增长，且训练需访问真实隐藏状态，根动作配对在大动作空间下需配合 sequential halving。

Abstract: Beliefs in a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) are posterior distributions over the hidden state given the agent's history of actions and observations. They summarize everything the history says about the state, so planning in a POMDP is planning in a Markov decision process (MDP) over beliefs. Belief MDPs have continuous state spaces even for finite POMDPs, and exact planning in them is intractable in general. Planners must therefore approximate beliefs and estimate values. Monte Carlo planners do both inside a search tree, with an approximate belief at every node and a value estimate at every leaf. Approximations usually consist of sets of sampled states, with leaf values coming from rollouts, hand-designed bounds, or learned networks. Policies and values computed from these approximations are limited by their quality, and prior methods with learned networks rely on hand-chosen summaries of the sampled states. A belief representation should be computable from the parent node's representation through the POMDP's dynamics, let the search sample from it, and be learned so that it provides the information that policies and value functions need. We present Belief Embedding Tree Search (BETS), a Monte Carlo planner that meets these requirements by representing each node's belief with a generative distribution embedding (GDE) while updating it through the POMDP dynamics. BETS trains its belief model alongside its policy and value networks through experience, with the realized hidden state of the POMDP as the belief model's training target. We evaluate BETS on six configurations of RockSample, LightDark, and PocMan against BetaZero and three planners without learned components. BETS is competitive or leading on all six, while every baseline falls far behind on at least one. Where beliefs are highest-dimensional, it outperforms them by a large margin, even without search.

</details>
