Across ten simulated tool worlds, PI solves all 600 cold held-out composition tasks with three allowed small trials, compared with 6.17% for a whole-trajectory control, while an equally expressive compositional repair control matches PI. On an unseen tool revision, PI achieves 70.0% success versus 24.0% without small trials and 79.0% with self-trial enumeration; an exploratory 24-task adaptation stream subsequently raises first-submission success to 100%, supporting a limited correction-and-retention mechanism rather than a unique incentive advantage or general intelligence. The CPU-only implementation, integrity checks, and reproducible results are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [1097] [Large Language Model Assisted Transportation Planning through a Differentiable User Equilibrium Layer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16140)
*Eunseung Lee,Gyeongjun Kim,Keemin Sohn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种集成LLM的交通规划框架，结合模型上下文协议（MCP）和开源交通规划工具AequilibraE，通过可微分用户均衡（UE）分配层，使非专家用户能够以自然语言执行交通网络分析与优化（如交通需求函数标定和网络设计），从而降低交通规划的门槛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统交通规划需要网络建模、交通分配和优化方面的专业知识，战略分析（如网络设计、容量扩展和模型标定）对非专家决策者而言门槛过高。现有基于LLM的系统主要作为仿真软件的接口，缺乏高效搜索、评估和优化交通方案的能力。

Method: 提出集成人类-AI交通规划框架，包含四个核心组件：(1) 大语言模型（LLM）用于自然语言交互；(2) 模型上下文协议（MCP）接口；(3) 开源交通规划引擎AequilibraE；(4) 可微分用户均衡（UE）分配层。该可微分UE层通过对Beckmann交通分配问题的Karush-Kuhn-Tucker（KKT）条件进行直接微分实现。通过两个代表性规划任务进行验证：基于观测交通量的旅行时间函数标定，以及预算约束下的交通网络设计。

Result: 该框架能够使非专家用户以自然语言执行网络分析并优化交通解决方案。通过两个示例（分类标定和预算约束网络设计）展示了可微分交通模型与LLM智能体如何共同促进交通规划民主化，并显著降低领域专业知识与交通决策之间的障碍。

Conclusion: 可微分交通模型与LLM智能体的结合能够有效地使交通规划民主化，显著降低领域专业知识与交通决策之间的壁垒，使非专家用户能够进行复杂的交通网络分析与优化。

Abstract: Transportation planning has traditionally required substantial expertise in network modeling, traffic assignment, and optimization. As a result, strategic analyses such as network design, capacity expansion, and model calibration remain inaccessible to non-expert decision makers. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) provide an opportunity to bridge this gap by enabling natural-language interaction with complex transportation planning tools. However, existing LLM-based systems primarily serve as interfaces to simulation software and lack the ability to efficiently search, evaluate, and optimize transportation solutions. This study proposes an integrated human-AI transportation planning framework that combines a large language model, a model context protocol (MCP) interface, an open-source transportation planning engine (AequilibraE), and a differentiable user equilibrium (UE) assignment layer. The framework allows non-expert users to execute network analyses and improve solutions for optimization. A differentiable UE layer is developed by directly differentiating the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions of the Beckmann traffic assignment problem. The proposed framework is demonstrated through two representative planning tasks: calibration of travel time functions from observed traffic counts and network design under budget constraints. The examples illustrate how differentiable transportation models and LLM agents can jointly democratize transportation planning and substantially reduce barriers between domain expertise and transportation decision making.

</details>


### [1098] [Phantom Merge: When Your Large Language Model Agents Pick One but Tell You About Another](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16141)
*Wangshu Zhu,Qianwen Guo,Yushun Dong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文识别了LLM智能体中一种新的可靠性问题——Phantom Merge (PM)，即智能体在多实体任务中将不支持的声明归属于其已承诺的实体，并提出了一个两阶段的诊断与修正框架（AGR检测+FAC修正），在多个智能体域和骨干网络上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机：LLM智能体在多实体任务中，即使任务完成正确，其最终响应中的声明可能并不属于其承诺的实体（锚点），这种实体-证据绑定失败无法被现有任务正确性或通用事实性评估捕获，亟需专门的诊断与修正方法。

Method: 方法：提出两阶段框架——(1) AGR（Anchor-Grounded Risk）结合表征性线性探针和基于Jacobian的功能性读数，估计声明级PM风险；(2) FAC（Fixed-Anchor Correction）通过锚点约束路由审查高风险声明，使用观察到的锚点证据修正或移除不支持的声明，保持锚点不变。

Result: 结果：在4个智能体域和4个骨干网络上证明PM普遍存在（0.4%-54.1%），包括任务正确的轨迹中也有PM；AGR-slot在Shopping测试集上AUROC达96.2%，AP达97.3%，优于所有评估的基线；FAC将Shopping轨迹级PM从51.4%降至6.2%，输出-原始声明比为80.7%。

Conclusion: 结论：Phantom Merge是LLM智能体中一种重要的实体特定接地失败模式，可通过内部风险估计与证据约束声明修正相结合的方法有效检测和缓解，这对构建可靠的多实体智能体至关重要。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate over multiple entities, where reliable response generation requires not only retrieving relevant evidence but also preserving its association with the correct entity. We identify Phantom Merge (PM), an entity-evidence binding failure in which an agent attributes unsupported claims to its committed entity, potentially even when the task is completed correctly. We formalize PM at the claim level and characterize its prevalence and error subtypes across four agent domains and four backbone families. To address this problem, we propose a two-stage framework for claim-level risk estimation and correction. First, Anchor-Grounded Risk (AGR) combines a representational readout of the agent's pre-emission hidden state with Jacobian-based functional information, providing complementary slot-level and anchor-value risk scores. Second, Fixed-Anchor Correction (FAC) audits flagged claims and selectively revises them using observed anchor evidence or removes them when no supported replacement is available. On the held-out Shopping detection cohort, AGR-slot achieves an AUROC of 96.2% and an average precision of 97.3%, outperforming the evaluated detection baselines. In the end-to-end Shopping mitigation evaluation, FAC reduces trajectory-level PM from 51.4% to 6.2%, with an output-to-original claim ratio of 80.7%. These results demonstrate the prevalence of entity-specific grounding failures and the effectiveness of combining internal risk estimation with evidence-constrained claim correction. Our code is publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [1099] [Pollard: Governed Semantic Execution Trees for Framework-Independent AI Agent Control and Replay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16145)
*Muntaser Syed,Marius C. Silaghi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Pollard，一个基于"治理语义执行树"的框架无关运行时。其核心思想是将代理执行中的语义身份（step identity）与因果血统绑定，使资源准入（admission）、结果回放（replay）和审计（audit）共享同一身份标识。系统在确定性退步和内存、SQLite、PostgreSQL 等存储后端上进行了严格签名评估，验证了严格回放（不调用包装操作的真正调用）、资源保留租约安全性和滚动封印完整性等关键机制的正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 AI 代理框架虽然在检查点持久化、工具调用追踪和资源使用限制方面提供了支持能力，但这些功能往往分别赋予执行、调用和回放不同的身份标识，导致控制决策与执行证据之间缺乏共享身份，难以实现统一的因果可追溯性。特别是在代理系统预算超支、形式资源合约和执行来源等研究中暴露的共性问题：控制决策与执行证据需要共享同一身份语义。本研究旨在通过统一的语义执行树解决这一治理难题。

Method: Pollard 的核心技术包括：
(1) 语义身份与因果血统绑定：节点标识符 I(n) = H(d_I ∥ C_I(p, k, a, x)) 由父节点标识、步骤类型、尝试次数和规范输入共同决定，相同语义输入在不同祖先下仍保持不同身份；
(2) 准入与结算转换：在 PostgreSQL 等事务性存储上实现原子性预留-结算，预估服务必须允许被调用方在结算前保留预留，超出部分以 ε_i = max(0, c_i - e_i) 为界；
(3) 严格回放语义：当节点身份和存储结果匹配时，直接返回已验证的存储结果而不调用包装操作，通过哨兵失败不调用进行直接测试；
(5) 滚动密封验证：按确定顺序 z_i = H(d_S ∥ C_I(i, I(n_i), p_i, k_i, D(n_i), z_{i-1})) 形成可检测重排序、截断或语义篡改的最终摘要；
(6) 结构化行动注册：行动注册基于名称、版本、JSON 模式、副作用声明和规范摘要执行准入，拒绝未知行动、版本不匹配、无效参数或策略违规；
(7) 框架集成适配器：保持与 LangGraph、OpenAI Agents、pydantic-ai 和 MCP 的轻量集成，将框架事件与模型和工具边界分开记录。

Result: 在签名的确定性退步（ictai-confirmatory-v1）下完成了以下结果：
- E1：两个状态模型副本各执行 6400 万次转换无违背；
- E2：542 个 PostgreSQL 进程组、2768 次准入尝试中，122 个保留租约的 Pollard 组未违反精确限制（单侧上限 0.0243），三个较弱的精确计数器各累积 280 单位超支；
- E3：895 个单元中，严格回放在 155 次观察中 0 次进入包装操作；60 次存储结果变更全部被拒绝，而仅参数缓存产生 930 个不安全别名；
- E4：132 个单元、660 个进程，最大进程耗时 408.47 秒；
- E6：1470 次语义变更全部被检测，120 个控制端元数据编辑产生 0 次警报；
- E7：360 对框架对、720 个 Pollard 树全部通过验证；
- E5：162 个托管试验，34 次完成，全部完成的 Pollard 试验均产生已验证的树，效用配对差异 -0.0123（置信区间 [-0.0385, 0.0000]），受提供商兼容性限制报告为集成证据而非基准等价性。
保守结算 $4.36 美元，低于 7.00 美元硬停止。

Conclusion: Pollard 验证了一个系统命题：当准入、执行、拒绝、回放和审计共享一个基于祖先的语义身份时，它们变得可相互检查。在正确仪表化的边界、保留租约和外部锚定密封的前提下，一个语义树可以将治理决策与可回放执行证据连接起来。研究承认其局限性：Pollard 回放的是记录的结果而非托管模型的采样过程；精确安全性需要可序列化的事务更新、精确估计和结算前保留的租约；签名清单必须与进程活跃性和外部守卫守护协调组合才能用于后续冻结。托管研究受提供商兼容性和固定预算规则限制，仅作集成证据而非可比通用基准报告。

Abstract: Agent frameworks can persist checkpoints, trace tool calls, and limit resource use, but these facilities often assign different identities to execution, governance, and replay. We present Pollard, a framework-independent runtime based on governed semantic execution trees. A step identity commits to canonical input, kind, attempt, and parent identity; the same tree records completion, refusal, resource settlement, and branch history. Strict replay returns a verified stored result without invoking the wrapped operation, while a transactional store coordinates reservations across concurrent workers. Under a signed deterministic freeze, two state-model replicas each executed the evaluation transitions without an invariant violation, retained-lease PostgreSQL groups were tested against exact limits, strict replay avoided external calls, and all semantic mutations were detected with no false alarms on the controls. A multi-pair framework matrix preserved reference behavior and verified the trees. A separate cost-capped hosted study exercised live provider paths, and every completed Pollard trial produced a verified tree. Together, the studies support the core mechanisms under explicit lease, boundary, and seal-custody assumptions.

</details>


### [1100] [Uncovering Robustness Weaknesses in LLM Agents via Persona Evolution with Task-Integrity Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16155)
*Yutao Xie,Jingbo Yang,Guanyu Yao,Xiaoyu Yang,Duo Ding,Shiyu Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TIPER，一种任务完整性约束下的人设演化方法，用于自动发现能暴露LLM智能体鲁棒性弱点、同时保持任务有效性的用户策略。通过在4个交互式智能体基准上对12个GPT-5.4设置和7个智能体跨28个智能体-域对的实验，TIPER持续降低智能体的avg@3分数，并在所有直接策略对比中优于固定行为程序和目标匹配的PPol方法，还提出了连接用户行为与智能体失败模式的分类法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的交互式智能体评估依赖标准化的、广泛合作的LLM用户模拟器，可能系统性地低估真实多样用户交互下的失败率，导致智能体鲁棒性估计过于乐观。现有方法要么依赖预定义的用户行为（可能遗漏特定于智能体或域的弱点），要么以失败为导向的搜索会通过使任务无效化而非暴露真实的鲁棒性失败来降低任务成功率。需要一种能自动发现智能体特定的用户策略、暴露鲁棒性弱点同时保持任务完整性的方法。

Method: 提出TIPER（Task-Integrity-Preserving Persona Evolution），一种任务完整性保护的人设演化方法。其核心包括：(1) 通过反思引导的行为变异（reflection-guided behavioral mutations）在自然语言空间中演化持久的人设；(2) 任务级Pareto选择（task-wise Pareto selection）保留跨任务的互补失败模式；(3) 任务完整性约束（task-integrity constraint），包括文本级检查（persona合法性、任务通用性）和搜索时完整性门控（search-time integrity gate）来区分真实的智能体失败与任务失效导致的失败。将任务分为search/rank/test三部分，通过15代演化搜索，以minibatch上的难度改进和完整性违规阈值为筛选条件。

Result: 在τ³-bench、Lost-in-Conversation、ColBench、VitaBench四个基准的12个GPT-5.4设置上，TIPER在所有设置上都降低了held-out的avg@3分数，观察到的降低幅度为5.8至33.7个百分点，中位数降低16.1点。在跨7个智能体的28个智能体-域对中，所有对的avg@3均降低，中位数降低22.9点。在所有8个直接策略对比中，TIPER的降低幅度超过最强替代方法7.5个百分点，其任务关键模拟器错误率≤2.5%。在150个抽样轨迹的人工审计中，148个被确认为任务有效，其中143个有可识别的智能体错误。还产生了一个将10种用户行为与6种智能体失败模式关联的行为-失败分类法。

Conclusion: TIPER能够自动发现当前协作智能体评估系统性忽视的鲁棒性弱点，同时通过任务完整性约束确保失败源于真实的智能体弱点而非任务失效。其有效性在多个智能体、基准和域中具有一致性，并提供了连接用户行为与智能体失败模式的诊断分类法。该方法支持更具诊断性的鲁棒性评估，为未来智能体鲁棒性改进提供了信息丰富的失败分析。局限性在于搜索固定对话级人设而非轮次自适应对手、模型化判断器提供经验证据而非形式化证明、演化搜索需要更多模型调用且严格minibatch改进可能限制多样化的进一步被接受突变。

Abstract: Interactive-agent evaluations commonly rely on standardized LLM-based user simulators that exhibit broadly cooperative behavior, potentially overlooking failures that arise under diverse but realistic user interactions. This can lead to overly optimistic estimates of agent robustness and provide limited failure signals for training agents that generalize across users. Existing approaches largely rely on predefined user behaviors, which may miss agent- or domain-specific weaknesses, while failure-oriented search can reduce task success by invalidating the underlying task rather than exposing genuine robustness failures. To fill this gap, we introduce TIPER, a task-integrity-preserving persona evolution method that automatically discovers agent-specific user policies exposing robustness weaknesses while keeping the underlying task valid and solvable. TIPER evolves persistent user personas through reflection-guided behavioral mutations and task-wise Pareto selection under a task-integrity constraint. Across four interactive-agent benchmarks, TIPER yields lower held-out avg@3 scores in all 12 GPT-5.4 settings, with observed reductions of 5.8 to 33.7 percentage points, and in all 28 agent-domain pairs spanning seven agents, with a median observed reduction of 22.9 points. Further analysis yields a behavior-to-failure taxonomy that connects discovered user behaviors to recurring agent failure modes. Together, these results show that TIPER enables more diagnostic robustness evaluation of interactive agents and provides informative failure analysis for future agent robustness improvement. Code repository: this https URL .

</details>


### [1101] [Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting under Moving-Solid Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16167)
*Jongwon Ryu,Sunjae Yoon,Junyeong Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了"交互式4D体积液体预测"任务——在给定当前液体状态与未来固体运动轨迹的条件下，预测全流域稠密3D液体速度场的时空演化。作者构建了一套基于DualSPHysics的合成基准（含球体、立方体、圆锥三类物体12800/1600/1600/4000条样本），并提出了两层级的循环预测框架TIDE/TIDES：TIDE采用局部界面驱动的核心（分离体相演化与界面残差），TIDES在此基础上加入基于粒子的传输反馈（dual-space P2G耦合）和显式稳定化（轻量化的"压力式"隐变量校正）。在五个随机种子的统一协议下，TIDES在滚动场误差、轨迹终点误差、近界面与远场误差及散度稳定化诊断上均达到最佳，并在运动/尺寸OOD与长时域（16/24/48/64步）预测中保持优势。代码已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经流体代理、神经算子、体积流增强、视觉刚–液合成以及粒子/网格动力学方法，要么只处理静态或预设几何条件下的流场，要么只重建/增强已有观测，要么预测空间并非全流域稠密欧拉速度场。它们无法预测"运动固体如何诱发未来全流域液体响应"，而这对机器人液体操控、数字孪生、刚–液视频生成等"重复查询"场景至关重要。核心挑战是局部–全局预测：流体–固体能量交换集中在演化的界面附近，但预测目标是全流域的自回归滚动展开。

Method: TIDE核心：将未来固体的SDF与边界速度确定性派生为占用oτ、界面掩码m∂、法向nτ与边界速度vτ等界面表示ℐτ，由3D U-NO骨架预测体相Δz^bulk，由局部界面模块产生界面残差Δz^int，两者相加后做轻量投影得下一步速度。TIDES扩展：在隐空间中加"压力式"Πlat,1修正→解码速度场→用三线性采样驱动辅助P=256个拉格朗日粒子→用最近体素scatter回栅格构造P2G反馈，再用Πlat,2修正，并加上界面条件输出校正和硬边界覆盖。自回归训练目标ℓ=ℓ_field+λrollℓ_roll+λintℓ_int+λtransℓ_trans+λstabℓ_stab（实现层分解为10项速度/梯度/散度/轨迹/界面/滚动/相位/双空间/交换/粒子项）。评估指标：l_roll、traj_end、near、far、Δdiv（散度变化），长时域延伸至H∈{16,24,48,64}。

Result: 在32×128×128网格8 FPS下，TIDES在l_roll=0.005746、traj_end=0.104397、near=0.005581、far=0.005826五项指标上均显著优于3D ResUNet（0.007585/0.122781/0.005757/0.009553）、U-NO（0.006542/0.112111/0.005807/0.005999）、Transolver（0.006981/0.142872/0.005712/0.008737）和GNS（粒子预测落栅后大幅恶化，3.77/5.56/3.67/3.96）；去除投影、对象局部patch或改用全局条件、扩大有限支持、TIDES各组件（dual feedback/latent correction/output correction）均会单调退化，验证了局部交互+传输耦合+显式稳定化三者各为关键；五个损失项中Lroll缺失退化最大。运动/尺寸OOD与H=16/24/48/64拓展下TIDES仍最优；参数匹配的338M U-NO局部化对照表明局部化输入贡献约一半收益，TIDE/TIDES中介与传输/稳定化机制再贡献5.3%–9.7%。TIDES 8步推理延迟302.9 ms，约为参照DualSPHysics（每物理秒6.46 s）的21.3倍；与同等耗时的粗粒度SPH（0.3015 s）相比误差低30.8%。

Conclusion: 本文将"运动固体条件下的稠密液体预测"形式化为一个可控的、面向重复查询的预测原语，并提供了一套基于DualSPHysics的合成基准和TIDE/TIDES参考实现。结果支持一种从局部到全局的建模视角——固体诱导的变化集中在演化的界面上，需要在全流域欧拉展开中稳定传播——这与经典的FSI在边界/界面上的认识一致。局部界面驱动建模是核心，传输感知耦合和显式稳定化是长程自回归鲁棒性的关键。局限在于：合成数据、OOD仅覆盖运动与尺寸、稠密目标由粒子仿真构建而非求解器原生连续场、固体轨迹作为已知外生条件不参与反耦合；未来工作将扩展到更丰富几何、多固体、更广物理参数与闭环双向耦合。

Abstract: We propose the task of Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting: predicting the spatiotemporal evolution of a future dense 3D liquid velocity field conditioned on how a solid object moves through it. This task provides an upstream physical forecasting primitive for systems that need to reason about motion-conditioned liquid response, including robotic liquid manipulation, digital twins, and rigid-fluid video generation. Existing works have made efforts in predicting flow around static or prescribed solid geometries and synthesizing visually plausible fluid motion. Yet these approaches provide limited coverage for interactive liquid dynamics, as they are not capable of forecasting how a moving solid induces a future full-domain liquid response. In this forecasting scenario, the hydrodynamic effect is condensed near an evolving liquid-solid interface, but the prediction target is a global spatiotemporal rollout. To address this challenge, we propose a two-level recurrent forecasting framework, TIDE/TIDES: TIDE isolates localized interface-driven forecasting, while TIDES adds transport-aware coupling and explicit stabilization to reduce accumulated rollout error. Across adapted neighboring baselines, controlled component ablations, motion/size OOD tests, and long-horizon evaluation, TIDES achieves the best forecasting performance and the ablations identify localized interaction, transport coupling, and stabilization as the key contributors. Together, our task formulation, benchmark, and TIDE/TIDES study establish a controlled foundation for moving-solid-conditioned dense liquid forecasting. The code is publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [1102] [ProCARE: Real-World Study Automation via Profile-Grounded Evidence Contracts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16175)
*Zhaoyu Fan,Bowen Han,Jincheng Ou,Yanwei Ren,Zehua He,Kaiyu Huang,Pengcheng He,Shanshan Ni,Chengchen Gong,Shuai Xue,Qingjiang Shi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ProCARE 是一个面向真实世界研究(RWS)自动化的"配置文件落地证据契约"框架，通过将异构数据转换为证据合约(Evidence Contracts)和RWS-IR(强类型中间表示)，结合确定性验证与局部修复，在36个HCC基准任务上实现了代码可执行性、语义一致性和结论可追溯性的全面提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的RWS自动化方法存在三种系统性故障：(1) 查询-规约故障(研究概念绑定到缺失/不兼容字段)、(2) 规约-代码故障(自由形式代码违反连接图/分析粒度/时序约束)、(3) 产物-声明故障(描述性产物被转化为无支持的临床声明)。这些故障源于数据、研究规约、可执行工作流与最终报告之间缺少契约约束，构成结构性瓶颈。

Method: ProCARE 将RWS自动化重构为"契约有效生成"，包含三大契约过渡：(1) 查询→RWS-IR 编译——将异构数据概况Φ转换为强类型中间表示 Z=⟨D,G,J,K,T,V,M,A,Π_q⟩；(2) IR→代码执行——在配置文件约束下生成代码，通过模式门、方法门、产物门等确定性验证器进行局部违规集 U_t 检测与定向修复；(3) 产物→声明报告——通过证据证书 e_q=⟨o_q,c_q,z_q,φ_q,a_q⟩ 绑定声明到验证产物，仅在可追溯性和策略检查均通过时接纳声明，并由DAG控制报告章节顺序。异构数据概况按层级(数据集vs字段)和抽象(结构vs知识)分为四块。

Result: 在36个HCC基准任务上，ProCARE 在所有指标上超越基线：GA 0.86、P F 0.84、XE 0.92、CQ 0.88、VRR 0.81、CTC 0.90、UCR 0.06、CLV 0.03，显著优于 Codex（最强次优基线）和 Claude Code。在18个 Public-RWS 跨数据集迁移任务（UCI糖尿病、NHANES、TCGA-LIHC）上也保持优势。消融实验显示各契约对象互补：概况贡献最大，RWS-IR 加强声明策略，违规引导修复提升执行稳健性，证据证书和DAG排序主要改善报告。自动化指标与盲法专家评审呈中度至强相关（ρ 范围 0.71-0.82，p<0.001），跨10个LLM骨干保持契约一致性。

Conclusion: ProCARE 是一个面向RWS自动化的契约架构，通过配置文件落地的证据合约使假设、产物和声明支持在人工监督下可审计。其成功取决于概况构建的正确性、确定性验证器的覆盖面以及RWSIR中的假设编码。该系统不确立临床有效性、充分的混杂控制或因果效度。主要基准为单中心且疾病特定任务的HCC，公共数据集迁移主要测试模式迁移而非多机构、多机构时间泛化。部署到OMOP、FHIR或机构模式需要重建配置文件并重新验证。代码已开源：https://github.com/ZyFanTJ/ProCARE。

Abstract: Real-world studies (RWS) analyze routinely collected healthcare data, such as electronic health records and insurance claims, to estimate treatment effects, monitor safety, and identify risk factors outside randomized trials. Automating RWS with large language model agents is appealing but brittle: valid analyses depend on dataset-specific clinical semantics, including index dates, follow-up windows, patient/event-level units, and outcome boundaries that are often implicit in observational data. This leads to schema mismatches, temporal errors, inconsistent analytical granularity, and unsupported clinical claims. We present ProCARE, a profile-grounded framework that reformulates RWS automation as constrained compilation. ProCARE converts heterogeneous data profiles into Evidence Contracts specifying available variables, temporal attributes, distributions, and evidentiary limits, and compiles study objectives into RWS-IR, a strongly typed intermediate representation for variables, time relations, analysis units, and statistical tasks. Deterministic validation and localized repair then check and revise generated workflows across schema mapping, cohort construction, variable derivation, analysis, and interpretation. On 36 EHR-based benchmark tasks, ProCARE outperforms strong LLM-agent baselines in code executability, semantic consistency, and conclusion traceability, with automated violation diagnoses showing moderate-to-substantial agreement with blinded expert review.

</details>


### [1103] [Label-Centric Knowledge Retrieval for Zero-Shot Text Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16182)
*Daoping Wu,Dong Wang,Siyu Liu,Chen Liang,Jian Geng,Ziqi Li,Shuguang Xiong,Ying Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SLKR（Semantic Label Knowledge Retrieval）是一种面向零样本文本分类的标签中心检索增强生成框架。它将昂贵的旗舰大模型推理从逐实例分类转移到一次性构建可复用的标签知识库（包含标签定义、检索关键词和边界规则），在线阶段使用轻量级大模型结合两阶段混合检索完成分类，从而显著降低大规模标注成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旗舰大模型虽具备丰富知识和推理能力，但其高昂的推理成本与延迟使其难以用于大规模数据标注。特别是在工业冷启动场景中，新分类任务频繁出现、标注数据难以全面覆盖，传统的"标注—人工校验—模型微调"流程迭代开销巨大。许多分类标签本身具有语义意义，这为利用大模型一次性构建可复用标签知识、避免重复调用提供了机会。

Method: SLKR框架分为离线和在线两阶段：(1) 离线阶段，旗舰大模型独立生成三类标签知识——语义定义𝒟、检索关键词𝒲、潜在混淆标签对的边界规则ℬ，构建可复用的标签知识库𝒦；(2) 在线阶段，采用两阶段混合检索：先用语义+词汇信号（RRF融合）从Top-K候选标签中筛选，再从候选标签对间的边界规则中检索Top-M输入相关规则；最后由轻量级大模型基于输入文本、候选标签定义和选中规则单次调用完成分类。成本上，旗舰模型的一次性构建代价𝒪(N²)与输入规模T无关，可被分摊。

Result: 在WOS-143、BANKING77、CLINC150三个公开基准和Book-38真实工业数据集（多语言图书分类）上，SLKR配合Qwen3.5-4B在全部4个数据集上取得最优结果，配合Ministral-3-3B在3/4数据集上最优，且无需任务特定标注样本。SLKR平均仅使用1.4k输入tokens（远少于1-shot/label的4.7k）。边界消融表明，使用Hybrid Top-M=5选择仅0.35k边界tokens，性能接近使用全部边界规则（2.51k tokens）。成本对比中，BANKING77上SLKR的摊销成本为$0.4276/1k次分类，远低于直接旗舰推理的$4.111/1k。

Conclusion: SLKR通过将昂贵的标签理解外部化为可复用的离线知识，使轻量级大模型能在紧凑上下文下完成高质量零样本分类，验证了"旗舰模型构建+轻量模型推理"分工在大规模冷启动分类场景中的可行性与成本效益，为工业级零样本分类提供了实用路径。

Abstract: Flagship large language models (LLMs) offer rich general knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, but their high inference cost and latency limit their use for large-scale data labeling. We study zero-shot text classification with semantically meaningful labels and task descriptions, without task-specific labeled examples or classifier feedback. We propose \textbf{SLKR} (Semantic Label Knowledge Retrieval), a label-centric retrieval-augmented generation framework that separates offline knowledge construction from lightweight online inference. Offline, a flagship LLM independently generates label definitions, retrieval keywords, and boundary rules for potentially confusable label pairs, forming a reusable label-knowledge store. Because this construction operates over the label space rather than the input corpus, its one-time flagship cost can be amortized across large-scale inference. Online, hybrid semantic and lexical retrieval first identifies the top-$K$ candidate labels and then selects up to $M$ input-relevant boundary rules connecting candidate-label pairs. A lightweight LLM performs the final classification in a single call using the retrieved definitions and rules. Across three public benchmarks and a real-world multilingual book-classification dataset, SLKR achieves the best results on all four datasets with Qwen3.5-4B and on three of four with Ministral-3-3B, while using compact input contexts and no task-specific labeled examples. Boundary ablations further show that retrieving a small set of input-relevant rules preserves performance close to using all boundaries with substantially less context, supporting efficient reuse of flagship-generated label knowledge for lightweight classification.

</details>


### [1104] [Correct Choices, Failed Sequences: Choice2Seq Benchmarks Correctness Retention Across Output Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16191)
*Tianyou Lai,Wentao Yue,Zhiying Deng,Qilei Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Choice2Seq 是一个诊断性基准，用于衡量模型在"完整答案选择"与"逐步序列构建"两种独立输出接口之间正确性的保持能力（用 Sequence Composition Rate, SCR 量化），揭示高选择准确率并不保证序列构建的可靠性，并区分任务正确性、复制保真度和输出合规性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型在完整候选答案上做单一决策时表现优异，但在逐字符/逐步局部决策构造答案时常常失败。现有研究多关注聚合准确率，无法揭示同一问题在不同输出接口下正确性是否被保持，也无法区分任务正确性、复制保真度和输出合规性这三种不同性质。论文旨在填补这一诊断空白。

Method: 设计 Choice2Seq 基准，包含两种独立接口：Native（从 8 个候选中选一个完整答案）和 Serial（按位置逐步构造，每步接收外部状态和当前前缀）。两项任务：算术乘法（3-8 位）和词义检索（WordNet 名词）。SCR 衡量 Native 正确的题目中 Serial 也正确的比例。控制变量包括候选支持的字母表（Full/Union/Trie）、位置索引、输出契约（代码/字符）、前缀反馈（Independent/TeacherForced）、以及 Schema-Guided Dialogues 对话状态评估。模型包括 Jev、StartLux、Qwen3-8B、Qwen3.5-27B。

Result: Jev 在 Native 算术和词义检索上分别达 97.1% 和 99.5% 准确率，但 SCR 仅 33.0% 和 2.1%。Qwen 直接输出字符时表现稍好（34.7% 词义 SCR）。候选支持的 Trie 接口大幅恢复词义构建（Jev 从 1.8% 提升到 82.0%）。索引证据改善复制保真度（甚至能忠实地复制错误答案）。对 话状态评估中 Jev 保持高保留率（97.9%），Qwen 显著降低。连续生成（WholeGenerate）几乎全对，而位置查询（Serial）大量失败，说明失败源于接口而非模型能力。

Conclusion: 高选择准确率不能保证序列构建的正确性保持。候选支持、证据表示和生成协议共同影响构建结果。复制保真度的提升未必带来任务正确性的提升。序列级 EM 可能掩盖后期状态差异。评估应区分任务正确性、复制保真度和输出合规性，并采用接口感知的评估方法。

Abstract: A model may select the correct answer yet fail to construct it through a sequence of local decisions. We introduce Choice2Seq, a diagnostic benchmark that measures correctness retention across complete-answer selection and sequential construction in independent runs on the same problems and candidate sets. Sequence Composition Rate (SCR) measures the fraction of correctly selected items that are also answered correctly through local construction. Jev achieves 97.1% and 99.5% selection accuracy on arithmetic and lexical retrieval, yet retains only 33.0% and 2.1% of those correct choices under serial construction, respectively. Substantial gaps also emerge for StartLux and Qwen, including when Qwen emits characters directly. Restricting local options to candidate-supported characters improves construction, while explicit position indexing improves copying fidelity, even for incorrect selections. These interventions distinguish task correctness, plan fidelity, and output compliance. Matched dialogue-state evaluations reveal that local field construction largely preserves Jev's correct states but reduces Qwen's mean-turn accuracy, highlighting task- and interface-dependent differences. Sequence-level confidence and request-cost analyses further characterize completed outputs.

</details>


### [1105] [OneShot: Label-Efficient Detector Weighting for Time Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16219)
*Seunghan Lee,Jun Seo,Jaehoon Lee,Junhyeok Kang,Sangjun Han,Sungdong Yoo,Minjae Kim,Tae Yoon Lim,Dongwan Kang,Hwanil Choi,Soonyoung Lee,Wonbin Ahn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OneShot提出一种利用单个已确认异常事件对检测器池进行softmax软加权的时间序列异常检测方法，无需重新训练任何检测器，在标签极少的情况下显著优于单检测器选择和传统集成方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列异常检测不存在通用最优检测器，最佳选择因序列而异。现有方法要么为每条序列选一个检测器，要么对检测器池取平均，但都假设永远没有标签可用。然而实际部署的监控系统中，操作员会确认报警（即产生标签），但这些标签从未被利用。本文探索：仅一个已确认的异常事件，能在多大程度上缩小与该序列最佳检测器之间的差距。

Method: OneShot的核心方法：(1) 将所有检测器的分数向量标准化为零均值单位方差；(2) 在操作员确认的单个异常事件上（配以等量随机抽取的正常点），用VUS-PR指标对每个检测器打分得到精度a_i；(3) 用温度τ=0.02的softmax将精度转化为权重w_i；(4) 对所有检测器的分数做加权求和得到混合分数z；(5) 在确认窗口上通过最大化F1确定报警阈值θ。无需重新训练任何检测器，无需语料库，温度在留一法跨序列固定。k-Shot扩展自然地处理多个已确认事件，使用相同的softmax机制。

Result: 在152条单变量和73条多变量时间序列上：OneShot在VUS-PR上达到0.710（单变量）和0.382（多变量），分别闭合了82.8%和70.4%的oracle差距（ρ），显著优于最强单检测器、无标签集成方法、确认窗口上的最佳检测器以及固定K值的top-K平均方法。OneShot在系列级比较中胜过所有基线，在四种排序指标上多数系列获胜。方法对不完美标签具有鲁棒性——即使确认窗口完全不覆盖真实异常，OneShot仍优于窗口赢家。计算开销极低：在已运行44.9秒的17个检测器管道上仅额外增加45毫秒。增益来源分析表明：当确认窗口上的检测器排名与真实最佳排名不一致时，OneShot收益最大。

Conclusion: OneShot证明了在时间序列异常检测中，仅需一个已确认的异常事件即可对检测器池进行有效的softmax软加权，显著缩小与最佳检测器的性能差距。该方法简单、标签高效、无需重新训练或语料库，为实际部署中利用稀缺标签提供了实用方案。增益受限于检测器池的覆盖能力，在极密集异常场景下增益减弱。未来的工作包括在真实操作员确认场景下验证以及处理多系列联合加权。

Abstract: Time series (TS) anomaly detection (AD) lacks a universal detector, with the best choice determined by the series rather than by the algorithm. Existing methods therefore either select one detector for each series or average a pool of them. However, both assume that no label ever arrives, while a deployed monitor does receive them, since an operator confirms the alarms it raises. In this paper, we propose ONESHOT, which uses a single confirmed anomaly to weight the pool rather than to choose one detector from it. Specifically, we score each detector on the confirmed anomaly, and those scores become the weights of a soft mixture over the whole pool. We show that a single confirmed anomaly is enough to come close to the best detector for the series. Across 152 univariate and 73 multivariate series, ONESHOT outperforms the strongest single detector, averaging the whole pool, and even picking the best detector on the confirmed event. Code is available at: this https URL .

</details>


### [1106] [Learning to GUIDE the Group: Self-Learning LLM Facilitation Across Multi-Party Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16231)
*Ziyi Liu,Tzu-Sheng Kuo,Jiale Liu,Deqing Fu,Nithum Thain,Crystal Qian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出GUIDE框架，通过自我学习使冻结的LLM从真实多人对话语料中归纳出通用的促进策略（playbook），在开放讨论、多方谈判和共识构建三类任务中以单一策略优于三个领域专家提示，并在实时人类实验中以更少干预提升参与者体验和群体公平性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM促进方法多为任务特定、依赖手工提示工程，缺乏跨多任务、多群体动力学的泛化能力；且传统自我改进依赖确定性奖励信号，而促进是无客观验证器的开放社会场景。

Method: GUIDE框架分三阶段：(1)用三个任务特定的专家LLM促进者收集432场真实三人对话语料；(2)从空playbook出发，由"对话反思器"从人类经验中提取课程、"验证反思器"从LLM法官反馈中提取课程、"策展人"执行ADD/EDIT/MERGE/DELETE等局部编辑、"规则级归因"为每条被引用的规则标记Helpful/Harmful/Neutral以驱动剪枝，经过30代迭代生成53条规则的playbook；(3)在线实验中部署单一通用playbook于462场新对话，与原专家提示进行组间对比。

Result: 离线测试集上学习策略对专家基线胜率61.4%（在专家发言时胜率66.9%）；实时实验中保持任务产出不变，心理安全从4.62升至4.67（p=.057），发言舒适度显著提升，人际摩擦从1.60降至1.42（p<.001），且组内体验方差全面下降，促进轮次减少24.7%、用词减少29.0%。53条规则中47/97条专家技能被部分保留，23条为全新规则，三大行为维度为"节奏制约下的克制""决断式收尾""非指令性干预形式"。

Conclusion: 冻结的LLM可以从真实人类互动语料中自我学习跨任务通用的社会促进策略，无需访问专家提示或确定性奖励，在保持任务产出的同时以更少干预改善参与者体验和群体公平性，为无程序化奖励的人类感知驱动领域提供了通用方法论。

Abstract: As large language models are increasingly adopted as multi-party communication facilitators, there is a growing demand for agents capable of balancing diverse group dynamics across contexts. However, existing LLM facilitators are often fine-tuned for task-specific objectives; generalized LLM-based facilitation methods that can adapt to different types of tasks and diverse group dynamics are underdeveloped. To address this gap, we present GUIDE (Generalized Unified Intervention for Dynamic Exchanges, a framework for developing generalized LLM-based facilitators across different multi-party contexts. GUIDE evaluates facilitation across both objective task outcomes and subjective metrics, including psychological safety and perceived friction. Within this framework, we study whether LLMs can self-learn generalized facilitation strategy offline to real-time interventions. We first collect multi-party human interactions guided by task-specific expert LLM facilitators (N=432 conversations). We then employ a self-learning method in which an LLM induces an actionable strategic playbook from conversations and iteratively refines it using feedback from an LLM judge aligned with human annotators (N=20), developing a single generalized facilitator that outperforms the three task-specific expert facilitators on held-out conversations 61.4% win rate. Finally, we evaluate these improvements empirically; in a real-time online empirical study, the self-learned generalized facilitator preserves facilitator performance and group productivity, improves speaking comfort and reduces interpersonal friction, while using 24.7% fewer turns and 29.0% fewer words than the expert prompts. These findings provide empirical evidence that LLMs can learn generalizable, task-agnostic social facilitation from task-specific human interactions, on-par with hand-crafted task-specific prompts across diverse group settings.

</details>


### [1107] [ScreenASR-Bench: A Tiered Benchmark for Speech Recognition with Visual Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16260)
*Mingwei Fu,Zheshu Song,Zhikai Zhou,Shen Huang,Shidong Shang,Mengxiao Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ScreenASR-Bench 是一个分层基准，用于评估语音识别模型利用视觉上下文识别声学模糊关键词的能力，包含 ETE、EVE、ISE 三个递进难度的视觉证据级别，并在三类模型上系统验证了视觉上下文的价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 ASR 模型在通用基准上表现良好，但对声学模糊词的识别仍存在困难；视觉上下文（屏幕文本、可见实体、场景语义）有望辅助识别，但现有基准未区分不同类型的视觉证据，无法揭示模型能真正利用哪类视觉信息。

Method: 构建包含 2,002 个案例的分层基准 ScreenASR-Bench，采用三阶段流程：候选收集（多 ASR 转写对齐挖掘难词）、自动筛选（VLM 选择关键帧、分配证据级别）、人工核验。三个证据级别为 ETE（屏幕直接文字）、EVE（可见实体/动作但非文字）、ISE（场景级语义推理）。在 ASR 模型、LALM、Omni 模型三类家族上，以音频-only、音频+图像描述、音频+图像三种输入进行评估，使用 WER、Recall 与归一化视觉增益 NVG 作为指标。

Result: 视觉上下文在所有三类模型和所有证据级别上均一致提升关键词 Recall：ASR 模型平均 Recall 从 48.18% 升至 62.20%，LALM 从 47.24% 升至 64.33%，Omni 模型从 61.98% 升至 77.24%。视觉增益随语义距离增大而递减，ETE 增益最大（ASR ΔRecall=26.53%，NVG=45.16%；LALM ΔRecall=35.03%，NVG=61.34%；Omni ΔRecall=25.66%，NVG=62.24%），ISE 增益最小。文本化视觉描述（Caption）在多数情况下与原始图像效果相当甚至更优。WER 低的模型未必 Recall 高，表明关键词识别需独立评估。

Conclusion: ScreenASR-Bench 证明视觉上下文能有效辅助声学模糊词识别，但模型对显式证据（屏幕文字）的利用远优于隐式语义证据，凸显当前模型在视觉推理与跨模态整合上的不足，为未来多模态 ASR 研究提供了公开基准。

Abstract: Current ASR models perform well on general benchmarks but still struggle with acoustically ambiguous words. Visual context can aid recognition in screen-based scenarios, yet existing benchmarks provide limited insight into the benefits of different types of visual evidence. To address this gap, we introduce ScreenASR-Bench , a tiered benchmark with three progressively challenging levels: Explicit Textual Evidence (ETE), based on direct on-screen text; Explicit Visual Evidence (EVE), using visible content rather than on-screen text; and Implicit Semantic Evidence (ISE), requiring scene-level inference. Extensive experiments on ASR models, Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) and Omni models show that incorporating visual context substantially improves recall over the audio-only setting across all three model families. The gains are largest for ETE and smallest for ISE, indicating that models leverage direct visual evidence more effectively than indirect semantic cues. To facilitate future research on visually grounded speech recognition, we publicly release ScreenASR-Bench.

</details>


### [1108] [Hardware-Friendly Token-Group Activation Quantization for Low-Bit Mamba Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16261)
*Jinwoo Chung,Jangho Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Token-Group Quantization (TGQ)，一种面向Mamba超分模型的低比特后训练量化(PTQ)激活量化框架。其核心思想是将硬件友好的预扫描预测器与离线校准的分组裁剪范围表相结合，静态地近似一个硬件不友好的"后扫描分组oracle"，并辅以频域保持精炼(FPR)目标以保留高频细节，最终在多个基准上实现最优性能与2.23×边缘加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Mamba模型中的选择性扫描(selective scan)操作具有输入依赖性，导致不同空间token的激活范围出现显著异质性（平均放大1.80×）。传统的层级(layer-wise)单一裁剪范围难以同时适配高响应token和典型token，在低比特量化下产生严重的精度损失。直接采用"后扫描分组"虽理想但需运行时统计，违反静态低比特部署约束。

Method: 1. **Token-Group Quantization框架**：以预扫描特征(选择性扫描参数生成源)作为输入，通过轻量级共享两层FFN预测器(C→64→K)预测token所属组(K=8)，进而查表选择离线校准的组级裁剪上下界(l_{ℓ,m,g}, u_{ℓ,m,g})，实现无运行时统计的静态低比特推理。2. **量化感知伪标签**：离线阶段，对每个token在8个组条件激活位点(out_proj、convffn2.fc1/fc2及5个scan操作数)构建描述符([q0.99, q0.999, RMS, max])，经K-means聚类生成伪标签，用交叉熵监督训练预测器。3. **Frequency-Preserving Refinement (FPR)**：在裁剪范围精炼阶段，对全精度教师与量化学生输出施加2D Hann窗后做傅里叶变换，联合对齐幅度谱与相位谱，弥补像素损失和特征损失对高频带监督不足的问题。4. **总体优化目标**：仅优化裁剪范围张量，固定权重、伪标签、预测器与比特宽度。

Result: 在MambaIRv2-Light (×2/×4) 的W4A4与W2A2权重冻结PTQ及LoRA权重训练PTQ协议下全面超越PTQ4VM、Quamba、MambaQuant、OAQ-SR、AIQViT、SPR²Q等基线；扩展到MambaIRv1、MambaIRv2-Base、图像去噪、JPEG伪影去除、Transformer SR (SwinIR-light)、Vision Mamba (ImageNet分类)以及SpinQuant/AffineQuant等通道轴变换组合均取得最优；W4A4下Jetson Orin Nano端到端推理达2.23×加速(A6000上1.70×)；消融显示分组贡献约77%(Set14)/65%(Urban100)总体提升、FPR振幅+相位互补、组数K=8已接近饱和、5种子下std<0.03dB (W4A4)。

Conclusion: TGQ通过静态预扫描预测机制成功解决了Mamba超分模型低比特PTQ中token级激活异质性难题，以硬件友好的单次推理路径逼近了后扫描oracle的精度上限；FPR目标有效缓解了低比特SR的高频退化；该方法在跨骨干、跨任务、跨协议下均表现最优且与通道轴量化变换正交可组合，为Mamba类高效架构的边缘部署提供了实用解决方案。局限在于预扫描预测与查表带来微小推理开销(相对基线4-bit路径约2-3%)。

Abstract: Mamba-based super-resolution models are efficient alternatives to Transformer-based restoration backbones, but their low-bit post-training quantization remains challenging because selective scan, Mamba's input-dependent state-space operator, induces different activation ranges across spatial tokens. Thus, a single layer-wise clipping range poorly matches all tokens. We propose Token-Group Quantization, a hardware-friendly activation PTQ framework that statically approximates a hardware-unfriendly post-scan grouping oracle, where tokens with similar preferred clipping ranges are assigned to the same group. To avoid runtime post-scan grouping in static low-bit inference, a lightweight predictor infers the groups from pre-scan features available before the quantized scan path. During calibration, we form pseudo-labels by clustering post-scan activation descriptors that capture similar rounding--clipping behavior. At inference, the frozen predictor maps pre-scan features to groups and selects entries from offline-calibrated group-wise clipping-bound tables, without runtime statistics collection, dynamic clipping updates, or post-scan group assignment. To address low-bit restoration degradation, we further introduce a Frequency-Preserving Refinement (FPR) objective for clipping-bound calibration. FPR aligns Fourier amplitude and phase between full-precision teacher and quantized student outputs to preserve high-frequency structures. Across PTQ protocols, bit-widths, backbones, and tasks, our method consistently outperforms prior Mamba and SR PTQ baselines, transfers to Transformer SR and Vision Mamba classification, composes with rotation-based quantization, and achieves 2.23x speedup on Jetson Orin Nano over FP16. Code is available here.

</details>


### [1109] [agent-risk: Risk Assessment for Changes to AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16280)
*Yue Zhao,Zixiang Xu,Angela Huyue Zhang,S. Alex Yang,Xiyang Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: agent-risk是一个框架，将经典风险分析扩展到AI代理的部分记录和部分变更场景，通过重放日志中的回合来评估部署前变更的风险。核心思想是：日志可确定一致行为和已停止行为，其余部分需日志支持、快照重放或边界约束。论文证明了精确重放所需的日志记录要求、阈值门族的快照设计，以及独立回合下重放次数和可容忍偏差的界限。在bash沙盒中的实验验证：仅7200回合日志无法决定两个重试门，但从保存状态重放被阻塞回合以半数代理调用达到了实际决策。论文强调部署前审批需要预先设计的证据：日志字段、保存状态、定向重放。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署AI代理的组织在变更前需要评估风险，但现有方法（基准测试、离线策略评估、部分识别）不能充分处理代理的六个关键特征：(1)审批门，(2)部分记录，(3)长视野，(4)模型发布，(5)共享状态，(6)监督线索。日志已掌握，但实时测试暴露用户风险且成本高昂。需建立一个框架确定哪些风险可从现有日志建立、哪些需额外证据。

Method: 框架形式化代理变更的风险规范ℜ=(E,ℓ,K,𝒞)，扩展Kaplan-Garrick场景三元组为执行机制、后果映射、观察机制、可接受变更集。核心方法：重放每个日志回合至首次偏差σκ（重置和新规则首次不同之处），分为三类：一致（agree）、停止（stop，重置后终止）、继续（continue）。重放分解等式(2)将变更后损失律分为三个项：(1)从日志读取的一致项，(2)声明停止值确定的停止项，(3)需支持、重运行或边界的继续项。假设：(A1)不变性，(A2)无预期（代理不知情变更），(A3)声明停止估值。关键结果：命题3.1（日志充分性条件）、命题A.5.1（支持继续的g-公式识别）、命题F.10.1（阈值门族的最小快照集）、执行预算界限（命题F.8.1/F.8.2）、共享状态的Fréchet界限（命题G.1.1）。实证采用定向执行：从保存快照仅重放未解决的继续。

Result: bash沙盒中16次运行记录约49000回合，主要结果：(1)停止门：日志重放P(harm)=0.039与实际0.030匹配（容差±0.03）。(2)两个重试门：仅日志界为[0.244,0.345]和[0.100,0.451]，无法决策；定向执行从1032和2929次快照继续得到0.279和0.158，与实际0.288和0.165匹配（容差±0.015）。(3)重试门1批准、重试门2拒绝，与实际决策一致；执行使用8%和23%实时代理调用，包括日志共15%。(4)无每步危害字段时停止门认证危害上限从0.064升至0.159（达2.5倍），因日志无法判断危害发生在停止前还是后。(5)模型发布：新模型重放零一致（0/99）。(6)双代理接力：干净启动高估危害0.178vs实际0.115。(7)宣布门使中止率提升0.070，超出重放预测。失败案例：忽略门、重试计为停止、跳过被阻止调用均超出容差。

Conclusion: agent-risk建立了部署代理变更批准所需的形式化框架，核心结论：(1)日志可精确建立哪些变更风险及需何种额外证据，证据设计（日志字段、快照、定向重放）应在变更前规划。(2)日志单独不足以评估重试门——必须定向执行未解决继续。(3)长视野下停止变更仍可识别，重试变更一致质量从0.77降至0.57。(4)假设A1（不变性）和A2（无预期）是基础，宣布门违反A2并证明代理监督感知。(5)共享状态需要联合执行或边际边界。(6)未来工作：超出保存文件的代理状态恢复、监督感知代理的风险边界。局限性：结果依赖条件，独立回合、忠实重放；模型发布实验未估计损失；诚实代理而非规避监督。

Abstract: Before changing a deployed AI agent (a stricter safety gate, a new model), organizations must approve the change, starting from existing logs. Extending classical risk analysis to partial records and partial changes to running systems, agent-risk replays logged episodes, assuming nothing else changes and the agent does not anticipate the change. The log settles episodes acting as before, a declared stop value settles stopped ones, and the rest need logged support, a saved-state rerun, or a bound. We prove what logs must record for exact replay and which saved states serve a gate family. For independent episodes, we bound the reruns a decision needs and tolerable drift from live behavior. In a bash sandbox, a 7,200-episode log alone decided neither of two retry gates, which let the agent act after refusals the log never shows. Rerunning only each gate's blocked episodes from saved states reached both live decisions at half the agent calls of a live test sized post hoc for them, given the log. Without per-step harm, a stopping gate's certified harm ceiling rose up to 2.5-fold, since the log hides whether harm preceded the stop. Approval thus needs evidence designed in advance: log fields, saved states, targeted reruns.

</details>


### [1110] [REVEAL: Reverse Engineering Agentic Latents from Frontier-Model Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16288)
*Yuetian Du,Meng Wang,Yucheng Wang,Zhangzhe Chen,Wei Wang,Boyu Yang,Weiqi Zhai,Bing Zhao,Ming Kong,Zhan Zhou,Jie Liu,Qiang Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: REVEAL提出了一种无需训练的框架，通过将前沿LLM的文本轨迹"逆向工程"为可在冻结的小型开源模型上应用的激活操控信号。该方法引入"代理潜变量"概念，在目标模型自身表征空间中构建反馈-响应循环的锚点状态和动态轮廓，并通过对比成功与失败轨迹中的局部事件，派生目标特定的转向方向以提升任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿LLM智能体在复杂交互任务中表现优异，但推理成本高昂，促使研究者将前沿模型经验迁移至小型开源模型。现有方法（如知识蒸馏和潜在通信）需要目标模型训练或访问源模型内部状态，在纯文本接口场景下存在实际应用缺口。本文研究如何仅利用文本轨迹为冻结的开源智能体提供可复用的局部控制信号。

Method: 核心方法包含三个组件：(1) 代理潜变量（Agentic Latents）：由冻结的"观察者"模型在重放文本轨迹时提取的锚点状态（A_{t-1}^{end}, B_t, A_t^{start}, A_t^{end}）和四类动态轮廓——更新幅度U、方向保持C、语言可达性V、跨循环一致性S；(2) 对比样本选择：对相同任务的成功与失败轨迹进行配对，按(U, V)的邻近度进行匹配，并根据|C|和|S|的差异排序选择局部事件；(3) 转向方向计算：从选定事件的响应转换差异中，通过层级平均构建每目标层的转向向量v_ℓ^θ，并在每次响应前的输入边界B_t处以加法方式施加（h^θ ← h^θ + αv）。整个框架无需更新目标参数或访问源模型内部。

Result: 在Terminal-Bench 2.1（89个容器命令行任务）和Humanity's Last Exam with tools（500题跨学科推理）上对三个目标模型（Qwen3.6-27B、Gemma-4-31B-IT、GPT-OSS-20B）进行评估：Terminal-Bench整体准确率较Vanilla提升5.62-6.74个百分点，且在所有三个目标模型上一致优于REVEAL-Base（无轮廓引导的CAA变体）和Prompt-Reg基线；HLE上同样获得最高整体准确率。效率对比中，REVEAL以Qwen3.6-27B解决35/89任务，超越轨迹SFT的32/89，且输入token减少35.6%、输出token减少50.4%、轮次和工具调用也更少。表征分析显示双端点摘要以0.75-0.92余弦相似度逼近全响应平均位移；响应结束保持性在147/148层低于响应开始；跨模型S轮廓的Spearman相关性达0.68-0.95。

Conclusion: 长程交互经验可被复用为冻结智能体自身表征空间内的局部控制。REVEAL将前沿模型轨迹转化为Agentic Latents（锚点状态+动态轮廓），通过轮廓引导的事件选择构建目标特定的转向方向，连接了纯文本轨迹与无需训练的激活操控，在任务执行和在线效率方面均带来提升，无需访问源模型内部或更新目标参数。

Abstract: Frontier LLM agents perform complex interactive tasks, but their inference costs motivate transferring their experience to smaller open-source agents. Distillation and latent communication typically require target-model training or access to source-model internals. We study how textual frontier-model trajectories can provide reusable local controls for a frozen agent. Inspired by protocol reverse engineering, we introduce $\textit{Agentic Latents}$, comprising anchored states and dynamic profiles of feedback--response cycles elicited by replay in the target model. Our training-free framework, $\textbf{REVEAL}$ ($\textbf{REV}$erse $\textbf{E}$ngineering $\textbf{A}$gentic $\textbf{L}$atents), uses these profiles and trajectory outcomes to match and select local events from successful and failed rollouts of the same task and source model. Their response-transition contrasts yield a target-specific steering direction, applied before each response. Within-benchmark evaluations on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and Humanity's Last Exam with tools report higher accuracy than unmodified agents across three targets. Representation analyses and behavioral case studies support reusing frontier-model experience as local activation control.

</details>


### [1111] [Memory-Efficient Integer-Only Training of Deep Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16298)
*Hazem Hesham Yousef Shalby,Fabrizio Pittorino,Manuel Roveri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个端到端的INT8整数训练框架,通过尾数-指数(Mantissa-Exponent)表示和五个可组合的基础原语(乘积、求和、除以常数、非线性查找表、权重更新)实现了完全无浮点的训练流程,在ResNet、MobileNetV2和ViT等多个模型与数据集上验证了可行性,并将训练内存压缩为FP32基线的1/4。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低精度训练方法在至少一个阶段(如权重更新或优化器状态)仍保留浮点运算,这不仅在GPU上限制了训练状态占用(每参数约12字节),也阻碍了在微控制器、固定功能加速器及存内计算等无浮点硬件平台上的端侧学习。

Method: 核心是带显式2的幂次指数的有符号INT8尾数表示法,在整数域内通过五个原语构建所有算子和层(包括卷积、归一化、Softmax、GELU等);中间累加使用INT32,通过按张量最大幅值计算的整数移位S(由count-leading-zeros指令实现)与随机舍入回收至INT8;针对权重更新,设计分组速度(per-group velocity)沿输出通道为各组设独立指数以保留小梯度通道的有效范围,并加入反应式重缩放(每步将权重最大幅值拉回[q_max/4, q_max]区间),从根本上避免溢出和范围浪费。

Result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet三套基准、跨CNN(ResNet-18/34/50/101、MobileNetV2)与ViT(ViT-Ti/B)上首次实现完全INT8训练:CIFAR-10 ResNet-18 INT8 94.7%(FP32基线95.3%)、ImageNet ResNet-50 76.4%(FP32 76.7%,但内存仅5.20 GB vs 20.82 GB);所有配置训练内存约为FP32的1/4;分组速度消融在MobileNetV2/ViT-Ti上分别贡献+2.2%/+2.7%精度;且在B=4时仍保持70.5%(对比Ghaffari et al.发散)。

Conclusion: 该研究证明现代深度网络的全整数训练是可行的,在相同内存预算下可以训练更深更准的模型,为资源受限平台上的端侧训练打开了新方向;但目前仅支持SGD+momentum,扩展到Adam/AdamW等自适应优化器(需整数平方根和除法)以及LLM/LoRA微调是未来重要方向。

Abstract: Training neural networks in reduced precision can yield significant efficiency gains, yet all existing methods that scale to standard computer vision benchmarks retain floating-point in at least one stage, typically the weight update or optimizer state. We present a training algorithm that scales to modern deep neural networks, in which every tensor (weights, gradients, and activations) is stored as INT8, and every operation (forward pass, backward pass, weight update, optimizer update) is performed in integer arithmetic. Specifically, tensors are stored as signed integer mantissas paired with explicit power-of-two exponents, on which integer-only operations are performed using five custom composable building blocks (products, sums, divide-by-constant, nonlinear functions, and weight updates). This allows complete implementation of trainable integer layers, including convolutions, batch and layer normalization, softmax, and GELU. A per-group velocity mechanism with independent exponent tracking preserves gradient precision across neurons and channels with diverse magnitudes. As every tensor fits in INT8, training memory is roughly 4x smaller than the FP32 baseline. We validate our training algorithm on CNNs (ResNet-18/34/50/101, MobileNetV2) and Vision Transformers (ViT-Ti / B), demonstrating for the first time that training neural networks with INT8 tensors and integer arithmetic can achieve competitive accuracy on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and ImageNet at a reduced memory budget.

</details>


### [1112] [FON: A Draft-Revise Dual-Organ Language Model without Sequence-Level Quadratic Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16301)
*Helong Hu,Hongdan Pan,Shuiqing Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出FON（Fusion-Organ Network）：一种无注意力模型，将单一权重拆分为两个"器官"——负责前向生成的"起草器官"（多头可学习延迟+内容自适应递归，因果、O(S)训练、O(1)解码状态），以及不生成token、仅对已写前缀再处理的"修订器官"（多尺度ripple核，通过弱门控注入）。在30M参数上，WikiText-103困惑度131.03，优于同参数量Transformer(197.73)与Mamba2(152.53)，并在长度外推和域内填充任务上展现优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准自注意力机制将"读哪里"与"如何混合信息"两个功能耦合在一起，带来O(L^2)训练成本、O(T)解码状态以及长度受限的位置编码等问题；而现有无注意力替代方案（如Mamba等）仅针对"生成"这一单一功能进行优化。

Method: FON由两个分工明确的器官组成：(1) 起草器官（Drafting Organ）——采用多头可学习延迟（multi-tap learnable delays）与内容自适应递归（content-adaptive recursion），保持因果性，无需序列级二次注意力；(2) 修订器官（Revision Organ）——不生成新token，而是通过多尺度ripple核（multi-scale ripple kernels）对已写前缀进行再处理，并以弱门控（weak gates）方式注入到主路径中。整体在参数量、token预算相同条件下进行对比。

Result: 30M参数规模：WikiText-103困惑度131.03，优于Transformer的197.73与Mamba2的152.53；优势在所有depth-aligned基线下保持，并在70M档保持约-20.8%相对改进。长度外推：在8x长度延展下退化约8-9%，介于ALiBi与RoPE之间，无需专门位置编码工程。修订通道为域内填充（in-domain infilling）提供结构性路径，比按需耦合方案提升+19%，且困惑度代价在测量精度内不可区分。边界与劣势：远程检索能力受损；在合成任务上处于劣势；域外代码填充弱于同配方Transformer；存在6.5-12.3倍的wall-clock差距。

Conclusion: FON通过"起草+修订"功能分化设计，在无注意力前提下显著提升语言建模困惑度与长度外推能力，并为因果架构天然缺乏的填充能力提供了一条结构化解决路径；但在远程检索、合成任务、域外代码填充及训练速度方面仍有明显短板。

Abstract: Self-attention assigns two functions to one mechanism-where to read and how to mix-at the price of O(L^2) training, an O(T) decode state, and position signals bound to the training length. Existing attention-free alternatives all optimize the single function of generation. We propose FON (Fusion-Organ Network), which differentiates one weight stack into a drafting organ (multi-tap learnable delays + content-adaptive recursion; causal, O(S) training, O(1) decode state, no sequence-level quadratic attention) and a revision organ that re-processes the written prefix through multi-scale ripple kernels injected via weak gates, never generating. At 30M parameters, iso-parameter and iso-token budget, FON reaches perplexity 131.03 on WikiText-103, beating Transformer (197.73) and Mamba2 (152.53); the advantage persists under all depth-aligned baselines and at the 70M tier (-20.8%). At 8x length extrapolation FON degrades by ~8-9% without positional-encoding engineering, between ALiBi and RoPE. The revision channel provides a structural pathway for in-domain infilling that causal architectures lack in principle (+19% over on-demand coupling), at a perplexity cost indistinguishable within measurement precision. We report all costs and boundaries: impaired long-range retrieval, synthetic-task disadvantages, weaker out-of-domain code infilling than a same-recipe Transformer, and a 6.5-12.3x wall-clock gap.

</details>


### [1113] [Narrative Paradoxes in LLM Inference: Shaping Reasoning Trajectories toward Misalignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16312)
*Haoming Yang,Ke Ma,Yangbangyan Jiang,Ligong Zhang,Xiaojun Jia,Longtao Huang,Yingfei Sun,Qianqian Xu,Qingming Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对大型语言模型多步推理过程的新型越狱攻击方法PDRA（Paradox-driven Reasoning-based Attack），通过构建悖论式叙事核心并嵌入三阶段分析框架，能够绕过LLM的安全机制并生成有害内容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM安全防御主要关注推理内容的最终输出，但忽视了多步推理过程本身的潜在危害——局部合理的推理步骤可能累积形成全局有害结果，需要探索推理链中的安全漏洞。

Method: PDRA方法分两步：(1) 构建悖论式叙事核心，将恶意行为者（如恐怖分子）与良性任务（如撰写安全公告）配对；(2) 将核心嵌入结构化分析框架，迫使模型完成三阶段强制分析——表层目的、潜在意图、操作重构，从而引导模型生成详细有害内容同时保持叙事连贯性。机理上，PDRA操纵模型内部表征，抑制安全触发词同时激活规划类术语。

Result: PDRA在多种LLM上实现了最先进的攻击成功率，且具有较高效率。从机理上证明该方法能有效转移模型内部表征，绕过拒绝机制。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了LLM多步推理过程中存在的安全漏洞，表明仅依赖输出端安全检查不足以保障LLM的可靠使用，需要针对推理过程本身开发新的防御机制。

Abstract: Explicit reasoning in large language models (LLMs) is often associated with reliability, yet it can still pose risks when a model infers harmful goals under a benign context. We identify a distinct challenge: ensuring the safety of the \emph{multi-step reasoning process} itself, where locally coherent steps may still lead to globally harmful outcomes. To explore this vulnerability, we propose PDRA (Paradox-driven Reasoning-based Attack), a novel attack method that programs a harmful reasoning trajectory. PDRA first constructs a paradoxical narrative core by pairing a malicious actor (e.g., a terrorist) with a benign task (e.g., writing a safety bulletin). It then embeds this core into a structured analytical framework that forces the model through a mandatory three-stage analysis -- surface purpose, latent intent, and operational reconstruction -- guiding it to produce detailed harmful content while maintaining narrative coherence. Mechanistically, we show PDRA steers the model's internal representations away from refusal-related patterns, suppressing safety-triggering lexicons while activating planning-oriented terms. Empirically, PDRA achieves state-of-the-art attack success rates across diverse LLMs with high efficiency. \textcolor{red}{\textbf{Warning:} This paper may contain sensitive content.}

</details>


### [1114] [ReTAC: Residual Test-Time Agentic Computation for Video Spatial Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16315)
*Yike Wu,Keyan Chen,Qixiong Wang,Xi Xiang,Maofei Que,Xiaolong Jiang,Xiaoqin Zhang,Ling Shao,Shijian Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ReTAC（Residual Test-Time Agentic Computation），一种无需训练的智能体框架，用于视频空间推理任务。核心思想是将测试时智能体计算视为"残差计算"：仅针对基础模型尚未解决的需求分配额外计算，并在发生局部失败时仅重算受影响的状态。ReTAC在VSI-Bench-Debiased和STI-Bench两个基准上，使用Qwen3-VL-8B、Gemini 3.1 Pro和GPT-5.5三个MLLM均取得了最高总体分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的测试时智能体计算（如规划、工具使用、迭代感知、反思）虽然能提升多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视频空间推理中的能力，但不加区分地应用计算会重复已解决的工作、引入噪声证据并扰动正确预测。已有研究表明，给模型提供真实认知图反而会降低性能。这引出一个问题：给定基础模型已解决的部分，还需要什么额外的测试时计算？现有方法未能显式区分基础模型已支持的需求与仍需解决的需求。

Method: ReTAC是一个训练免费的多智能体框架，核心组成包括：(1) 原生状态生成：单次原生推理产生结构化状态（需求集合、原生证据、未解决需求、候选答案）；(2) 残差路由：若无未解决需求则直接返回，否则进入精炼分支；(3) 残差规划：仅针对未解决需求构建有序的补充感知步骤，与原生证据合并进行推理；(4) 阶段对齐验证：按规划→感知→推理顺序检查，将失败定位到特定阶段；(5) 基于依赖的选择性恢复：仅重算失效状态及其依赖项，保留未受影响的中间状态。同一个基础MLLM在角色特定指令下担任规划者、感知者、推理者和验证者。使用GroundingDINO进行目标检测，VGGT进行几何估计。

Result: 在两个主流基准（VSI-Bench-Debiased和STI-Bench）上，ReTAC使用三种不同MLLM（Qwen3-VL-8B、Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.5）在全部6种模型-基准组合中均取得最高总体分数。控制路由干预实验表明：对直接返回实例强制补充处理会降低性能，对精炼实例抑制精炼也会降低性能。在默认恢复预算下，选择性恢复比完全重启使用更少的平均模型调用次数，且Qwen和GPT获得更高分数。恢复分析显示约三分之二的错误到正确转变，正确到错误转变低于3%。增大恢复预算并不持续改善性能。

Conclusion: 测试时智能体计算应该是残差的：补充计算仅针对基础模型未解决的需求，恢复仅重算失效的状态及其依赖项。实验证明ReTAC在三个异构MLLM和两个视频空间推理基准上的有效性。控制干预表明，计算效用取决于分配位置及保留的有效中间状态，而不仅仅是计算量。这支持模型-实例特定的计算分配原则和基于依赖的状态复用，优于反复执行完整智能体流程。

Abstract: Test-time agentic computation can improve multimodal large language models (MLLMs) through planning, tool use, iterative perception, and reflection, but indiscriminate computation may duplicate resolved work, introduce noisy evidence, and perturb correct predictions. We propose that such computation should be residual: allocate additional computation only to requirements unresolved by the base model and, after a localized failure, recompute only the affected states. We instantiate this formulation in ReTAC, a training-free multiagent framework for video spatial reasoning. ReTAC organizes supplementary computation around unresolved requirements. It plans ordered steps to acquire missing spatial evidence and combines the observations with compatible native evidence for reasoning. In addition, it uses stage-aligned verification to localize failures to planning, perception, or reasoning. Dependency-based recovery recomputes only affected states while reusing unaffected ones. Extensive experiments show that ReTAC achieves the highest overall score among the compared methods across three mainstream MLLMs and two widely adopted benchmarks. Further analyses show that gains from additional computation depend not only on how much is used, but also on where it is allocated and which valid intermediate states are preserved.

</details>


### [1115] [HyWe: Unifying Search and Operation for Real-World Hybrid Web Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16319)
*Zijian Cai,Haowei Liu,Kailai Chen,Lin Peng,Cong Wan,Ziqi Zhang,Chunfeng Yuan,Bing Li,Weiming Hu,Haiyang Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HyWe 提出一个统一搜索（search-based）与操作（operation-based）能力的网页智能体框架，通过模式专属提示词、显式 switch 动作与共享历史，在单一轨迹中完成混合型网络任务；配套 HyWeCollector 自动数据流水线与 HyWeBench 人工编写基准；35B 参数的 HyWe-35B 在混合任务上取得 47.0% 成功率，操作类基准上以更少动作数超越开源基线，并保留深度搜索能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实世界网页任务往往既需要跨站信息检索，也需要页面交互（操作），而现有搜索型与操作型智能体各自发展、单独评测，无法有效解决混合任务；需要一种统一框架与配套训练数据、评测基准来填补这一空白。

Method: HyWe 框架：单一模型在 search mode（S）与 operation mode（O）间切换；每个模式使用专属系统提示与隔离工具集；引入无参数的 switch 动作作为显式能力切换；通过分段（segment）与统一 (m, a, o) 格式及共享历史 H_{<s(t)} 携带证据跨模式传递。HyWeCollector 流水线：阶段1 通过能力探测（探针搜索）在 1110 个真实网站抽取事实池并划分为可搜索 F_S 与需操作 F_O，抽象出 36 个搜索原型与 48 个操作原型；阶段2 设计四种切换模式 A1（O→S 求效率）、A2（S→O 搜索失败回退）、A3（S→O 用搜索结果指导操作）、A4（O→S 用操作结果指导搜索）；阶段3 多智能体协同（任务合成器、执行器、控制器、审核精修器）生成已校验的混合轨迹。训练：在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上用 8055 段级样本（来自 3735 条轨迹按 switch 切分）+ 7000 条搜索轨迹进行 SFT，仅训练语言模型参数，冻结视觉编码器。评测：HyWeBench 100 个人工编写任务，配 info/op 检查清单与基于结果（outcome-based）的评判流程。

Result: HyWeBench 上：HyWe-35B 达 47.0% 任务成功率，优于训练前基线 28.0% +19.0pp，显著超过 XYZ-Aquila-mini（22.0%）与 Fara-7B（13.0%），与 Kimi-K3（46.0%，2.8T 参数）、Qwen3.8-Max（44.0%，2.4T 参数）相当而参数仅为其 1/80 与 1/69。框架消融：同基模型下 naive merging（单一提示暴露全部工具）仅 11.0%，HyWe 框架达 28.0%；info 子目标完成率从 36.9%→74.8%，op 从 15.8%→43.7%。操作类基准：Online-Mind2Web 59.0%（开源最高）、WebVoyager 88.3%；Steps/SR 相比 Fara-7B 分别下降 48.3% 与 51.9%；训练后切换率从 37.3%/20.8% 升至 93.7%/87.9%。深度搜索：HLE 47.8%、xbench-DeepSearch-2510 64.0%（开源最高）、BrowseComp-EN 74.6%，保留并增强搜索能力。

Conclusion: 通过子目标执行、显式模式切换与共享证据的统一组织，HyWe 在单一模型与轨迹中有效融合搜索与操作能力，相对 naive merging 显著提升混合任务完成率；自动化的 HyWeCollector 可扩展地生成高质量混合训练数据；HyWe-35B 以约 35B 参数量在混合与操作任务上达到或超越参数量大数十倍的前沿模型，并维持深度搜索性能，表明显式能力分解与切换是实现通用网页智能体的有效路径。开放方向：隔离各设计贡献的单独作用，以及提升对持续变化的真实网站的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Real-world hybrid web tasks need both information gathering and page interaction, yet search-based and operation-based agents are developed and evaluated separately. To bridge this gap, we introduce HyWe, a framework that unifies both capabilities within one model and trajectory. Its two modes use dedicated prompts and tool sets to sustain sub-goal execution; explicit switching selects the needed capability, and shared history lets each mode build on the other's findings. To provide demonstrations of these behaviors, we develop HyWeCollector, a fully automatic pipeline that uses task prototypes, four switching patterns, and multi-agent synthesis to produce verified hybrid trajectories. We train HyWe-35B on these demonstrations to unify efficient information gathering and browser interaction in a single 35B web agent. To evaluate hybrid task completion, we introduce HyWeBench: 100 human-written tasks on websites distinct from training, with human-written sub-goal checklists and an outcome-based evaluation pipeline. Hybrid training enables HyWe-35B to achieve 47.0% success on this benchmark, improving on the untrained base model by 19.0 percentage points and outperforming existing search-based and operation-based agents. Even before training, the same base model solves 28.0% of tasks with HyWe, versus 11.0% with all tools under one prompt. Beyond hybrid tasks, HyWe-35B achieves 59.0% and 88.3% success on Online-Mind2Web and WebVoyager, outperforming existing open-source baselines and cutting action cost per successful task by 48.3% and 51.9% compared with Fara-7B.

</details>


### [1116] [When a Conceptor Complement Becomes Gain: Operator Geometry and Behavioral Attribution in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16325)
*Shuhul Razdan,R Balamurugan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型激活干预中概念子补矩阵的贡献归属问题。通过设计保留目标中心和增益但移除协方差矩阵的对照组，证明整体干预的行为效应不能简单归因于拟合矩阵。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在激活引导（activation steering）中，当一个干预改变了模型行为时，传统的整体对照实验无法确定是干预的哪个组件（如矩阵、中心点、增益）产生了效果。本文旨在解决这一组件归属问题，检验目标中心的缩放概念子补矩阵是否对生成行为有独立贡献。

Method: 使用三个模型（Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）和七个Persona Vectors目标。设计匹配控制 $F_{0,t}$，保留目标中心和增益但移除协方差矩阵 $C_t$。在 $\alpha=.05$、$\beta=2$ 下进行完整图谱分析、孔径扫描、保持性外激活估计（480对匹配比较，1920响应），以及线性可访问性测试（LEACE/INLP对比）。

Result: 在测试的操作点上，21个拟合图谱全部扩展所有方向（最小增益1.6598）；矩阵修正仅占匹配控制位移的0.093%-7.815%。480对文本比较中285对不同，但所有12个目标表达和连贯性对比的95%置信区间均包含零，未能建立一致的目标抑制附加效应。孔径扫描显示当 $\alpha=2$ 时所有图谱进入衰减状态。可逆软滤波保持仿射可读性，而专用擦除方法（LEACE/INLP）将新拟合探针的预测准确率降至0.663/0.669。

Conclusion: 基线对照的行为效应不足以将生成行为归因于拟合矩阵。需要：分析完整变换、固定共享组件、直接测试输出后果。矩阵的"软滤波"名称或其局部位移都不能决定其生成效应。归属要求是报告交付给模型的完整变换，移除被声称为贡献的组件而保留其他组件，然后测量行为结果。

Abstract: When a steering intervention changes a language model's behavior, which part of the intervention deserves the credit? We test this question for a target-centered, scaled conceptor complement by removing its fitted covariance filter while preserving the same target-specific center and gain. At the original aperture $\alpha=.05$ and gain $\beta=2$, all 21 fitted maps across three models and seven targets expand every direction at the generation intervention layers. The matrix correction is $0.093\%$--$7.815\%$ of the matched-control displacement on held-out extraction activations. In 480 paired comparisons within a 1,920-response study, retaining the matrix changes many individual texts but does not establish a consistent additional target-suppression benefit on the four-target panel. A geometric aperture sweep shows that the operating regime changes with the filter setting. Separately, an invertible soft filter preserves what an unrestricted affine readout can recover, whereas dedicated erasure methods reduce prediction by newly fitted probes. Together, the results show why a whole-intervention comparison cannot by itself attribute generated behavior to the fitted matrix: analyze the complete transformation, hold shared components fixed, and test its output consequences directly.

</details>


### [1117] [TRAP: Tool-result Replay Attack for Probing Misbinding in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16333)
*Yutong Zhi,Jie Zhang,Xiuqi Lu,Jiayuan Xu,Jing Shao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出"工具结果错绑"(Tool-Result Misbinding)这一新型LLM Agent安全风险：真实且未被篡改的工具结果被错误地关联到不兼容的执行上下文，导致Agent执行不安全操作。作者构建了ReplayBench基准测试，通过受控的工具结果重放攻击，在8个LLM、3个Agent框架、19个场景中系统评估该漏洞，发现跨任务重放下平均终态错误率高达0.649，并提出三种运行时防御机制可完全消除此类错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI Agent越来越多地通过外部工具执行操作，工具结果需要经过缓存、恢复机制和共享运行时状态才能被使用。这种持久化与跨上下文传递破坏了结果与产生它的执行上下文之间的正确关联，造成了一种新型安全风险：即使结果是真实且未被修改的，在错误的上下文中使用也会导致Agent执行不安全操作。现有关于Agent安全的研究主要关注提示注入、工具投毒等对抗性内容攻击，或异步协调、状态一致性等执行过程失败，但尚未系统研究"结果-上下文绑定缺失"这一根本性问题。LangGraph.js生产报告中的跨线程状态污染事件和CVE-2026-25536 MCP TypeScript SDK漏洞表明该风险已现实存在。

Method: 1. 形式化定义：提出绑定函数 B(r,C) 表示结果r是否正确关联到执行上下文C，错绑即 B(r_s, C_t)=0；定义四阶段失败传播路径（结果投递→错误动作生成→动作通过→终态错误）。2. 构建ReplayBench基准：包含19个应用场景（如邮件、日历、文件共享、支付等）、4种失败模板（T01跨任务、T02过期上下文、T03重复执行、T04乱序）、3种重放机制（持久化恢复、队列重投递、缓存恢复）。3. 评估设置：8个LLM（GPT-5.5/5.6系列、Gemini-3.8-Flash、DeepSeek-V4-Pro、GLM-5.3、Qwen3.8-Max、Claude-Opus-5）× 3个框架（LlamaIndex、LangGraph、OpenAI Agents SDK），每配置n=10试验。4. 关键指标：DAR（投递率）、WAR（错误动作率）、AAR（动作接受率）、FSER（终态错误率，主指标）。5. 防御机制：在工具网关实现Call-ID绑定、一次性票据（One-shot tickets）、世界状态纪元（World-state epochs）三种运行时校验。6. 消融实验：分析任务/对象相似度、结果新鲜度、环境变化、对抗提示注入（IPI）等控制变量对重放脆弱性的影响。

Result: 1. 主实验T01：168个模型-框架-场景配置中，38.1%达到FSER=1.0，平均FSER=0.649；完整基准测试平均FSER达0.989。2. 方差分解：模型身份解释约74%的变异（η²=0.742），框架仅解释<1%，场景解释6%。3. 模型差异显著：DeepSeek-V4-Pro平均FSER=0.967最脆弱，Claude-Opus-5仅0.019最具抵抗力。4. 阶段分析：DAR≈1.0，AAR紧密跟踪WAR和FSER，表明失败主要源于模型侧将错误上下文的结果视为有效证据。5. 相似度分析：任务相似度对脆弱性影响因场景而异，对象相似度无明显关联。6. 新鲜度：显式新鲜度提示可将高陈旧结果FSER从1.0降至0.60，但不彻底。7. 环境变化：隐式状态变化无影响，显式撤销授权可将FSER降至0.20。8. IPI对比：部分模型（如DeepSeek-V4-Pro、GLM-5.3）能抵抗提示注入但仍受重放攻击，表明两类攻击暴露不同脆弱性。9. 防御效果：三种运行时校验在所有评估模板下均将FSER降至0，FR=0，Recov=1.0；仅基于对象ID的基线防御在T03同对象重复重放下失败（FSER=1.0）。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了工具结果错绑作为有状态AI Agent的普遍性安全风险：真实且未被修改的工具结果在错误的执行上下文中被消费时，会导致持久性状态错误。ReplayBench的实证表明该漏洞在多样化的模型、框架和场景中广泛存在，主要失败发生在模型侧的证据接受阶段，而非结果投递阶段。模型对指令型攻击（如间接提示注入）的抵抗力并不能保证对结果错绑的抵抗力。论文呼吁Agent运行时引入显式的上下文绑定机制；所提出的三种运行时有效性校验（Call-ID绑定、一次性票据、世界状态纪元）能完全消除终态错误且不干扰合法恢复，验证了"在工具网关层强制结果-上下文绑定"是可行且必要的防御方向。

Abstract: As AI agents increasingly act through external tools, tool results are no longer simple outputs but execution artifacts that must remain correctly associated with the context that produced them. Yet as results persist across caches, recovery mechanisms, and shared runtime state, this association can break, causing a real and unmodified result to be consumed in an incompatible execution context and lead the agent to an unsafe action. We characterize this failure as tool-result misbinding. To systematically study this failure, we introduce ReplayBench, a benchmark that uses controlled tool-result replay to evaluate misbinding across 19 representative agent scenarios, 4 failure properties, and 3 replay mechanisms. Across eight LLMs, three agent frameworks, and diverse stateful workflows, we find widespread replay-induced failures, with a mean Final-State Error Rate of 0.649 under cross-task replay. Stage-wise analysis localizes these failures to model-side action generation. Further analyses show that replay susceptibility varies with task similarity, shows little dependence on object similarity, and remains high under result staleness and implicit environment changes. These findings motivate runtime validity mechanisms that eliminate final-state errors in our evaluated settings while preserving legitimate recovery. The results call for explicit contextual binding in tool-using agent runtimes. Our work is public at this https URL .

</details>


### [1118] [Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning via Confidence-Guided Adaptive Debate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16343)
*Seungdong Yoa,Ye Seul Sim,Suhee Yoon,Sanghyu Yoon,Dongmin Kim,Soonyoung Lee,Bumsoo Kim,Junhyun Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 LASE（Leader-Adaptive Structured Engagement），一种基于置信度门控的自适应多智能体辩论框架。该方法通过非对称的"领导者-支持者"拓扑结构和不确定性驱动的选择性交互，仅在预测可能有益（纠正性机制）的实例上触发多智能体协作，从而在保持接近单智能体推理成本的同时，实现多智能体级别的推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体辩论（Multi-Agent Debate, MAD）的有效性在理论上存在争议：一方面，贝叶斯潜在概念分析表明在存在"正确种子"时辩论可放大正确信号；另一方面，对称辩论动态在期望上是中性的（鞅），多数投票往往更优。现有MAD框架对所有实例无差别地启用辩论，浪费计算资源却未能稳定提升性能。本文的核心问题是：辩论应在何时、以何种结构被调用，才能避免中性机制并利用纠正性条件。

Method: 方法包括三大组件：(1) 置信度代理（Confidence Proxies）——使用最小token对数概率 LP_min 和最大token熵 H_max 定义不确定性事件 U；(2) 选择性门控——当 U=0 时直接输出单智能体结果，U=1 时才触发交互；(3) 领导者-支持者非对称星型拓扑——Leader接收单个支持者（依次为Adversary、Supporter、可选Expert）的1:1定向反馈，由Leader聚合更新；支持者不互相覆盖Leader的决策。理论上，该设计通过打破对称辩论的鞅中性条件（Choi et al., 2025），并在潜在概念贝叶斯框架（Hu et al., 2025）下集中预算于"正确种子"可能出现的纠正性机制上。文中给出 Theorem A.5（选择性辩论带来正向期望改进）和 Corollary A.7（帕累托前沿改善）的形式化证明。

Result: 在六个推理与知识基准（MATH-500、MATH-lv5、GSM-Symbolic、MMLU-Pro、GPQA-Diamond、TruthfulQA-MC）上，使用 Gemini-2.0-Flash 和 GPT-4.1-mini 评估，LASE 在所有基准上一致优于单智能体、多数投票（MV, N=7）和多智能体辩论（MAD, N=3, 2轮）。在 GPQA-Diamond 上 LASE 达到 65.2%（MV 62.7%, MAD 62.1%）。同时平均 token 成本相比 MAD 降低超过 10×（如 GSM-Symbolic 上 0.4k vs 5.6k）。与 Mixture-of-Agents（MoA）相比，LASE 在 MATH-500 上以仅 25% 的计算预算（0.9M vs 3.6M tokens）实现 74.2% 准确率（MoA 72.0%）。校准分析表明 LP_min 与准确率正相关（高置信度 85.5% vs 低置信度 50.9%），H_max 与准确率负相关（熵>1.0 时准确率仅 30.4%），验证了不确定性代理的有效性。在 Llama-3-8B 上进一步验证了方法的迁移性，并在该弱模型上观察到 MAD 性能低于单智能体基线（24.1% vs 25.7%），印证了对称辩论在低能力机制下的退化效应。阈值敏感性和支持者顺序随机化的实验均显示方法具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: LASE 框架将多智能体辩论重新定位为一种成本受控的测试时计算分配策略，通过置信度门控和领导者-支持者非对称拓扑，实现了准确率与 token 成本的帕累托前沿改善。理论上证明了其打破鞅中性、诱导正向偏差的能力，实验上证实了在多个基准和模型上以接近单智能体成本达到多智能体性能。作者指出当前局限包括：高度自信但错误的实例难以通过同质支持者纠正（"自信错误"），以及基础模型内在推理能力上限构成性能天花板。未来工作方向包括将单支持者推广为多智能体辩论子系统的层次化扩展。

Abstract: Multi-agent debate has shown promise for improving the reasoning of large language models, yet recent theory suggests its benefits are highly regime-dependent. While interaction can amplify informative signals under corrective conditions, symmetric debate dynamics are neutral in expectation, often making majority voting preferable. We reconcile these views by arguing that debate is effective only when invoked at the right time and with appropriate structure. Based on this insight, we propose LASE: Leader-Adaptive Structured Engagement, a leader-centric multi-agent debate framework that selectively engages interaction only in non-neutral regimes. LASE introduces an asymmetric leader-supporter architecture that enables directed information flow and selective signal amplification, while defaulting to simple aggregation otherwise. Experiments across diverse reasoning benchmarks show that LASE achieves multi-agent-level performance with near single-agent token cost, substantially improving efficiency over static debate and voting baselines.

</details>


### [1119] [ChronoScribe: Semantic-Numerical Specialization for Instruction-Driven Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16345)
*Yuchen Jiao,Miao Zhang,Yuxuan Liu,Chengxi Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ChronoScribe提出了一种"语义-数值专精化"框架，将LLM与时序基础模型（TSFM）解耦分工：LoRA微调的Qwen3.5-9B负责解析自然语言指令、生成类型化指令（路由+上下文长度）以及基于证据生成响应；冻结的Chronos-2专门负责生成量化轨迹预测。在30个公开数据集、23个评估维度中，ChronoScribe在sMAPE、MASE、WAPE、RMSE、MAE五项核心指标上全面优于11个专有直接LLM和3个开源TSFM，最佳直接LLM的误差仍为ChronoScribe的2.0–2.7倍；任务级得分（TLS）为65.5，比最强直接LLM基线高10.6分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指令驱动时序预测面临核心矛盾：LLM擅长理解非结构化自然语言指令但数值预测不精确，TSFM数值预测能力强但需要结构化输入（目标序列、上下文窗口、预测范围）。现有方案要么让LLM直接生成预测（精度差），要么用固定上下文无法灵活适配不同请求。需要一种架构让LLM配置数值专家而不直接生成或修改预测轨迹，保持数值来源的可追溯性。

Method: 1) 类型化指令工作流：LoRA适配的Qwen3.5-9B生成JSON格式指令（含路径选择u∈{0,1}和上下文长度C），确定性规则Γ解析并归一化，失败时回退到默认路由；2) 双路径架构：直接路径LLM直接回答；专家路径由冻结的Chronos-2接收选定历史窗口X^{(C,j*)}生成{P10, P50, P90}量化轨迹Y；3) 确定性证据映射g将量化轨迹转换为证据记录e=(e_num, e_dir, e_unc, e_aux)；4) 证据条件响应：LLM基于请求q和证据e采样响应r，不生成也不修改数值；5) 形式化定义forecast-groundedResponse"性（Claim_k⊆Derivable_k）作为可审计的溯源测试；6) LoRA微调（rank=64, α=128, dropout=0.05, 2 epoch, lr=2e-4）训练指令生成和证据-响应两个接口任务；7) 评估涵盖23维度/5组（预测60%、时序推理15%、指令遵循15%、不确定性5%、效率5%）和TLS加权聚合。

Result: 在30个公开数据集（8120实例）、23个评估维度、460条主对比记录上：1) 点误差：ChronoScribe sMAPE=25.5, MASE=4.20, RMSE=1.77, WAPE=24.4, MAE=1.13，五项指标全部最低；2) 相对最强直接LLM（GPT-5.5）的sMAPE从50.85%降至25.51%（95% CI [17.4, 35.2]pp），降幅约50–63%；3) TLS=65.5，比最强直接LLM Gemini-3.1 Flash（55.0）高10.6分；在w_F∈{0.40, 0.80}敏感性分析中均第一；4) 消融：无LoRA降至51.7，无Chronos-2降至25.5（说明直接LLM预测不可替代数值专家），C2-only为35.3；5) 控制器95.9%请求返回可解析指令；230条声明中87.4%与确定性证据一致（数值79.6%，方向92.1%），89/100响应通过全部检查。

Conclusion: ChronoScribe通过语义-数值专精化分工实现了指令驱动时序预测：LLM负责解释、配置和沟通，TSFM单独负责生成预测轨迹。该设计保留了预测值的单一来源，使数值来源（provenance）可审计，并显著优于直接使用LLM或固定上下文TSFM的方案。在高风险应用中，受数值声明一致性79.6%的限制，建议采用约束渲染或基于验证器的修订机制以提高可靠性。

Abstract: Recent advances in instruction-driven time series forecasting highlight a fundamental tension: systems must simultaneously master natural-language instruction following and precise numerical prediction. Current approaches often force a compromise. Large language models (LLMs) can interpret unstructured requests but may be inaccurate when asked to produce forecast values directly, whereas time series foundation models (TSFMs) provide numerical forecasts but typically require structured inputs specifying the target series, context window, and horizon. We present ChronoScribe, which applies semantic-numerical specialization to this workflow. A LoRA-adapted LLM proposes an execution path and context length; deterministic rules resolve the executable configuration. On the specialist path, a frozen TSFM produces quantile trajectories for the task-specified horizon. Deterministic trajectory summaries condition the response, while the LLM neither generates nor revises predicted values. We evaluate a Qwen3.5-9B--Chronos-2 implementation across 23 evaluation dimensions and 30 public datasets against eleven proprietary direct LLMs and three open TSFMs. ChronoScribe has the lowest error on sMAPE, MASE, WAPE, RMSE, and MAE among all evaluated systems, including fixed-context controls. Across these metrics, even the lowest direct-LLM error remains 2.0--2.7 times the corresponding ChronoScribe error. At the system level, ChronoScribe achieves a Task-Level Score (TLS) of 65.5, 10.6 points above the strongest direct-LLM baseline. The results support ChronoScribe's division of labor, in which the LLM handles interpretation, configuration, and communication while the TSFM handles numerical forecasting.

</details>


### [1120] [World Models Need a Physical Registry: Learning Internal Predictive States for Physically Plausible World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16365)
*Shinseong Kim,Jaeseok Jeong,Jianlong Fu,Youngjung Uh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Physical Registry（物理注册器），将预测性动力学作为视频DiT内部的显式、可读状态；在Physics-IQ Verified上比vanilla微调提升9.9/8.7点，并提出无需完整视频评分的Physical Registry Selector（PRS）用于早期候选选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视频世界模型在生成物理合理未来方面仍存在不足。现有方法通常使用语义、物理或预测信息引导视频生成，却未明确回答"在生成器的哪里应当承载场景演化的预测"这一基本问题。标准视频token将外观与表征共同编码，无法提供独立可读的预测动力学状态。

Method: 在视频DiT内部引入Physical Registry：一组时序锚定的注册器slot，由基于观测的JEPA预测初始化，与视频token共同演化，并通过预测监督对齐到未来帧的JEPA表示。训练目标结合流匹配损失和余弦对齐损失。推理阶段提出Physical Registry Selector（PRS），基于中间注册器读数与共享预测的偏离度进行候选排序，无需完整视频评分。

Result: 在Physics-IQ Verified上，Physical Registry比vanilla微调提升I2V/V2V 9.9/8.7点；Cosmos 3 Nano 16B仅增加0.45%参数即超越Cosmos 3 Super 64B（43.56 vs 42.7）。PRS在四个骨干上将I2V提升5.6%-15.9%。在WorldModelBench和EWMBench上同样改善物理合理性与运动正确性。

Conclusion: 动力学预测应当作为显式模型状态，与视频表征共同演化。这一原则为世界模型中物理合理未来的表征与读取提供了有效接口。

Abstract: Video world models must generate physically plausible futures, not just realistic frames. Existing approaches typically use semantic, physical, or predictive information to guide the visual generation stream, leaving a fundamental question: where inside the generator should predictions of scene evolution live? Standard video tokens jointly encode appearance and dynamics, but provide no distinct state for learning and reading predictive dynamics. We answer this question with the Physical Registry: temporally grounded registry slots inside a video DiT that are initialized from an observation-conditioned forecast, co-evolve with video tokens, and receive future-representation supervision, making predictive dynamics an explicit, readable state of the generator. In a controlled comparison of predictive-state interfaces on Physics-IQ Verified, Physical Registry improves vanilla fine-tuning by 9.9/8.7 points on I2V/V2V, the largest gain among the interfaces we compare. Across all Cosmos and WAN backbones, Physical Registry improves Physics-IQ Verified scores. With only 0.45% additional parameters, it enables Cosmos 3 Nano 16B to surpass the published I2V score of Cosmos 3 Super 64B (43.56 vs. 42.7). On WorldModelBench, it also improves physical adherence and the total score for all four evaluated backbones. Because the registry becomes candidate-specific while remaining readable, the Physical Registry Selector (PRS) ranks emerging futures by how far their intermediate registry readouts depart from the shared forecast before full denoising is complete. Across four backbones, this selection improves I2V scores by 5.6-15.9% without completed-video external scoring. Together, these results support a broader principle: dynamics prediction should live as an explicit model state that co-evolves with the video representation. Project page: this https URL

</details>


### [1121] [RetroPlanner: Multi-Route Expansion and Multi-Objective Reasoning for LLM-Based Retrosynthesis Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16391)
*Ye Rin Kim,Yongjun Jeong,Seongjun Yun,Hanbum Ko,Soohyun Oh,Sungbin Lim,Sungwoong Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RetroPlanner 提出了一种基于 LLM 的多步逆合成规划方法，通过在单轮决策中同时扩展多条路径并基于反应合理性、循环一致性和起始原料价格四个目标进行多目标推理，在保持高成功率的同时恢复更多高质量的替代合成路线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 逆合成规划器每步仅扩展单个前沿分子并仅以可解性为目标，导致在受限搜索预算下大量潜在的高质量替代路线（虽已被部分展开但未继续扩展）被遗漏，难以在多个反映实际合成可行性的目标间做出权衡。

Method: 1) 将前沿扩展形式化为对多个前沿分子的集合决策（open/rank/done 三阶段并行扩展）；2) 引入结构化推理模式 MOLECULE/DISCONNECTIONS/DECIDING（含 diverging from 与 ordered by 子字段），基于反应合理性、循环一致性与起始原料价格进行多目标推理；3) 利用 Qwen3 作为教师生成推理轨迹，通过与搜索图自动核验保证推理事实正确性，并对 GPT-OSS-20B 进行监督微调。

Result: 在 USPTO-190 与 ChEMBL-1000 基准上，RetroPlanner 恢复了显著更多的备选路线（7.41 / 10.59 条），Better-Than-Reference 优于全部基线（66.84% vs MORetro* 的 52.11%），三个质量指标均取得兼顾最优，成功率（92.11% / 90.00%）接近最优的 RetroAgent；消融实验验证多路径并行扩展快于串行扩展（每分子 10.6s vs 13.0s），且单步模型更换为 LocalRetro 或循环一致性模型更换为 RXNGraphormer 后优势仍保持。

Conclusion: 将前沿视为联合决策上下文并以证据化多目标推理指导扩展，能在受预算约束的逆合成搜索中同时提升路线多样性与合成可行性；未来工作包括通过强化学习直接优化路线级目标，以及将反应条件、产率与安全性等实验因素纳入考量。

Abstract: Multi-step retrosynthesis planning is often considered solved once a route to purchasable starting materials is found, but such a route should also be practical in real-world chemistry. Recent LLM-based planners formulate this process as sequential decision-making over an AND-OR graph, yet typically expand a single molecule per turn and are optimized for solvability alone, leaving alternative routes uncompared across the multiple objectives that determine practicality before the search budget is committed. We introduce RetroPlanner, an LLM-based planner that jointly compares multiple routes to steer the search toward higher synthesizability, as measured by reaction plausibility, round-trip consistency, and starting-material price. RetroPlanner is trained to reason over chemical evidence: structural progress from the target molecule, bond changes and reaction classes, where candidate routes diverge from one another, and how they rank across multiple objectives. Experiments on multi-step retrosynthesis benchmarks demonstrate that RetroPlanner recovers more alternative routes than prior LLM-based planners while improving synthetic route quality and maintaining a high success rate.

</details>


### [1122] [Recursive Environment Scaling for General Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16397)
*Lingxiao Jing,Zhengbo Jiao,Yichen Xiang,Bofan Zhu,Lingbei Meng,Yan Ni,Haorui Chen,Ran Ran,Zhirong Shen,Yuheng Yang,Chenhang Cui,Yaosong Du,Rui Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出递归环境缩放（RES）框架，通过保留核心任务目标、递归改变信息访问、资源关系和执行依赖来扩展现有基准环境的难度。实验表明 RES 能显著降低六个评估模型在三个基准上的任务成功率（最高下降 77.14 个百分点），同时使用 RES 收集的轨迹进行监督微调在所有三个 Qwen3.5 基础模型上一致优于原始轨迹 SFT（提升 7.00–14.61 个百分点）。消融实验证实递归继承和依赖组合是难度提升的关键来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型智能体在长时程交互任务中的评估与训练受限于固定的基准环境，难以系统性地扩展难度。传统方法如任务合成从零构建任务，而本文探索保留核心目标、对现有环境进行递归改造的扩展维度，旨在解决如何递归缩放可执行环境同时保持任务有效性这一研究问题。

Method: RES 框架将任务建模为 (C_k, E_k) 对（目标规范 + 可执行环境），通过三个机制运作：(1) Proposer 检查已验证的父环境，组合对资源、关系和操作的程序化变换；(2) 执行基础验证器独立重放声明的变换，检查任务保留性、构造一致性和公开可执行性；(3) 递归继承使已接受的子环境成为下一轮父环境，使先前的访问路径和依赖沿谱系累积。变换库包含 17 个 Claw 算子，操作分为资源变换、依赖组合和操作变换三类。

Result: 在三个基准（Claw-Eval-Live N=105、Workspace-Bench-Lite N=100、Terminal-Bench 2.1 N=89）的 294 个初始任务上，RES 使六个评估模型（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash、GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Opus 5、GLM-5.2、Qwen3.8-Max、Kimi K3）的成功率在所有基准上均下降（18/18 比较），其中 Claw-Eval-Live 上下降 57.14–77.14 个百分点。训练方面，使用 RES 轨迹的 SFT 在 Qwen3.5-4B/9B/35B-A3B 三个基础模型上均优于原始轨迹 SFT（9/9 模型-基准比较），平均提升 10.00–10.86 个百分点。消融证实：移除依赖使成功率从 0% 回升至 100%；移除递归继承则从 6.7% 升至 93.3%；限制运算符子集从 6.7% 升至 80.0%；递归深度从 1 到 10 使成功率从 82.9% 降至 4.8%。

Conclusion: RES 将现有可执行环境转化为智能体评估与训练的可控缩放维度。在保留核心任务目标的前提下，递归继承的变换能降低三个基准、六款模型的任务完成率，同时生成的训练轨迹在三个 Qwen3.5 基础模型上均优于原始轨迹 SFT。组件消融与轨迹分析将观察到的效果归因于继承依赖的累积与交互需求的增长，支持将环境缩放作为扩展现有基准和收集改善智能体性能的轨迹的实用路径。

Abstract: We study environment scaling as a way to increase agent-benchmark difficulty while holding core task objectives fixed. Our framework, Recursive Environment Scaling (RES), transforms existing benchmark environments while preserving their objectives and completion requirements. A proposer changes information access, resource relations, and execution dependencies; execution-grounded checks validate the resulting candidate, and accepted changes are inherited across rounds. This produces related environments for paired evaluation and training-trajectory collection. Experiments on 294 initial tasks from three benchmarks show lower task success for all six evaluation models, with decreases of 57.14--77.14 percentage points on Claw-Eval-Live. With equal trajectory counts and identical optimization settings, fine-tuning on RES trajectories outperforms original-trajectory SFT in all nine model--benchmark comparisons by 7.00--14.61 percentage points. Ablations identify recursive inheritance and dependency composition as important contributors to increased difficulty. Together, these results support environment scaling for both agent evaluation and training.

</details>


### [1123] [EvoWeb: A Benchmark for Coding Agents on Evolving Web Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16402)
*David Nukrai,Bar Alon,Nativ Levy,Ido Andrew Atad,Ido Cohen,Itamar Zimerman,Lior Wolf,Eli David,Ilan Naiman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EvoWeb是一个针对长时序、多请求Web应用开发的基准测试，包含320个累积请求和32个Web应用，通过功能依赖图构建，并使用多模态Web智能体在真实浏览器中评估代码智能体的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Web生成基准主要评估针对固定规范的单次开发过程，无法反映真实世界中Web应用通过连续、增量请求迭代开发的场景，也缺乏对开发过程中可靠性的细致评估。

Method: 构建基于真实产品功能的32个Web应用基准EvoWeb，包含320个累积请求，这些请求通过功能依赖图（functional dependency graphs）组织。智能体在持久代码库上进行迭代修改，多模态Web智能体在实时浏览器中测试每个中间应用，评估新请求功能、跨请求集成及历史功能的保持情况。通过用户容忍阈值上的轨迹性能积分来刻画开发过程中的可靠性。

Result: 在开源和闭源前沿模型上的实验表明，EvoWeb能够清晰区分不同模型的性能，其中跨请求集成是关键挑战。后续分析显示，依赖关系更深或更多的后期请求解决准确率更低，且随着请求的累积，运行时错误变得更加频繁。

Conclusion: EvoWeb为评估和改进长时序、多请求开发中的代码智能体提供了一个测试平台，揭示了当前模型在累积式Web开发中的可靠性局限，特别是在跨请求集成方面的不足。

Abstract: Web application development often proceeds through successive requests that extend an existing implementation. Yet web-generation benchmarks primarily evaluate development toward fixed specifications. We introduce EvoWeb, a novel benchmark comprising 320 cumulative requests over 32 web applications, grounded in real-world product features and structured by functional dependency graphs. Agents iteratively modify a persistent codebase, while a multimodal web agent tests each intermediate application in a live browser, assessing newly requested functionality, cross-request integration, and previously requested functionality. To characterize reliability throughout development, we integrate trajectory performance across user-tolerance thresholds rather than impose a fixed stopping criterion. Experiments across open- and closed-source frontier models show that EvoWeb reveals clear performance differences between models, with cross-request integration emerging as a key challenge. Further analysis shows that later requests with deeper or more numerous dependencies are solved less accurately, while runtime errors become more frequent over successive requests. EvoWeb provides a testbed for evaluating and improving coding agents in long-horizon, multi-request development.

</details>


### [1124] [SLS-Bench: A Benchmark for Incident Log Summarization with Synthetic Observability Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16412)
*Valerii Iakovlev,Markus Spanring,Martin Flechl*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了SLS-Bench，一个基于真实事故报告构建的合成日志摘要基准测试，包含90个任务，每个任务配有平均56k条合成日志流和参考摘要。作者开发了一套报告驱动型合成数据生成流水线，通过结构化事故模型、生成器-验证器循环以及与真实日志流的统计对比来确保数据质量。评估了14个LLM后发现，前沿模型能生成有用摘要但成本和延迟较高，开源权重模型质量明显落后。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着IT系统规模与复杂度增长，自动化智能体驱动的故障响应愈发关键，其中将海量日志流总结为人类可读报告是核心能力。然而，由于真实生产日志和参考摘要的收集成本极高，现有基准测试在"从大型日志流进行端到端摘要"这一任务上覆盖不足，亟需一个可扩展、可控、真实的评估框架来衡量LLM智能体在该任务上的能力。

Method: 方法核心是"报告驱动合成数据生成流水线"：(1) 从公开事故报告(postmortem)出发，使用LLM将其转化为结构化"事故模型"（包含系统结构、日志模板与发射机制burst/background/path、分阶段时间线）；(2) 通过LLM生成确定性Python模拟器，将事故模型编译为大规模CSV日志流；(3) 直接从事故模型生成参考摘要，严格限制只描述日志可观测到的信息；(4) 采用生成器-验证器循环（最多20次迭代，要求K=10次连续验证通过），结合算法校验和LLM语义校验保证质量；(5) 与Loghub-2.0真实日志在消息长度、模板多样性、变量基数、邻接模板可预测性等维度进行统计对比验证真实性。评估方面采用双LLM评判员（GPT-5.2 medium + Sonnet 4.6 low）按七维rubric打分并取平均。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) 90个任务，每个平均56k条日志，参考摘要平均2400词；(3) 流水线总成本约776美元；(5) 评估结果显示GPT-5.4 (high/medium) 以0.73分并列最高，但仍低于"good match"阈值0.75，平均耗时6.9–9.5分钟、成本1.56–2.19美元/题；OpenAI模型定义成本-性能Pareto前沿，GLM-5是表现最强的开源权重模型(0.49)；(7) 评分分解显示高层次的故障链重建接近饱和(诊断维度接近1.0)，而时间线进展和支持对齐维度在0.7-0.8区间停滞；(8) 效率分析表明约21%的工具调用输出可预先计算，30%的轨迹属于可并行的"初始定向与规划"前缀段；(9) 与o11y-bench的Spearman秩相关系数为0.81，与OpenRCA Partial得分为0.90，验证了基准的外部有效性。
